title: Troubles From Distant Lands
objectives:
Gather 3 types of healing herbs for [Aneka Konko](Aneka Konko) in [Ratchet](Ratchet).
- [Summer Dew](Summer Dew) (3)
- [Life's Dawn](Life's Dawn) (3)
- [Vulpa Bloom](Vulpa Bloom) (3)
description:
I offer you humble greetings, denizen of these lands.

It is remiss of me to ask this of you, but my people are in grave danger so I cannot withhold from inquiring. My name is Aneka Konko. I hail from Kamio, a land across the seas. Five years ago, we first saw the fish and snake people wash upon our shores. Their encroachments have only continued and our sacred Kami can no longer protect us.

I have arrived to this land with a small entourage to seek the help of kind souls who could assist me.

Our warriors are fighting to their last breath against the invaders, although, these days most of our warriors die not to the enemy, but to illness.

We're ill equipped to treat the many injured. Our island is small and few of us possess the knowledge or reagents needed.

When I first came here, I learned of three rare plants that possess immense healing properties. I beg of you to assist us. Retrieve these plants from the three oases in the Barrens.

Each oasis contains one of these plants.
progress: Did you get the herbs? Please, so many lives can be saved.
completion:
These are the herbs. I will have them shipped to my homeland. I am in your debt <name>, but I have little in terms of value to offer you.

My people have created a unique invention that utilizes magic to produce sound. This is but a toy in Kamio, but perhaps it is worth more here. Simply hold this to your ear and then listen. Once you do, the enchantment will let you hear the songs of my homeland. I will need more help later as our war continues. Please come visit me from time to time.

title: Translating The Unknown
objectives:
Find someone capable of deciphering the script on the parchment.
- [A Strange Parchment](A Strange Parchment)
description: The parchment is written in an unknown script that appears to be logographic. Judging by your surroundings, this building does not belong to any native culture to Tel'Abim. The calligraphy is elegant. The strokes for each character appears perfect. Seek out someone who may be able to decipher the script.
progress: Yes? What do you have there? It appears to be written in my language.
completion: Ah, so you need someone to translate this for you? Let me see it.

title: An Exile's Regret
objectives: Find a totem near the abandoned house in Tel'Abim.
description:
<Aneka furrows her brow for a moment as she reads.>

This is written by an exile of my people. A senshi that was afflicted by soul rot who fled the island trying to find a cure, she was filled with regret for abandoning her oath and home. It seems she was attempting a ritual to cure herself but evidently failed in doing so since you are here.

Soul rot is an affliction that happens when someone is tainted by the dark Kami. Evil beings that only seek to corrupt, twist and destroy, with the ultimate aim of stealing one's soul. Return where you found the parchment, and seek out a totem near the dwelling, you may receive further guidance there.
progress: The totem seems to beckon you further.
completion: As you stand before the totem, a voice touches your mind. It seems to call for help.

title: To Heal A Soul

fields.name: To Heal A Soul
fields.rewards: Kabuto of the Senshi or Kabuto of the Protector

objectives:
Gather the Senshi Bones from the Wave Crest Explorers, once collected, bring the bones to Aneka Konko at Ratchet.
-[Senshi Bones](Senshi Bones)
description:
<A female voice seems to penetrate through your mind.>

The beast seeks to end... everything that I am. As I prepared the ritual site after years of work, one of the naga slew me, and my bones were taken. Reclaim my bones, from the slithering foe, and find someone who can help me.
progress: You have returned...
completion:
The bones of one my kin you say, haunted by Kami? The thing we must do is burn the bones, and free the curse.

<Aneka Konko lights a small fire, burning the bones within them.> You have helped one of my kin, redeemed her in the eyes of the kami, cast aside her dishonor, and saved her soul. Her spirit is free to be reborn once more. Take this as a symbol of my gratitude.
notes:
-Upon completion**
  **Spirit of the Senshi says:** I am... free. The dark Kami's vile hold over me is gone. I can ill repay this debt stranger, I thank you from the deepest recess of my soul. You may use my house as you see fit. I shan't be needing it any longer. Goodbye, and farewell.

title: An Opportunity to Dig Deep
objectives:
Slay 8 Spiritual Wanderers, and collect 4 Ancient Troll Tablets for Archaeologist Trixia Goldspark at Tel Co. Bacecamp in Tel'Abim.
- [Spiritual Wanderer](Spiritual Wanderer) (8)
- [Ancient Troll Tablet](Ancient Troll Tablet) (4)
description:
Yo <race>, fancy seeing a capable adventurer out here! Interested in some work? You see, when Tel co. came here, this place was deserted. Just monkeys and bananas.

But that wasn't the case before, you know? Thousands of years ago, this island was a mountain range on the border of nations, and there's sure to be riches hidden here. To begin with, my surveyors have discovered some ancient Zandalari ruins on the northern coast dating back over ten thousand years.

The ruins are infested with the restless ghosts, as a muscle, go there and slay those ghosts, and bring any tablets and writing you find. I'll make it worth your time, promise, yeah?
progress: Well, how did it go?
completion: This is a nice haul and the ghosts are gone, yeah? I will order the crew to start diggin' once we make sure there's no further complications. Now let's see about these texts... Hmm, very fascinating! <race> I may need your assistance again.

title: Azotha Gold
objectives:
Dig around the ritual site and find the Azotha Ritual Cache for Archaeologist Trixia Goldspark at Tel Co. Basecamp in Tel'Abim.
- [Azotha Ritual Cache](Azotha Ritual Cache)
description:
Ten thousand years ago, the Zandalari were competing against a civilization known as the Azotha. Their struggle was put at an end when the world was shattered, and oceans swallowed a large chunk of the ancestral landmass. Tel'Abim just happens to be a region where the two clashed.

The Trolls seem to have lost the skirmish referenced on this tablet, and it mentions Trolls being sacrificed to the gods at the ritual site, their riches buried. This means there could be GOLD buried under this ritual site! And we may even have found it.

Head to the western-most isle of the Jagged isles and search for an obvious ritual site, when you find it, start digging!
progress: Well? Don't keep me in suspense, did ya do it?
completion: Hoo mama! This is what I'm talkin' about! This haul will earn us lots of prestige and accolades. This is both Azotha, Troll, and gold from other civilizations they must have buried here! You deserve your share for sure! We may work again in the future, you've certainly been useful!

title: Finding Bixxle!
objectives: Head to Bixxle's Storehouse in Northern Tel'Abim and report to Bixxle if he is still alive.
description:
We lost our communication with the Derelict Camp and Bixxle's Storehouse a few weeks ago. Bixxle's Storehouse was the key to profit for our northern harvesting. If we are ever to start up again, I need to know that the place isn't a wreck and covered in monkeys.

More importantly, Bixxle was a logistical mastermind, as much as his focus tends to drift towards engineering useless contraptions.

Head far to the north, to Bixxle's Storehouse, follow the road, it should take you right to it, see if Bixxle is alive.
progress: Yes?
completion: Huh, Telraz sent you? I was wondering when he would check in, I guess everything has gotten quite crazy around here after all!

title: A Report From Bixxle
objectives:
Bring Bixxle's Report to Baron Telraz at the Tel Co. Basecamp in Tel'Abim.
- [Bixxle's Report](Bixxle's Report) (provided)
description:
Well, here we are, still very much alive and kicking. We did have our fair share of encounters with the local wildlife.

I prepared a report to Baron Telraz, bring it back to Tel Co. Basecamp, it'll let him know we're still kicking up here, whenever he brings in the big guns to clean things up.
progress: So, have you heard news from Bixxle's Storehouse?
completion:
A report from Bixxle himself? Give me that!

<Baron Telraz frantically reads the letter with utmost curiosity, letting out a sigh of relief.>

My, that certainly is a relief! Without Bixxle, I would have no idea how to manage things up there. Thanks for the work kid. Here, take some coins for the hassle of running around.

title: The Mystery of Karazhan V
objectives:
Slay [Captain Rothynn](Captain Rothynn) to collect the Mark of Karazhan, and retrieve the Old Crypt Key from [Groundskeeper Jacoby](Groundskeeper Jacoby) for Magus Ariden Dusktower in Deadwind Pass.
- [Mark of Karazhan](Mark of Karazhan)
- [Old Crypt Key](Old Crypt Key)
description:
If Ansirem Runeweaver is correct, then Alarus must be stopped at all costs. To reforge the key to enter the crypt we will require a few items from the souls lingering within the ruins around Karazhan.

First, we will need a Mark of Karazhan, an object magically enchanted with the ley energy of the tower. It is said that the twins Andreon and Rothynn were both granted one upon being accepted into the tower guard. Whilst Andreon's whereabouts are unknown, Rothynn's spirit still haunts the caverns of the Master's Cellar.

Finally, there is Groundskeeper Jacoby, one who still to this day lives and tends to the grounds. A man who only appears when not a living soul is looking, only to flee and hide when the living linger. It is from him that the key itself will be collected, so hunt him down.

When everything is collected, I can begin to infuse the key with the power it once held, to allow access to the Karazhan Crypt.
progress: If we are to enter the Karazhan Crypt, then we must take action, I suggest you find some friends to help, for our foes may be quite strong.
completion:
<Magus Ariden Dusktower would look over the items, and let out a breath of relief>.

Perhaps there is a hope after all, you have done well, now, let us begin.
notes: Both of the NPCs are found in the [Master's Cellar](Master's Cellar) in the ruined homes just before the tower entrance, with each of the NPCs on opposite ends of the area from one another. [Groundskeeper Jacoby](Groundskeeper Jacoby) can be found at the very end of the wine cellar's right-most passage, whereas [Captain Rothynn](Captain Rothynn) haunts the underground caves beneath the collapsed cellar. You can skip some of the mobs in the caves by hugging the left wall and then dropping down into a small crevasse in the floor and continuing along the way again, keeping to the left.

title: The Rebellion
objectives:
Listen to the tale of Darius Ravenwood.
- Listen to the tale of Darius Ravenwood
description:
Welcome to the remnants of Gilneas.

What lies before your eyes may not match the grandeur and splendor you envisioned. This once-mighty bastion of human power now stands as a testament to the relentless march of time and the ravages of war. We, too, have succumbed to the fate that has befallen much of the world.

Take a moment and lend an ear to the tale of an old knight.
progress: The situation in Gilneas is dire.
completion: So now you know. I left many details out, but there's no time for chatting. We must act now, with the newfound strength of our allies.
notes:
-Speaking with Darius**

  Gilneas has seen darker days. But with newfound allies, such as you, hope remains. I feared the Alliance would've abandoned us, but here we stand. I will bend no knee to these Alteraci scum.

  We will prevail.

  > Gossip: *Debrief me on the situation in Gilneas.*

  I'll try to keep things short.

  Genn Greymane sought to shield Gilneas from the troubles that plagued the rest of the world. He firmly believed that we possessed the strength and resilience to stand alone, that the outside world brought nothing but strife. And for a time, it seemed he was right. Soon after the completion of the formidable Greymane Wall, the dread Scourge descended upon the North, leaving only desolation and ruins in its wake.

  However, isolation came with its own trials. Food became scarce, trade collapsed, and the Scourge and worgen began to infiltrate our lands. Despite these hardships, King Greymane remained steadfast, refusing to open our gates. This stubbornness only deepened the divide between the king, his nobles, and his people.

  > Gossip: *<Continue>*

  He grew increasingly isolated, ensconced within the confines of his own family. And then came the Harlows, Alteraci scum who had found refuge within our walls. Whispering poison into Genn's ears, they further isolated him from his loyal nobles and common folk.

  To preserve what scarce resources remained, many nobles, including myself, had our lands and possessions seized for redistribution. It was a painful blow, for I had been a vocal opponent of the king's decision. Stripped of my holdings, I was left with nothing but the fire of righteous indignation burning within me.

  Throughout this turmoil, Genn's unwavering love for his wife, Mia, provided a semblance of sanity. At her behest, he emerged from seclusion, organizing a public event to distribute food and clothing to the Gilnean populace. Regrettably, the meager resources quickly dwindled, leading to a confrontation between the common folk and the guards. In the ensuing chaos, Mia tragically lost her life.

  > Gossip: *<Continue>*

  Devastated, Genn withdrew to the confines of his mansion, retreating from public view. The Harlow family seized power as regents, ushering in a reign of tyranny over Gilneas. Falsely accused of Mia's murder, I had no choice but to rally the support of the commonfolk and rise up against the oppressive regime.

  In my heart, I know Genn is no longer among the living. Even in his compromised state, he would never have allowed such injustices to prevail. As we forge ahead in this rebellion, we strive to restore justice and bring about the liberation of Gilneas from the clutches of tyranny.

  > Gossip: *I see.*

title: The Balance of Power
objectives: Find and speak with Mally O'Flor to decipher the relationship between Kul Tiras and the Alliance on behalf of Thrall.
description:
It has been a long time since we did battle with the Kul Tiran's in such a manner. Tiragarde never really posed such a major threat, but the news coming to my hall is worrying.

Lieutenant Alverold is the one who leads their Expedition Fleet, and it is he I wish to direct my attention. In the past, Admiral Proudmoore was not willing to discuss in terms of diplomacy, and I do not think his loyal Lieutenant will either.

My concern is not with these foreigners, but with the Alliance, for I do not know their standing with Kul Tiras, the last I heard an embassy opened in Stormwind. The last thing we want is an all out war between our factions.

I must know more before I directly engage and I would trust you to speak with an agent in Ratchet that goes by the name 'Mally O'Flor', he is a human.
progress: What can I do for you?
completion:
So, he sent you?

I see.

title: The Fall and Rise of Greymane

fields.name: The Fall and Rise of Greymane
fields.rewards: Ravenshire Tabard, Choice of:, Ravenwood Belt,, Signet of Gilneas, or, Ravenshire Gloves

objectives:
'Save' Genn, and recover the Greymane Crown for Lord Darius Ravenwood at Ravenshire in Gilneas.
- [The Greymane Crown](The Greymane Crown)
description:
The entirety of Gilneas stands at our side! The tyranny of the royalists can no longer be allowed to stand! If this nation is to ever recover from the darkness, then we must hold fast, and strike even faster still!

The Greymane Crown must be recovered if our dream is ever to be realized. Enter Gilneas City. Fight your way through his most loyal soldiers. End the Harlows, and reclaim the Greymane birthright. A new king and a new beginning awaits us, <name>.
progress: Be brave adventurer, the city itself has struggled through civil strife as we have.
completion:
The end of an era is upon us. A darkness has been lifted on this day, and with it, a new hope emerges from the clouds. A ray of light for all to see. Liam Greymane shall be named king and his reign shall bring prosperity to the people who have suffered for so long!

<His eyes shine with hope, for perhaps the first time in a generation.>
notes:
-Upon completion**
  **Lord Darius Ravenwood yells:** Tyranny has been defeated this day! Our land has been freed from the evil that has corrupted our forests, and murdered countless innocents. A new king has been crowned, glory to Gilneas!

title: Report to Livia Strongarm
objectives: Seek out [Livia Strongarm](Livia Strongarm) at [Blackthorn's Camp](Blackthorn's Camp) in [Gilneas](Gilneas).
description:
Livia has been part of this outfit since the very beginning. If she judges you worthy, then so will I.

I have given her a task of the utmost importance. Go assist her.
progress: Ah, it's you.
completion: Listen up kid: I never wanted to set eyes nor foot upon the land of fancy pantsy Gilneans, not even to rob it. You want to earn my appreciation? Then help me complete this task from the boss so we can finish down here and leave this wretched place.

title: To Gilneas

fields.name: To Gilneas
fields.next: Report to Livia Strongarm, Report to Luke Agamand

objectives: Seek out [Blackthorn](Blackthorn) at [Blackthorn's Camp](Blackthorn's Camp) in [Gilneas](Gilneas).
description:
The Dark Lady has a task for a capable <class> such as yourself that would benefit the interests of the Horde.

One of the Banshee Queen's agents has been sent to Gilneas in order to survey the situation, acquire assets for the Horde, and evaluate whether the area is suitable for exploitation by the Forsaken.

The Greymane Wall was recently breached and the nation it once protected is in chaos, granting us access and an opportunity. Follow the road south into Gilneas, circle around the city, and you will find a camp by the western shore occupied by Blackthorn.

You may be surprised by the nature of his followers, but rest assured that he and his minions are devoted in their service to the Horde and the Dark Lady. Report to him and he will make good use of you.
progress: And you are?
completion:
I see that the Dark Lady has sent someone to assist us. I may look human, but do not let appearances deceive you.

I am fully committed to the Horde, as my loyalty lies with the Banshee Queen. If you are here to assist, I shall put you to work.

Help my subordinates, then I will have further instructions for you.

title: Report to Luke Agamand
objectives: Speak with [Luke Agamand](Luke Agamand) at [Blackthorn's Camp](Blackthorn's Camp) in [Gilneas](Gilneas).
description:
Luke Agamand was always the outcast among his family. Disowned and banished, he found his way into my notice and joined our crew.

His old home was one of his first raids. I have entrusted a task to him personally, and you will ensure that he succeeds.
progress: Well, hello there.
completion:
The boss wants you to help me? I hope you're a capable <class> and not some diplomatic noodle.

What you're about to do will take some guts.

title: Heist in Dryrock Mine
objectives:
Gather 16 Sacks of Mithril Ore from [Dryrock Mine](Dryrock Mine) for [Luke Agamand](Luke Agamand) in [Blackthorn's Camp](Blackthorn's Camp).
- Sack of Mithril Ore (16)
description:
There is a mine up in the hills, Dryrock Mine I believe the locals call it, responsible for providing the Gilnean army with Mithril ore. The boss believes this Mithril is far better suited to supply the Horde, wouldn't you agree?

Travel up to the mine, kill anyone who tries to stand in your way, and acquire 16 Sacks of Mithril Ore. Return to me when you've finished the job.
progress: Did you get the ore?
completion: Well I'll be damned. You actually went and pulled it off! The boss will ensure this Mithril gets where it's most needed. I'd say you've proven your worth, kid. Here's your cut.

title: Rendezvous with the Infiltrator
objectives:
Travel to the [Ruins of Greyshire](Ruins of Greyshire), locate [Greta Longpike](Greta Longpike), and acquire the [Sealed Report](Sealed Report to Livia) for [Livia Strongarm](Livia Strongarm) at [Blackthorn's Camp](Blackthorn's Camp) in [Gilneas](Gilneas).
- [Sealed Report to Livia](Sealed Report to Livia)
description:
Our intelligence on this region is poor. We knew Gilneas was an isolationist nation, but we did not expect it to be in such a miserable state.

Being among the living, we have no trouble blending in to conduct espionage. One of ours has assumed the name "Greta Longpike", who in her last missive reported she had infiltrated a settlement named Greyshire.

Seek her out and tell her "Night Lady, gold in mouth at dawn". That is the code phrase. She will give you a report, the details of which are of vital importance, that you are to bring back to me.
progress: You return. You had better have that report in hand.
completion: Gilneas appears to be in open rebellion. One side is led by Prince Liam Greymane and a certain Ravenwood, while the other side is led by corrupt Gilnean nobles. The boss will want to hear about this. You have done well. This task couldn't have been easy, but as a member of the Horde, you have proven yourself capable with this flawless execution.
notes:
-Speaking with Greta Longpike**
Well, this is a fine day here in Gilneas, isn't it? Take care if you leave town, alright?

  > Gossip: *Night lady, gold in mouth at dawn.*

  I didn't expect Livia to send a member of the Horde. What was she thinking?

  Whatever. Make sure this sealed report gets to her.

  > Gossip: *Goodbye.*

  > Gossip: *Long Blizzard, ice dew at dawn.*

  What are you talking about? Don't make me call the guards!

  > Gossip: *Goodbye.*

  > Gossip: *Sun Lady, silver in ear at night.*

  What are you talking about? Don't make me call the guards!

  > Gossip: *Goodbye.*

  > Gossip: *Goodbye.*

title: Quality Time with Blackthorn

fields.name: Quality Time with Blackthorn
fields.previous: Heist in Dryrock Mine, Rendezvous with the Infiltrator

objectives:
Slay 8 Spitecrest Netters for Blackthorn at Blackthorn's Camp in Gilneas.
- [Spitecrest Netter](Spitecrest Netter) slain (8)
description:
You may wonder why a gaggle of humans are working with the Horde. The answer to that question lies in the Civil War in the Plaguelands, when we Forsaken first gained liberty...

Yes, we Forsaken. You see, I am a banshee currently possessing Blackthorn, and I have convinced his band of cutthroats to fight for us. Rest assured, I am not alone in this endeavor.

If you wish to know more, then you will need to earn my trust. Some of those naga creatures have been encroaching upon the camp from the beach. Slaughter them and we will resume our conversation upon your triumphant return.
progress: Shall we continue the tale?
completion:
You have done well.

Following the victory of the Forsaken, those who possessed a body during the conflict were sent out as the Dark Lady's eyes and ears. My group is usually sent to spy upon the Alliance as we are suited for blending in among humans.

I have come to grow fond of my comrades in this group. They lacked discipline and purpose once, but are now skilled infiltrators and spies.

title: Genn Greymane Must Die!

fields.name: Genn Greymane Must Die!
fields.rewards: Choice of:, Blackthorn Gauntlets,, Banshee's Tear, or, Dark Footpad Belt

objectives:
Enter [Gilneas City](Gilneas City) and slay [Genn Greymane](Genn Greymane), then bring his head to [Blackthorn](Blackthorn) at [Blackthorn's Camp](Blackthorn's Camp) in [Gilneas](Gilneas).
- [Genn Greymane's Head](Genn Greymane's Head)
description:
Storytime is over. The time to act is at hand. I have read the report you retrieved from Livia, and I have decided how best to proceed.

King Genn Greymane was ever a force to be reckoned with in the old Alliance of Lordaeron. His strength and shrewdness were only matched by his stubbornness and pride. He cannot be allowed a to wrest control over his crumbling kingdom once more.

Venture into his city with as many comrades as you can find and bring me his head.
progress: The King of Gilneas was once a force to be reckoned with. Though his power and grip over the kingdom has diminished, he will be no easy prey.
completion:
Wonderful! You have proven yourself a capable agent of the Dark Lady.

Though your tale of what happened in the city troubles me... If Genn Greymane was truly behind the rebellion, we may have inadvertently aided our enemies. That, however, is neither your fault nor your concern.

We will take it from here. You are dismissed.

title: An Audience With the Prince
objectives: Listen to the conversation between Grand Magister Rommath and Kael'thas.
description: I will now open a portal to Outland. Brace yourself. You might feel a slight pull, try not to fall down.
progress: My Prince...
completion: So you see now. Every day, I hear our people label him a traitor, a coward. Yet, I am bound to fulfill his wishes. I do not comprehend his intentions, but I hold steadfast in my belief in him. I only wish more of our people could perceive it in the same light.
notes:
**Grand Magister Rommath says:** Aseph-ah-balla nah!
  *[Image of Kael'thas](Image of Kael'thas) appears.*
  **Image of Kael'thas says:** Rommath, my faithful servant. It has been too long since we last spoke.
  **Grand Magister Rommath says:** My Prince. I am relieved to see you alive and well. I have much to report...
  **Image of Kael'thas says:** Yet, I have little time. Are my people well?
  **Grand Magister Rommath says:** Yes, my Prince. Yet, many wither, as we are unable to sate our addiction. Also, the [Regency Council](Regency Council) is torn...
  **Image of Kael'thas says:** Do not bore me with politics, Rommath. I care little about it. Soon, our people will hunger no more. I will see to it.
  **Grand Magister Rommath says:** When, my Prince? Many believe that you have forsaken us. They call you a traitor, I can no longer bear the insults...
  **Image of Kael'thas says:** Soon, Rommath. Maintain silence for now. Until my return, it is better that they forget about me. They cannot afford to be dependent on a mere idea; they require tangible solutions. Do not sow false hope among our people. I will only return when I have discovered the path to our salvation.
  **Grand Magister Rommath says:** I understand. We await your return.
  **Image of Kael'thas says:** And I cannot wait to be with me people once more. It won't be long, I promise.
  **Grand Magister Rommath says:** May you always remember the Light of the Sunwell, my Prince.
  *Image of Kael'thas disappears.*

title: The Tower of Lapidis II
objectives: Bring the Shimmering Brass Key to Archmage Ansirem Runeweaver in Dalaran.
description:
Arch Hydromancer Lapidis held incredible skill in hydromancy and was much stronger than many, even within Boralus. Many had their opinions on how the man was able to achieve such power, though I always gave him the benefit of the doubt. I believe he has had some assistance from either a magical artifact or an outside force, though I cannot prove my suspicions.

Regardless, if there is a way in the tower, I would believe it to be this key. <Hydromancer Flakereef produces a small Shimmering Brass Key>.

This key was given to me by Lapidis before we had arrived. He entrusted it within my care, and I was to be one of his pupils. However, after he created his imposing tower and began to close himself off, I instead returned here. This key fits the lock to his domain, but cannot open it. Perhaps it requires some magical attuning to grant access.

We must look to those with a greater knowledge of the Arcana. Archmage Ansirem Runeweaver of Dalaran could help. Seek him out.
progress: What brings you to Dalaran?
completion: Hydromancer Lapidis, I have heard the name from before the horrific Third War. He was spoken as one of the most powerful of his kind. He refused to give us a lesson within Dalaran of his great magics, or to at the least, show us how it was done.

title: The Tower of Lapidis III
objectives:
Gather a Pure Aqua Orb from Water Elementals in [Feralas](Feralas), and bring it to Archmage Ansirem Runeweaver.
- [Pure Aqua Orb](Pure Aqua Orb): 0/1
description:
Lapidis was always an interesting, if strange, man. At the time, we hadn't considered his refusal to our curiosity as something potentially bad, but hearing of what he has done upon Lapidis Isle has certainly shifted my opinion.

<Ansirem Runeweaver studies the Shimmering Brass Key>. It would appear that this key still has lingering magic within it. It is possible to reconstruct the enchantment, but may take considerable power and reagents to do so. If the key is to work upon the lock as suggested, it will need to be both attuned and enchanted to the magic that once powered it.

It is within my capability to enchant this key with the same magic that once powered it. A Pure Aqua Orb from a water elemental along the coast of Feralas should be sufficient and powerful enough to mimic the key's enchantment.
progress: Has the orb been obtained?
completion: Excellent work, with this orb I can begin to work with the magic of this key to replicate some of the traces that are present.

title: Fate Of The Harborage
objectives:
Alert Sanv K'la of the imminent danger.
- [Sanv Tas'dal](Sanv Tas'dal) slain
description: Quickly, rush to the Harborage and warn Sanv K'la! If we do not evacuate all in time, who knows what horrible tragedy will befall us! I will attempt to contact Master Akh Z'ador in the meantime, hopefully he can aid us sooner than anticipated. <race>, I place all my hopes on you. Perhaps there is still time.
progress: <name>, you are restless. Tell me, could you find Akh Z'ador?
completion:
I am devastated. Not even in the wildest of dreams could I have imagined this to happen. Sanv Tas'dal, once my mentor as chieftain and noble leader of our tribe, succumbing to the sweet lies of the Burning Legion. If it wasn't for you and Akh Z'ador, then my people and I would have followed him back to Draenor, to live the rest of our lives as drones for the Legion's machinations.

The Harborage is forever in your debt. Words cannot express how heavy my gratitude towards your selflessness lies, so please: Take this symbol of appreciation from all draenei of this humble sanctuary.
notes:
-Talking to Sanv K'la**
You are out of breath, what has happened?

  > Gossip: <Kas'tal sends me, he fears for the safety of your people!>

  **Sanv K'la says:** I do not understand, what do you...?
  *[Sanv Tas'dal](Sanv Tas'dal) appears. The Draenei Exiles start running in fear.*
  **Draenei Exile says:** They have returned! Run for your lives!
  **Sanv Tas'dal says:** Sanv K'la. After years of searching for you and the other lost sheep of mine, you finally reveal yourself.
  **Sanv Tas'dal says:** Your need for pitiful hiding is over, my brethren. For I have secured us a safe haven in our homeworld, the place you should all return to.
  **Sanv Tas'dal says:** Join me, as I can give you whatever you desire. Yet, most importantly, I can give you a purpose; a purpose greater than anything you could possibly fathom!
  **Sanv Tas'dal says:** Anyone eager to follow me back into the fulfilling embrace of our saviors, come forth! And those who wish to defy me...
  **Sanv Tas'dal says:** Prepare to be cast into the endless oblivion of the Twisting Nether!

-At 50%:*
  **Sanv Tas'dal yells:** You feeble races. Your defiance is laughable in the face of certain death. Perish, and let your bodies pave the way for the enlightened!
  **Akh Z'ador yells:** Friends of the Harborage! Stay vigilant! Assist me in banishing this foul specter from our new home. The corrupt and demonic have no place here!
  **Sanv Tas'dal yells:** Impertinent fool! Your pathetic display of magic won't change a thing! Your fate is already sealed!

-After killing Sanv Tas'dal's projection:*
  **Sanv Tas'dal yells:** No! This will not be the end, there is nowhere to hide for you anymore!
  **Akh Z'ador yells:** The evil shadow of my former master is cast into the void again. Friends, speak with Sanv K'la, while I regain my strength.

title: The Tower of Lapidis IV
objectives: Wait for Archmage Ansirem Runeweaver to finish his magic.
description: Now, to begin, I will transmute some of the energy from the Pure Aqua Orb and enchant the key with the magic that once was present. This may take a few moments to do, and I require precise concentration. Give me but a moment, and I will be done.
progress: I think I've done it.
completion: There... It is done, the key has had its magical properties manipulated, and should contain similar enchantment.
notes:
Archmage Ansirem Runeweaver will begin channeling magic. After a moment, he will finish.
-**Archmage Ansirem Runeweaver says:** That certainly was challenging, but I have finished my work, the key should be enchanted.

title: The Tower of Lapidis V
objectives: Return the Enchanted Brass Key to Hydromancer Flakereef.
description: With the key enchanted, one piece of the puzzle has been put into place. I however, do not possess the skillset able to give this key an attunement of that who created it. The power that once attuned this key is incredibly potent and complex, and will need someone of greater skill than I to do this. You may return the key to Hydromancer Flakereef, perhaps he may know of another.
progress: Have you learned anything new about the key?
completion: Hmm. So there is still more to be done, who knew that Lapidis had such potent magic that not even Dalaran could crack it. There must be some other way.

title: The Tower of Lapidis (quest)
objectives: Speak with Hydromancer Flakereef in Caelan's Rest.
description:
The Tower of Lapidis looms over us like a great evil that could destroy us at any minute. When we first arrived upon this island, the Arch Hydromancer Lapidis set to constructing a tower with the help of some of our workers and his own elementals of water. With his great power, the tower was constructed much before the town of Caelan's Rest had gotten its footing.

With his power, he gained an alliance with both the trolls of Zul'Hazu and the ogres of the Gordosh Heights. He has been working against us since then. He has not spoken with us since the tower has been erected, hidden away behind powerful water elementals and a sealed magical door.

If there is ever to be a hope for us, the Arch Hydromancer Lapidis must be slain. Flakereef was a fellow Hydromancer and worked beneath Lapidis. If there is anyone who knows where to begin, it will be him.
progress: Oh, yes, has the Colonel sent you?
completion: So, we are finally doing something about Lapidis. It will be a tough task, given how powerful the man is.

title: The Tower of Lapidis VI
objectives: Find Magus Valgon on Lapidis isle, and inquire about the Enchanted Brass Key.
description:
I hadn't imagined Lapidis could harness such power, even into such a small object such as this key. Perhaps there is someone else that could be of assistance. The fleet had a Magus with us when we first began to establish Caelan's Rest. Shortly after he departed in search of a latent, powerful magic that emanated from the island.

When he returned he spoke of a great hermit that was beyond his own power, and that of others he seen in his lifetime. He ventured out once more to learn from this figure, and to study out in the island. If there is something that can be done, perhaps Magus Valgon can help us get the answer. You should be able to find him somewhere on this island, I would imagine he has a camp somewhere.
progress: Flakereef sent you? I haven't spoken with him in quite a while now.
completion: So, they are looking into Lapidis, it is about time. The man was always a shady figure, one who hid most of his studies and his work, and no doubt had nefarious purpose. I would suspect he is the reason we are all here.

title: The Tower of Lapidis VII
objectives: Travel to Kazon Island and speak with the troll hermit Insom'ni.
description:
<After studying the Enchanted Brass Key it would appear that Magus Valgon is stumped>.

I do not think I can assist with this, friend, the complexities of the magic may take many weeks to begin to crack, and I think you do not have such time to wait.

I do know one who knows a great deal of magic, hidden away from the world. There is a hermit that remains somewhat hidden upon the island of Kazon, nestled in between Gillijim and Lapidis Isle.

Go there, and find Insom'ni, he is a powerful troll, much more powerful than any I have met.

If there is anyone who could attune this key, it would be him.
progress: What do you need from me, adventurer?
completion: Magus Valgon sent you, interesting, let me have a look then and I will see what I can do.

title: The Tower of Lapidis VIII
objectives:
Obtain Pethax's Horn for Insom'ni on Kazon Island.
- [Pethax's Horn](Pethax's Horn): 0/1
description:
<It would only take a single glance at the key with inquisitive eyes for the troll to crack a small smirk>.

I can do this, though I must wonder why I would help you, especially for free.

If you want me to work the magic of this key, and attune it for you, I will need a favor from you. There is a satyr of whom I knew a long time ago, one who still walks this world today. Let us say that me and him are not on the best of standing and I want you to bring me one of his gnarled horns from his battered corpse.

Travel to Felwood, to the Ruins of Constellas, you will find Pethax Blackhorn there, it is his horn I desire.
progress: Have you found that blackhearted mongrel yet?
completion:
<The troll looks almost filled with glee.>

You have done well, this wretch had much worse coming to him, but this shall do, especially given my current state. Fine, give me that key, I will do as you asked, my word is my bond.

title: The Tower of Lapidis IX
objectives:
Wait for Insom'ni to attune the Enchanted Brass Key, once the key is attuned, return it to Hydromancer Flakereef in Caelan's Rest.
- [Attuned Brass Key](Attuned Brass Key) (provided)
description:
Now, I will do what I can to restore the attunement to this key. It shouldn't be that difficult, the magi who left the magic did a poor job with leaving magical traces upon it.

Step back, I will do as you asked, it shouldn't take long. When I am done, you may return to the one who sent you.
progress: How have you fared? Have you gotten any answers about the key?
completion: Now that the key is attuned, and enchanted, we can begin our planning to destroy Hydromancer Lapidis.
notes:
Insom'ni will begin channeling magic. After a moment, he will finish.
  **Insom'ni says:** There, it is done. The key is attuned. Do with it what you must. I hope that it serves you well for whatever purpose you are using it.

title: The Tower of Lapidis X

fields.name: The Tower of Lapidis X
fields.rewards: Choice of:, Kul Tiras Marine Helmet,, Hydromancer's Peak, or, Sailor's Headband

objectives:
Venture into The Tower of Lapidis, slay Arch Hydromancer Lapidis, and return his head to Colonel Hardinus in Caelan's Rest. 
- [Head of Lapidis](Head of Lapidis)
description:
The Tower of Lapidis will not be an easy task to conquer, even with this key, this is only the entryway into the gates of hell. You must steel yourself for what is to come, Lapidis has been able to ally himself with the most unlikely friends for a reason. He is a powerful man, and extremely skilled in magic, not to mention surrounded by minions of his own conjuring.

If you are to conquer The Tower of Lapidis you will need a band of fellow adventurers. Plan for the mission ahead and slay Arch Hydromancer Lapidis for all of his lies, his deceit, and his crimes against Kul Tiras. If you succeed, bring his head to Colonel Hardinus, he would be the most eager to reward such heroic actions.
progress: Hello again <name>, what can I do for you?
completion:
This... This is the head of Lapidis! It is done, his horror has ceased?!

What you have done here is truly heroic, truly worthy of legend. You have assured our survival upon this island, and triumphed over a great evil, a great evil that would have surely been our downfall. Kul Tiras and the Anchor have been given justice, for all of the crimes this man has caused against our people.

Please, as a token of our gratitude, and in Caelan's name, have a just reward.
notes:
-Upon completion**
  **Colonel Hardinus says:** It is done, the tyranny of Lapidis has come to an end! Admiral Caelan's soul is put to rest, cheers to <name> for their heroic actions!

title: The Warchief's Orders
objectives: Speak with Thrall in Orgrimmar about the Kul Tiran threat.
description:
You have made glorious battle upon our enemies, <name>.

The Horde honors those who bear our banner so proudly. For your might, I bestow upon you this commendation. Wear it well, for your next task will take you to our great Orgrimmar.

In the Valley of Wisdom, our Warchief waits for tidings of the ongoing Kul Tiran conflict. Tell him all you have done and all you have learned.
progress: Lok-regar no'gal, <race>. I bid you welcome.
completion:
I see you carry Dar'nakk's commendation. I've never known him to grant such accolades freely.

You did well in defending our coasts, and for that the Horde owes you its gratitude.

title: A Favor for Mally
objectives:
Gather 3 Vials of Sunscale Blood for Mally O'Flor at Ratchet in the Barrens for the information Thrall seeks. 
- [Vial of Sunscale Blood](Vial of Sunscale Blood) (3)
description:
So, Thrall sent you huh?

Interesting, I was sent here to replace another, but I never expected to be contacted. The last two before me were never spoken to in regard to anything.

I work for an organization that has deep ties with Stormwind and has its eyes all over the world, so to say.

I will share the information I hold, but I need a favor from you and your kin beforehand. I am here for another purpose, one I need completed in short time, but do not fret, it is within the region.

In the Barrens can be found a very specific type of raptor, Sunscale. Some of our agents have been looking to gather vials of their blood. Three in total for archival purposes.

Gather me those vials, and the information is yours.
progress: Have you had any progress?
completion:
<Mally O'Flor would take careful time analyzing the blood.>

You honor your word, and so I shall honor mine.

title: Information for Thrall
objectives:
Listen to Mally O'Flor tell his information, when complete, bring the news to Thrall in Orgrimmar. 
- Bring the news to Thrall in Orgrimmar
description:
I have stashed away the Vials, and am ready to speak, should you be prepared to listen.

When you are ready, speak with me, and I will tell you what it is I know.
progress: Have you had any progress?
completion:
It is always useful to have information, it helps one not step on their own feet.

Do not forget that <name>.

You've done well, and now we can act without worry.
notes:
-Talking to Mally O'Flor**
Watch yourself buddy.

What do you want?

  > Gossip: I am ready to hear your information Mally.

  **Mally O'Flor says:** A few weeks ago Kul Tiras was allowed embassy within the city of Stormwind, given by Bolvar Fordragon in an attempt to improve diplomacy between the two nations.
  **Mally O'Flor says:** While things seem to be going fairly well, it is quite obvious to many that Kul Tiras is still very stubborn on their ideals and traditions, their sanctity of honor, and respect for the fallen is on par with many of the most noble paladin.
  **Mally O'Flor says:** As of current, there has been no consensus, Stormwind is not looking to be dragged into a war without good reason. I am under good authority and good information to inform of no cooperation between Kul Tiras, and the Alliance in this matter. This 'invasion' you are facing is, by our eyes, up to Thrall to handle as he sees fit.
  **Mally O'Flor says:** The SI:7 has given me clear authority to pass along this information for the better interest of both parties. Bring this to your leader, and let him know.

title: A War Worth Fighting
objectives: Report back to Warbringer Dar'nakk in Razor Hill.
description:
There are few things I loathe more than needless war, <name>. It might be an irony to you, for the title I bear, but I saw what horrors wake in men and women when ashes and bloodshed are all that is left of their lives.

I led my people to Kalimdor because I wished to give our children a better world to grow into. I believe that world is still within reach: Woe betide anyone that would threaten it!

I have sent envoys to treat peace with Alverold, to make him see sense. Return to Dar'nakk, and if Alverold refuses... it can only be victory or death.
progress: You return, and not a moment too soon.
completion:
I advised the Warchief against the sending of envoys. It was no use with a man like Alverold.

Our men were cowardly assailed under the flag of peace. Those treacherous Kul Tirans tied them to stakes, soaked them in tar and burned them alive on the shore.

Now we hold nothing back, now we put an end to them!

title: Cutting Ranks
objectives:
Slay 10 Expedition Officers, Hydromancer Shaleborn, and Deckmaster Darkhollow for Warbringer Dar'nakk in Razor Hill. 
- [Expedition Officer](Expedition Officer) (10)
- [Hydromancer Shaleborn](Hydromancer Shaleborn)
- [Deckmaster Darkhollow](Deckmaster Darkhollow)
description:
If we wish to utterly dismantle the Expedition Fleet, then we must crush the head of the snake: Captains, commanders, officers and other figures of interest. The Shattered Hand Clan was kind enough to provide me with a list of their names.

Go to Anchor's Edge, south of the Echo Isles in southeastern Durotar.

Once you arrive, you must look for and kill Hydromancer Shaleborn and Deckmaster Darkhollow, along with any breathing officer on the isle .

Their whole leadership shall crumble!
progress:
It must be done, their leaders must die. They, more than the luckless footsoldiers they throw at us, are at fault for the persecution of our people.

Do not forget it.
completion:
It is done, then. With their chain of command gone, it might take months for their expedition to re-organize.

We shall not give them such a luxury.
notes:
-Upon accepting this quest and [quest: Anchor's End]**

  **Warbringer Dar'nakk says:** Baha! A true soldier of the Horde! One of grit and steel — those Kul Tirans are no match for you!

title: Anchor's End
objectives:
Slay 8 Expedition Sailors, 6 Expedition Clerics, and 10 Expedition Soldiers for Warbringer Dar'nakk in Razor Hill. 
- [Expedition Sailor](Expedition Sailor) (8)
- [Expedition Cleric](Expedition Cleric) (6)
- [Expedition Soldier](Expedition Soldier) (10)
description:
There is an island south of the Echo Isles the pinkskins have come to call Anchor's Edge.

The time for planning and talking is over.

Travel to Anchor's Edge with as many comrades as you can find and kill every Kul Tiran armed with either blade or spell. Take the rest prisoner. That is my command!

GO FORTH FOR THE HORDE, FOR BLOOD AND THUNDER!
progress: Have they been overcome, have they been destroyed?!
completion:
If my duties did not keep me here, I would have gladly joined you in the thrill of battle.

You have delivered the Warchief's reckoning to our enemies. For that, the whole Horde shall sing your praise.
notes:
-Upon accepting this quest and [quest: Cutting Ranks]**

  **Warbringer Dar'nakk says:** Baha! A true soldier of the Horde! One of grit and steel — those Kul Tirans are no match for you!

title: Lieutenant Alverold (quest)
objectives:
Slay Sir Danuvis and bring the Head of Alverold to Warbringer Dar'nakk in Razor Hill. 
- [Sir Danuvis](Sir Danuvis)
- [Head of Alverold](Head of Alverold)
description:
You have bested their warriors, killed their champions, breached the heart of their stronghold.

Only one deed remains to be done: Alverold himself must follow Daelin Proudmoore to the grave.

He is likely to be hiding in the most fortified structure on Anchor's Edge, guarded by a paladin knight known as Danuvis.

End them both, then return to me with Alverold's head.
progress: I have not forgotten Alverold's heinous pyres. Give him and the last of his expedition what they deserve!
completion:
<Dar'nakk holds the head of Alverold aloft.>

Here you are, pinkskin. Burn in your hell, knowing it was the Horde who vanquished you.

We orcs are here to stay, you make sure you remember that when you bring my regards to Daelin!

<Dar'nakk looks back to you.>

Now, you and I shall have a talk.

title: A Hero's Reward

fields.name: A Hero's Reward
fields.rewards: Band of Durotar, Signet of Durotar, Ring of Durotar

objectives: Speak with Thrall in Orgrimmar and claim your reward.
description:
Your dedication to the Horde and your courage in battle are both beyond question.

You have earned one of the highest honors Orgrimmar can bestow: A Lok'tra shall be composed of your victory at Anchor's Edge, forevermore to be sung by our people in memory of what transpired there.

But that cannot be your only reward.

The Warchief wishes to see you again — he is known to be generous to his loyal warriors.
progress: Here you are. Hail, <name>!
completion:
I feel sorrow in having to be forced to violence a second time in so few years.

But I feel no shame in ordering the deaths of our enemies when our sovereignty is infringed. A war in the defense of our people is a just war.

Take pride in your bravery, <name>! For I now name you Champion of the Horde and give you this mighty signet as recognition of your triumphs! Bear it with honor!

title: A Letter from the Royalty
objectives: Bring the Feltouched Letter to [Commander Anarileth](Commander Anarileth).
description:
I trust this letter finds you in good health. It is with a heavy heart that I bring to your attention a matter of utmost importance. Intelligence has been gathered, suggesting that the dissidents from Alah'thalas are in the preparatory stages of a movement against us.

While our agents are vigilant in the city, it is imperative that you maintain a watchful eye over the refugees situated in [Brinthilien](Brinthilien). Exercise utmost caution and restraint, refraining from any provocation or direct confrontation with the individuals in question. 

I urge you to remain unseen in your observations, acting with discretion and prudence. Your commitment to this task is crucial in safeguarding the welfare of our people and the integrity of our cause. 

With unwavering trust in your capabilities,

Viceroy [Eldin Sunstrider](Eldin Sunstrider).
progress: Yes?
completion:
So, this missive was recovered from the commander's remains?

The contents are disquieting, and it is imperative that this letter reaches the [Regency Council](Regency Council) in [Alah'Thalas](Alah'Thalas) without delay. The mention of spies infiltrating our ranks within the city is a matter of grave concern.

title: Smashing the Southsea!
objectives:
Gather 20 Southsea Sashes from Southsea Pirates for Colonel Hardinus in Caelan's Rest.
- [Southsea Sash](Southsea Sash) (20)
description:
The Southsea Pirates are a direct threat to our survival on this island. Their operations here are much larger than we had first anticipated when we set out. They still have many powerful vessels, and whilst they haven't attempted to sail them in front of our town, the possibility is still real.

Kul Tiras has always been at war with piracy. Those that threaten the merchants are a direct threat to our kingdom. I need you to claim the sashes of the Southsea Freebooters, a pirate gang that operates in a vast area. You can find them across both large islands and along the sandbar named after them to the southwest of here, off the coast of Lapidis.

As proof of your deeds, bring me twenty of the sashes that they wear. Your efforts will not only help us, but all who travel the vast sea.
progress: The Southsea Freebooters must be stopped if we are to ever leave this place.
completion: I salute you. You have made the waves a much safer place for all who travel them.

title: Southsea Interference
objectives:
Slay the Southsea Captains located on the Southsea Sandbar for Colonel Hardinus in Caelan's Rest. 
- [Captain Ironhoof](Captain Ironhoof) slain
- [Captain Blackeye](Captain Blackeye) slain
- [Captain Saltbeard](Captain Saltbeard) slain
description:
With each sash collected, the Southsea are weakened, but not destroyed. Their strength comes from the captains of each ship and crew. A man with great charisma and promises of wealth, fortune, and adventure can easily rile up a group with no future ahead of them.

It is these individuals that we will need to target—the captains of the Southsea Freebooters. You shall find them to the southwest along a dangerous strip of sand called The Southsea Sandbar. Be cautious, it is the basecamp of the pirates on both Gilijim, and Lapidis.

You shall find the captains upon the boats there. Enter each and kill the leaders.
progress: Once the leaders are dead, the pirates will be sent into a state of chaos to establish new leadership.
completion: The Admiral would be proud of everything you've done. I have no doubt it will take the Southsea many weeks before someone is their new leader, and even then, they will be very much weaker than they were before. Cheers, the dead of the fleet have been avenged.

title: The Meeting with the Enemy
objectives:
Speak with Falgran to begin the meeting, once complete, report to Captain Garran Vimes at Theramore Isle in Dustwallow Marsh.
- Assist Falgran with the meeting
description:
You remember the orc, right? He wants us to talk. He knows something that we don't.

<name>, please remain calm, and try not to provoke them. I know it may be difficult, given our history, but they are much like you and me.

Just perhaps a bit more green.
progress: Back already? What did you learn?
completion:
You met with the Horde unauthorized? This could've provoked a major diplomatic incident!

At least you learned important information.
notes:
-Talking to Falgran Hastil**
What is it you need?

  > Gossip: I am ready for the meeting.

  **Falgran Hastil says:** I am Falgran Hastil, scout of Theramore. Why did you call for this meeting?
  **Kagoro says:** We saw you investigate the inn. We wanted to assure you it is not the Horde's doing.
  **Falgran Hastil says:** We found this shield strapped to the wall of the inn. Do you have any recollection of this object?
  **Kagoro says:** Let me see.
  Kagoro investigates the shield thoroughly.
  **Falgran Hastil says:** Do you know how it could've ended up in the inn? We found his grave. It was recently disturbed.
  **Kagoro says:** To disturb the grave of a fallen warrior I assure you, I know nothing of this.
  **Falgran Hastil says:** It seems like someone wanted to make us blame you for the burning of the inn.
  **Kagoro says:** Indeed. Have you found anything else in the investigation?
  **Falgran Hastil says:** Yes, quillboar footsteps...
  **Kagoro says:** False lead.
  **Falgran Hastil says:** I see you did some work too.
  Kagoro nods.
  **Falgran Hastil says:** And the badge of one of the deserters. Paval Reethe. We couldn't find Reethe, though. Have you seen him, by any chance?
  **Kagoro says:** This is... a delicate matter, and the actual reason I called for the meeting. Paval Reethe is dead.
  **Falgran Hastil says:** He was a deserter. While I still would've preferred to arrest him and allow for a just trial, I understand that you killed him. We do not blame you.
  **Kagoro says:** If it only was that simple. We knew he was connected to the burning of the inn, and we wanted to investigate him. Before he could talk... we were attacked. By Theramore soldiers. One of them bore the name Caldwell.
  **Falgran Hastil says:** Attacked? Unprovoked, by Theramore soldiers? I swear to the Light, orc. If you are lying...
  **Kagoro says:** I swear upon my ancestors and my Warchief. They killed him in cold blood. Quick arrow pierced his heart. We also barely made it out alive.
  **Falgran Hastil says:** Theramore soldiers would never... We shall investigate this. But if we find out that your words aren't true...
  **Kagoro says:** I am sorry for the loss of your comrades. While you investigate this, we shall follow another lead we have. Black Dragonflight.
  **Falgran Hastil says:** And we will investigate in Theramore. But be warned, orc. Your story doesn't add up.
  **Kagoro says:** Let's meet here once we know more. I hope you will find truth in your city of stones.

title: Recovering Vault Shackles (Alliance)
objectives:
Within the Stormwind Vault, slay Runic Constructs for 2 Runic Shackles, return them to Koli Steamheart.
- [Runic Shackle](Runic Shackle) (2)
description:
Back when the Vault first was opened, it was used to house the most dangerous prisoners, to contain magical entities and the insane alike, we used Runic Constructs to patrol the hallways!

These Runic Constructs have fallen corrupt from the intense magic within the Vault, and need to be destroyed, their powerful bracers are what keep them intact, and they need to be recovered! I have plans to test what exactly went wrong with these bracers.

You can find them within the Stormwind Vault, slay them, and bring me a pair of Shackles, I will make sure you are rewarded for the task.
progress: Be careful, the Runic Constructs are quite powerful, an overchage of magical energy gone rampant!
completion: Ahh, here we are! This is them, thanks again, this means a lot, here, just as I promised.
notes:
-Upon completion**
  **Koli Steamheart says:** Thanks again for the help! I will make sure to study these so the same thing cannot happen again!

title: Ritual of Divination
objectives:
Assist Magus Halister during the ritual and report the findings to Garran Vimes at Theramore Isle in Dustwallow Marsh.
- Information from Paval Reethe
description:
I shall need your help during the ritual. Perhaps we may learn more from the spirit realm.

Let's begin.
progress: I heard terrible noises coming from the Mage Tower. What happened?
completion:
So it was the deserters. Very well, I suspected it, to be honest. These people have no honor. We shall send our best men to deal with them. But before this, I think the Horde should also get an explanation and... an apology.

And when it comes to this Mariner, let me consult with some of my advisors. I think I may have heard of this man before.
notes:
Magus Halister begins to call upon the arcane, his channeling draws forth the energy of the spiritual realm.
  **Paval Reethe says:** Who disturbs my rest? Do I owe my service to the Alliance even in death? Let me pass to the Spirit Realm in peace.
  **Magus Halister says:** Paval Reethe. In life, you failed to uphold honor. You deserted your friends, your family. Now you have a chance to redeem yourself.
  **Paval Reethe says:** Isn't it obvious? The deserters did it. Not me, though. In my last days, I did what was right. I tried to stop them. That's why they left me in the swamp.
  **Magus Halister says:** Why? Why did they burn it?
  **Paval Reethe says:** Shady Rest Inn was open to everyone. Even us. We have spent many evenings there, laughing and drinking. But one time, some of our people got too drunk. They started meddling with the innkeeper. Until they said too much. Something about the [Vengeful Mariner](Vengeful Mariner). They couldn't allow this to reach Theramore, so they burned the inn. No witnesses.
  **Magus Halister says:** Vengeful Mariner?
  Paval Reethe laughs openly.
  **Paval Reethe says:** You would not understand.
  The Spirit of Paval Reethe vanishes.
  **Magus Halister yells:** Paval! I curse you, come back! Reethe!
  Magus Halister sighs.
  **Magus Halister says:** Well, looks like he left us for good. At least we got some answers out of him. Now, go back to Captain Garram Vimes. He will know what to do next.

title: The Second Meeting
objectives:
Assist Falgran with the meeting, once complete, return to Captain Garran Vimes at Theramore Isle in Dustwallow Marsh.
- Assist Falgran with the meeting
description:
Here we are again, for another meeting with the Horde.

Kagoro has explained some things to me, but we are ready for our meeting.
progress: The Horde have been honest about their investigations, it makes me happy that we disclosed our own information.
completion: What did you learn, soldier?
notes:
-Talking to Falgran Hastil**
What is it you need?

  > Gossip: I am ready for the meeting.

  **Falgran Hastil says:** Kagoro! We are ready.
  **Kagoro says:** Falgran.
  **Falgran Hastil says:** Kagoro, on behalf of the Alliance and the City of Theramore, I would like to apologize for not believing you and my false accusations. We are now certain that the deserters burned the inn.
  **Kagoro says:** I am relieved to hear it. Our investigation of Black Dragons yielded no results. But how did you learn of the truth?
  **Falgran Hastil says:** Through the power of magic, of course. Arts of Divination. We communed with the spirit of Paval Reethe.
  **Kagoro says:** Extraordinary. Incredible sorcery, as always. But... why? Why did they burn the inn?
  **Falgran Hastil says:** Well. This is where it gets a bit complicated. The deserters were regular patrons of the inn. In their drunken state, they confessed... something to the innkeeper. In fear of the information reaching Theramore, they preferred to kill him and leave false evidence.
  **Kagoro says:** The shield... Yes, it makes sense.
  **Falgran Hastil says:** Paval Reethe wanted to stop them. He may have been a deserter, but he had some of his honor still left in his heart.
  **Kagoro says:** That's why they left him in the swamp. But, what was the information that was so precious to the deserters?
  **Falgran Hastil says:** About this, we are not sure. Something about the [Vengeful Mariner](Vengeful Mariner), their rumored true leader. Have you heard about him?
  **Kagoro says:** Vengeful Mariner... The Ogres speak of a haunted sailor terrorizing the shores, but I doubt it's connected.
  **Falgran Hastil says:** We will soon bring justice to the deserters for their crimes, thank you for your information Kagoro, the horde has helped plenty in these lands.
  **Kagoro says:** We believe in justice the same way you alliance do, go with honor friend.
  **Falgran Hastil says:** We should report to Captain Garran Vimes and let him know our discoveries.

title: Delivery to Alah'Thalas
objectives:
Deliver the Wildhammer Supply Package to [Tiriel Brightwater](Tiriel Brightwater) in [Alah'Thalas](Alah'Thalas).
-[Wildhammer Supply Package](Wildhammer Supply Package) (provided)
description: Heading to the city of Alah'Thalas, are you? If so, I've a task that requires your aid. My companion, Tiriel, has established an inn for the influx of refugees making their way to the city, and, as you can imagine, it's teeming with occupants. We've just received a fresh supply package from the [Wildhammers](Wildhammer dwarf), and it would be of immense help if you could deliver it to her. You'll find Tiriel's inn adjacent to the city entrance, the first building on your left as you pass [Anasterian Park](Anasterian Park).
progress: Welcome to my inn, traveler. We are out of beds for now, but you can always sleep on the floor, right?
completion: Ah, it's from [Solenia](Solenia Solarcrest)? My dear girl is truly sweet. I appreciate your kindness in delivering it, stranger. If you happen to cross paths with her again, convey my gratitude and tell her she must come to visit me. There are matters of great importance that we need to... discuss.
rewards:
You will receive:
-130 XP
-+25 [reputation](reputation) with [Silvermoon Remnant](Silvermoon Remnant)

title: Message for the Windrunner
objectives:
Bring the Feltouched Letter to Lady [Vereesa Windrunner](Vereesa Windrunner) in [Alah'Thalas](Alah'Thalas).
-[Feltouched Letter](Feltouched Letter) (provided)
description:
Quickly now, time is of the essence. This missive must find its way to the [Regency Council](Regency Council) with the swiftness of the wind before circumstances turn dire.

<[Commander Anarileth](Commander Anarileth) leans in, her voice dropping to a hushed tone.>

Yet, a caution weighs upon these words. Not every member within the Council is to be held in unquestionable trust. Ensure, with the utmost discretion, that this message reaches Vereesa Windrunner's hands exclusively. She alone is to be entrusted with the contents therein.
progress: Another one of our kin finds a way into Alah'Thalas. Welcome.
completion:
<Vereesa gracefully accepts the letter from your hand, her keen eyes perusing its contents with a measured intensity.>

Thank you, <class>, for your diligence in bringing this matter to my attention. The urgency of the situation is apparent, further corroborating my apprehensions. It appears that the once understandable discontent has evolved into blatant mutiny.

<She pauses, her demeanor reflecting a mix of concern and determination.>

Not all within our midst remain loyal to our shared cause. We must swiftly identify these agents still aligned with Kael'thas and promptly expel them from our city.
rewards:
You will receive:
-70 XP
-+150 [reputation](reputation) with [Silvermoon Remnant](Silvermoon Remnant)
-[Thalassian Handguards](Thalassian Handguards)

title: The Tidemaster
objectives:
Venture within the Tidemaster in Shank's Reef and recover the Tidemaster's Logbook for Deckmaster Breachcrest in Caelan's Rest.
- [Tidemaster Logbook](Tidemaster Logbook)
description:
Our sister ship, the Tidemaster, was wrecked off the coast, and we suffered horrible casualties after grounding into Shank's Reef. The rocks ripped the ship apart, and murlocs attacked the crew. None survived to tell the tale. The ship was wonderful, and now it sits as a disfigured wreck within the Reef as if to disgrace Boralus.

There is nothing that we can do with the husk of the Tidemaster or its perished crew, but we still need to recover the logbook. I do not have the crew to risk, especially with the murlocs and rather hostile fish that tread the waters there. You will be the one to venture inside the wreckage and take the logbook from its chest. The information there cannot fall into our enemies' hands, or the pirates'.

You shall find what you're looking for to the northwest along the coast.
progress: Have you had any luck in finding the logs?
completion: You have done well in your task. If the Blackblood or Southsea Pirates had found this, they would have been able to raid innocent merchantmen with leisure.

title: The Boran Family
objectives:
Deliver the letters from Arnold Boran to his two brothers.
- Deliver [Letter to Karl](Letter to Karl): 0/1
- Deliver [Letter to Samual](Letter to Samual): 0/1
- [Letter from Karl](Letter from Karl): 0/1
- [Letter from Samual](Letter from Samual): 0/1
description:
I come from a large family, one that once occupied the boroughs of Kul Tiras. We weren't exactly a rich family, but we were not poor either! I traveled out with two of my brothers when the third war started up in Lordaeron, hoping to earn some fortune and glory. I helped the navy, my brother Karl started work in Menethil Harbor, and Samual went to Southshore to assist the war effort.

Ever since I set sail years ago, I have had no communication with them and would like to reach out, if you could deliver a letter to the both of them. They must have thought I perished after so long without a word or peep, and I want to ease their minds.
progress: Have you seen my brothers yet? It will require travelling, but I would appreciate it greatly.
completion: My family has always been close knit, and I know that such a long length without hearing from me would certainly cause worry. I am simply happy to dispell such concern and let them know all is fine. Thanks again. This has meant a lot for me.
notes:
[Karl Boran](Karl Boran) is located on the docks in [Menethil Harbor](Menethil Harbor) in the [Wetlands](Wetlands), and [Samual Boran](Samual Boran) is located in the inn in [Southshore](Southshore), in the [Hillsbrad Foothills](Hillsbrad Foothills).

  -Speaking with Karl**

  > Gossip: *I have a letter from your brother.*

  **Karl Boran says:** A letter from Arnold... I thought he died at sea. I haven't heard from him in such a long time.
  **Karl Boran says:** This is splendid news. Here, please take this to him.

  -Speaking with Samual**

  > Gossip: *I have a letter from your brother.*

  **Samual Boran says:** I knew Arnold was still out there somewhere, though I cannot imagine what it would be like stranded on some island at sea. Hopefully he returns home safely.
  **Samual Boran says:** I have a letter for you. Deliver it to him and with haste.

title: Grapes in the Hills
objectives:
Bring 10 Buckets of Grapes to [Fainriel Silverharp](Fainriel Silverharp) in the [Thaumarium](Thaumarium).
-[Bucket of Grapes](Bucket of Grapes) (10)
description:
Greetings, friend. Have you come to savor our renowned wines? Regrettably, due to the incessant [lynx](lynx) attacks, grape cultivation in the hills had to be halted, leaving us with naught.

Yet, I harbor optimism that amidst the chaos, our workers may have left behind buckets still brimming with grapes in the hills southeast of this abode. They might be a tad fermented by now, but isn't the essence of winemaking in embracing such nuances? If you could retrieve even ten buckets, I could conjure up some wine for prospective patrons! Your assistance would be invaluable.
progress: Be wary of those lynxes! My sweet Maelor lost his eye in a fight with one of them.
completion: Thank you, by the [Sunwell](Sunwell), thank you! It may not be grand, but any aid in these challenging times is truly appreciated. Accept these potions as a token of my appreciation. They may be of more utility to you now than any wine I could offer. Safe travels, friend.
rewards:
You will receive:
-630 XP
-+100 [reputation](reputation) with [Silvermoon Remnant](Silvermoon Remnant)

You can choose one of these awards:
-[Minor Healing Potion](Minor Healing Potion)
-[Weak Troll's Blood Potion](Weak Troll's Blood Potion)
-[Swim Speed Potion](Swim Speed Potion)

title: The Highland Menace
objectives:
Bring 10 Bright Lynx Furs to [Maelor Steelguard](Maelor Steelguard) in the [Thaumarium](Thaumarium).
-[Bright Lynx Fur](Bright Lynx Fur) (10)
description:
Welcome to Thaumarium. Within these walls, my [enchanting wife](enchanting wife) crafts the finest wines to grace the [Thalassian Highlands](Thalassian Highlands). We've bestowed upon this haven the same name as our erstwhile winery in [Quel'Thalas](Quel'Thalas), harboring eager anticipation for the prosperity of our venture.

However, a quandary befalls us. Our aspirations lead us to cultivate a vineyard in the hills southeast of this sanctuary. The microclimate there is exceptionally conducive to grape cultivation. Alas, these very hills are plagued by a savage breed of [lynx](lynx), making it impossible for our workers to toil the soil in peace. I implore you to eliminate as many of these creatures as you can and return with their furs as tangible proof of their demise. Your assistance shall not go unrewarded.
progress: Be careful, these creatures are more savage than you think.
completion: One, two, three... and a score of ten! Remarkable work. With such diligence, the hills will soon be secure for our laborers to resume their work without fear.
rewards:
You will receive:
-910 XP
-+150 [reputation](reputation) with [Silvermoon Remnant](Silvermoon Remnant)

You can choose one of these awards:
-[Winestained Bracers](Winestained Bracers)
-[Thalassian Sentinel Belt](Thalassian Sentinel Belt)

title: A Score To Settle
objectives:
Bring 1 Fang of Shar'Lan to [Maelor Steelguard](Maelor Steelguard) as a proof of your deed.
-[Fang of Shar'lan](Fang of Shar'lan)
description:
I must burden you with one more request, <name>. A few weeks past, as I scoured the hills in search of ideal spots for grape cultivation, I fell victim to a [lynx](lynx) of unparalleled ferocity. In the ensuing struggle, the creature overpowered me, leaving me grievously wounded, my eye forever lost.

A personal vendetta now brews within me against this formidable adversary. Vanquish the beast and retrieve its fang as evidence. I will easily recognize it; the fangs were larger than any I have ever seen.
progress: Be wary of its bite.
completion: Indeed, this fang unequivocally belonged to the ferocious beast that tormented me. With the creature now vanquished, my workers can hasten their return to the hills. There's a profound sense of satisfaction in knowing that the creature which inflicted a life-altering scar upon me is no longer among the living.
rewards:
You will receive:
-680 XP
-+150 [reputation](reputation) with [Silvermoon Remnant](Silvermoon Remnant)
-[Lynx Sword](Lynx Sword)

title: Faelon's Folly (quest)
objectives:
Travel to [Faelon's Folly](Faelon's Folly) on [Gillijim's Island](Gillijim's Island) and slay 7 Forgotten Swordsman, 7 Drowned Souls, and 7 Forgotten Crew
- [Forgotten Swordsman](Forgotten Swordsman) (7)
- [Drowned Soul](Drowned Soul) (7)
- [Forgotten Crew](Forgotten Crew) (7)
description:
Our fleet was accompanied by a squadron of high elf vessels. They traveled to the islands with us for a somewhat secretive mission. I had many friends within their crew whom I met from Kul Tiras. The high elves are a good people, but their leader, Faelon, was a rather shady character--one who traded illegal goods and dealt with unsavory individuals.

It is sad to say that many of those people I once called good friends were slain by the Deeptide Naga. They're now haunting the shores of Faelon's Folly on the island of Gillijim, left restless by an item Faelon coveted and hoped to trade.

Go there and free the souls of the dead. You will find them on the western coast of Gillijim's Island south of Lapidis.
progress: Have the crew been put to rest?
completion: It is a shame what happened to the elves, but I know if we Kul Tirans were in a similar state, they would offer us the same kindness.

title: Sailors Innovation
objectives:
Collect 6 Juicy Crawler Legs and a Pinch of Salt for 'Slim' in Caelan's Rest. 
- [Juicy Crawler Leg](Juicy Crawled Leg) (6)
- [Pinch of Salt](Pinch of Salt)
description:
From our time at sea, it is us sailors who come up with the fine dining aboard ship. The same meals can get repetitive when you have them over and over again, so it is time to improvise and innovate.

I came up with this recipe some time ago when we spent a few days on [Tel'Abim](Tel'Abim). All we had were sand crawlers and bananas. Fry it up together and add a pinch of salt, then you have quite a meal! Sadly, we don't got bananas, but I do know that Chef Jenkel has some salt. Get the salt from him, and gather some legs from any sort of sand crawler around these islands, then I can finally have a change of meal.
progress: Make sure those crawler legs are juicy!
completion: Ah, yeah this should be everything. A meal worthy for the Admiral! Here, have some as thanks.
notes:
-Speaking with [Chef Jenkel](Chef Jenkel)**

  Cooking is a fine art, and working with such few resources at our disposal makes it an even finer art.

  > Gossip: *Slim is asking for salt.*

  **Chef Jenkel says:** Alright, fine, but he owes me, make sure you tell him!

title: Mount Hyjal In Turmoil
objectives: Seek the [druid](druid)s at the foot of the [World Tree](World Tree) [Nordrassil](Nordrassil) in [Hyjal](Hyjal).
description:
<Class>, news spread from atop the sacred Mount Hyjal. Our greatest fear, the [Nightmare](Emerald Nightmare), has taken root and seeps once more into our realm. Many brave souls venture to the great World Tree to offer assistance to our brethren's cause to quell the Nightmare's influence.

<Name>, I implore you to ascend Mount Hyjal and aid the [Wardens of Nordanaar](Wardens of Nordanaar) in their endeavors.
progress: Greetings, adventurer. To ensure [our world](Azeroth)'s continued existence, we accept anyone willing to assist.
completion: [Moonglade](Moonglade) sending support is assuring to hear, young one. The turmoil we are facing should be the concern of us all, is it not perilous to ignore it.
rewards:
You will receive:
-1200 XP
-+100 [reputation](reputation) with [Cenarion Circle](Cenarion Circle)

title: The Water Rat
objectives:
Find 'Water Rat' Jorgy on Lapidis Isle and return his head to Sergeant Blackwell in Caelan's Rest.
- [Head of Jorgy](Head of Jorgy)
description:
A group of pirates led by 'Water Rat' Jorgy ambushed us and left us stranded ashore. Our sister ship fared much worse than we have, but still, we have endured many hardships upon this island. The battle off the shore destroyed all three ships. Jorgy's ship was running ashore after taking on water at the western side of the island.

He and his men have become trapped much like we are, and I know he still is out there. I want you to claim his head for the death of Admiral Caelan. Bring it to me, and I'll give you the golden earring he is known for. Check the western side of the island along the Bright Coast. He and his crew remain there.
progress: Have you had any luck?
completion: Admiral Caelan's death has been avenged, and the captain from each ship now lies in a grave. I thank you for what you've done. The marines will be overjoyed with such news of vengeance.

title: The Gor'dosh Ogres
objectives:
Slay 12 Gor'dosh Brutes, 8 Gor'dosh Ogres, and 5 Gor'dosh Shamans for Sergeant Blackwell in Caelan's Rest.
- [Gor'dosh Brute](Gor'dosh Brute) (12)
- [Gor'dosh Ogre](Gor'dosh Ogre) (8)
- [Gor'dosh Shaman](Gor'dosh Shaman) (5)
description:
The Gor'dosh Ogres are a fearsome foe. They battled us almost constantly when we made landfall, but we drove them back. It is only a matter of time before they are ready to strike again.

Now that they are allied with Lapidis, they have become even bolder upon the island and must be stopped at any and all costs. They have established quite a formidable force to the northwest in an area known as Gor'dosh Heights. Travel there and kill them to end the bloodshed.
progress: Brutality, that is all they know, and that is all they shall receive.
completion: With their numbers thinned, it will take them much longer to organize an attack. Your actions have helped us greatly, but still, there is more to be done.

title: The Tyrant King

fields.name: The Tyrant King
fields.rewards: Choice of:, Mantle of the Ogre Slayer, or, Tyrant Cuffs

objectives:
Slay the Tyrant King, and bring his crown to Sergeant Blackwell in Caelan's Rest.
- [Tyrant's Crown](Tyrant's Crown)
description:
Spurred by their leader, the Gor'dosh may never leave us alone. The Tyrant King has gotten his name for being a rather intimidating brute who led the first attacks of ogres here. He is stubborn and doesn't even listen to the advice of his shamans or his wisest seers.

If we are to stop the Gor'dosh truly, this Tyrant King must be eradicated and killed. You will find him within Gor'dosh Heights, more than likely within their largest camp. Venture forth, and make sure he can no longer cause us issues. Bring me the crooked crown he wears upon his head.
progress: There is no diplomacy to be had. All that is left is to kill the king.
