completion: Such a crude thing. An ugly trophy it will make. With the Tyrant King removed, the Gor'dosh will be splintered without leadership and may truly never recover. Many thanks. You have done good work this day.

title: The Aqua Stone
objectives:
Recover the Aqua Stone from Hargul the Hardy. 
- [Aqua Stone](Aqua Stone)
description:
Margon the Mighty and his son Hargul the Hardy are two sea giants that roam the island of Lapidis and the surrounding waters. Hargul especially has been something of a nuisance and attacked Caelan's Rest many weeks ago. While no one was harmed, he did away with a few items of importance before the marines had assembled and prepared to engage him.

One such item was the Aqua Stone, a magically potent stone that has been imbued with the energy of powerful Hydromancers. With this stone, we could better channel our abilities with increased potency. I would like you to reclaim this valuable treasure, and to that end, slay Hargul the Hardy. More than for the benefit of the Hydromancers, so that it does not ever fall into the wrong hands.
progress: The Aqua Stone is of much importance to us here, and we must recover it.
completion: This is it! We had abandoned all serious hopes of reclaiming it, and now it is in our possession once again. A marvelous day, and it is all thanks to you.

title: Drowning Deeptide
objectives:
Collect 10 Deeptide Bracelets from Deeptide Naga for Eliza Caldwell in Caelan's Rest.
- [Deeptide Bracelet](Deeptide Bracelet) (20)
description:
The Naga of the Deeptide have been a problem ever since we first arrived. They attacked our vessels when we first landed upon the island of Gillijim with the High Elves we came with. While we were victorious, it still was reason enough for us to travel to Lapidis instead.

Unfortunately, you know what happened after we got here, but still, the naga remain a threat that must be dealt with. They have a sanctum off the southwestern coast of Gillijim's Island located just south of Lapidis.

Head to their sanctum, and kill what naga you find. Take from them their bracelets and bring them to me.
progress: Has it been done? Have you traveled to Gillijim?
completion: The Deeptide Naga have been up to something, but that is not what we are here to investigate. Good work in dispatching the foul creatures. Let us hope they prove no further harm to the crew.

title: Southsea Reserve
objectives:
Claim the Southsea Reserve Recipe from ['Moonshine' Marty]('Moonshine' Marty) for Sailor Larson in Caelan's Rest
- [Southsea Reserve Recipe](Southsea Reserve Recipe)
description:
Oh, to be back on the sea... back on the sea and on the way home. It's been hell just to be left to roam this small part of the island. The only thing we sailors have is grog and each other's company.

Rum is fine, but we've been craving more variety. This is where you're going to come in. The Southsea Pirates have been rather known for their own Southsea Reserve recipe which only they can make. That is, until you go and steal the recipe.

They are currently holed up on a strand of sand called the Southsea Sandbar and the small neighboring patch of sand known as Distillery Island. It's practically a damn factory of the stuff. They have an entire trained crew working around the clock pumping this stuff reserve out.

It's down in the southwest off the coast of Lapidis Isle. You should see several of their ships docked there. The one who invented the recipe is named 'Moonshine' Marty. You'll get it from him.
progress: Any luck, matey?
completion: This is it! Haha! Such fine work—you'd make one excellent swashbuckler aboard the Waterbreaker when she is repaired!
notes:
-Speaking with 'Moonshine' Marty**
  Please, don't kill me!

  I'm the bootlegger who created the recipe for the famous Southsea Reserve!

  You... you can buy some of it if you'd like!

  > Gossip: *Give me the recipe for the Southsea Reserve and I'll let you live!*

  **'Moonshine' Marty says:** Fine! Spare me please, here is the recipe!

title: The Harvest Golem Mystery (16)
objectives:
Talk with F.W. in the shack south of Darkshire, then report back to Maltimor.
- [Farad Wrightsow](Farad Wrightsow) slain
- [Gazzirik](Gazzirik) slain
description:
A few months ago, a mysterious blind man moved into an abandoned shack south of Darkshire. A goblin accompanied him, helping him with everyday tasks in exchange for mentorship. He was a renowned engineer, of some kind.

Strange couple, that's for sure, though they professed to only be seeking shelter.

With all our concerns across Duskwood, I was only able to spare a single Watcher to surveil their dealings, and what little I've heard has done nothing to quell my suspicions.

If you venture there and find out what you can as you go about your errand, you would render a fine service to the Night Watch.
progress: Have you found him?
completion: The people of Westfall are safe. Thank you, <name>. These lands will heal in time.
notes:
-Speaking with Farad**

  Get out of my shack.

  > Gossip: *Did you produce Animation Runes for the Defias?*

  Dammit, I knew they would find me. Alas, all good things come to an end. Before we fight for our lives, tell me who sent you. Was it [Maltimor](Maltimor Gartside)?

  > Gossip: *<Stare silently.>*

  Of course it was him, the old fool. He thinks that my death will fix everything... Oh, how wrong he is. My death will change nothing!

  > Gossip: *<Attack.>*

  -Death**
  **Farad Wrightsow says:** If only you knew... Maltimor, I hope the Twisting Nether... takes you...
  **Gazzirik says:** That was a bad deal...

title: The Harvest Golem Mystery (13)
objectives:
Find the Lordaeron Needles among the gnoll hovels and bring them to Franklin Hamar in Lakeshire.
- [Lordaeron Needles](Lordaeron Needles)
description:
Alright, you helped me well. I will spare you running errands and just send you to do what you do best. Kill.

Gnolls in the hills of Redridge have been giving me and other traders a hard time lately. It's bad for business. I lost two shipments with rare materials this month only! They probably still hoard them somewhere in their camps up north. Check it out.

I want you to look especially for one lost shipment - rare needles from Lordaeron. You will know when you see them.
progress: Less talking, more doing.
completion:
Extraordinary. Great work. Those needles will serve me well. So thin, so durable. But I'm getting ahead of myself.

I made a promise. Let me decipher this message.
notes:
-On completion**
  Franklin Hamar looks into the note.
  **Franklin Hamar says:** Awful handwriting, it's like the person writing this was blind. Alright, here it goes. Listen carefully.
  **Franklin Hamar says:** Tell [G.](Gilnid) that the people in Darkshire are getting delicious. Sorry, suspicious.
  **Franklin Hamar says:** The Night Watch is eyeing my shack every day. I need to move out soon if the production of runes is to continue.
  **Franklin Hamar says:** Send someone. Stormwind shall fall, yadda yadda, F.W. The end.
  **Franklin Hamar says:** Interesting note, friend. You and Hewen might be in trouble. But that's none of my business.

title: Letter from Maltimor
objectives:
Confront Maltimor about the letter.
- Listen to Maltimor
description:
Dear Farad,

We made a mistake. You need to stop distributing the golems. Our plan will not work.

I know you are still angry at me for what I did to you. It was an accident, I swear! But you have to listen, please. I cannot stop the golems from killing people. The spell does not work! Oh, how stupid I was.

Please, Farad, stop this nonsense with the Stonemasons Guild and come back. We will figure out how to fix them together, like the old times. Please.

I await you in our old workshop in Moonbrook. Where everything started. Our friendship, our plans, our failure.

Your good friend, Maltimor Gartside.
progress: What is it, friend? Oh, by the Light...
completion: I bid you farewell, <name>. Thank you for understanding. And once again, thank you for all you did. You truly are a hero.
notes:
-Speaking with Maltimor**

  Westfall. Once, a land of prosperity. Now, nothing more than a wasteland.

  > Gossip: *<Hand him the letter.>*

  I... I should explain. Yes, I was lying to you all this time. I made the golems with the help of Farad and some goblin machinery. We lived here, in Moonbrook, many years ago.

  We just wanted to escape this damned place. So we made the Harvest Golems to help the farmers and also to get their money. But we knew it was too expensive for an average farmer to buy one. So we were selling them for a low, low price. We were losing a lot of money on it.

  > Gossip: *Listen more.*

  You probably already know where it is going. I'm not proud of this part. There was a catch. When everyone's fields were protected by golems, we would activate their true nature.

  They would become murderous machines. We would blame it on some vile warlock or anyone else. It didn't matter. The only important thing was that we would be sole ones who could fix them... for a very high price.

  > Gossip: *Listen more.*

  At least, that was the idea. In my greed, I activated the murderous killswitch when Farad was working with some golems in a workshop. I wanted him to die so that all the money would go to me.

  I learned later that he survived and merely was blinded. He hated me for it. But regardless, I saw the destruction I caused, I wanted to make the golems docile again... but our spell didn't work.

  > Gossip: *Listen more.*

  Some mistakes were made during construction, or just a lack of skill, I will never know. I couldn't fix them. Westfall became a wasteland. Then came the Defias with Farad on their side.

  You know the rest of the story. You may judge me, think of me a monster. The truth is... you are probably right. I was a monster. But I did everything I could to fix it. By the Light, I can only hope that it is enough.

title: Empty Houses
objectives:
Interrogate the townsfolk of Ambershire.
- Interrogated [Ignatz](Ignatz)
- Interrogated [Bailiff Lancaster](Bailiff Lancaster)
- Interrogated [Judith Flenning](Judith Flenning)
description:
King's Honor, <class>. ‘Tis not an opportune time visiting Northwind, I must admit. Normally this vale is a tranquil place, untouched by the troubles of the world. But recently, many crises came crashing down on these hills. If you journeyed here from Stormwind, you've seen what I am talking about. There are, however, more harrowing events transpiring in the shadows of the night.

For several weeks now, we've received reports of disappearances occuring in the kingdom. They were seldom at first, nothing out of the ordinary, but the number has risen to an alarming amount. This is technically confidential, but I've been assigned to this as the solitary investigator, and cannot by no stretch of the imagination accomplish this alone. The SI:7 has its hands full with the Defias in Westfall, so I will deputize you to assist me. Don't fret, I'll arrange just compensation for you.

Start by questioning the remaining townsfolk; the groundskeeper, bailiff and one of the victim's relatives.
progress: <Operative Hawthorne is noting something down in his journal. With a stern expression of contemplation, he is lost deep in thought.>
completion: Interesting. With the testimonies you've presented and my own information, we should be able to pinpoint potential suspects. Well done.
notes:
<interactive-map name="Northwind"|marker=https://turtle-wow.fandom.com/wiki/Map:Northwind?marker=1/>
  -Speaking with Judith Flenning**
<The woman is shaking and distressed.>

  > Gossip: *I am here on behalf of SI:7 Operative Hawthorne. Have you noticed anything suspicious during the previous nights?*

  It is all my fault! If I hadn't gone to Stormwind alone and took them with me, they... they...! Our house; rummaged and broken into, it must've been terrifying for them! Oh, good <Class>, please, I beg of you! Bring back my dear babies, they must be scared and tired and... By the Light, I cannot take this much longer!

  <Judith is breaking down in tears.>

  -Speaking with Bailiff Lancaster**
What do you want from me? I really have neither the time nor the luster to bother myself with the insignificant squabbles of an adventurer.

  > Gossip: *I am here on behalf of SI:7 Operative Hawthorne. Have you noticed anything suspicious during the previous nights?*

  So you're Hawthorne's dog, I take it? With each passing day, the kingdom draws closer to ruin. That Stormwind is sending just one measly person to solve all our problems is all we need as proof. To answer your question: Yes, I have noticed 'suspicious activity' the past few days. Blackrock Orcs have invaded our vale, razing the entirety of Birkhaven to the ground and locking themselves in a stalemate with the Dark Iron that ALSO invaded Northwind. It is to be expected for people to disappear under these circumstances.

  -Speaking with Ignatz**
These leaves just never stop falling.

  > Gossip: *I am here on behalf of SI:7 Operative Hawthorne. Have you noticed anything suspicious during the previous nights?*

  I must tell you, I rarely go out during the night nowadays. It's not as safe as it used to be around town anymore, especially for an old man like myself. Dubious characters skulk around the park and outskirts of town, it is harrowing. My heart aches for those who disappeared, the people of Northwind are sincere and just. They do not deserve all the tragedy.

title: Deathcap And Widow's Frill
objectives:
Acquire the needed material for the Witch of Northwind in her coven in northwestern Northwind.
- [Deathcap](Deathcap) (10)
- [Widow's Frill](Widow's Frill) (20)
- [Sara's Comb](Sara's Comb)
description:
So you are lost. Darling, I can see it in your face as clear as day. You need someone to guide your way, and you've been told that someone could be me. Must have been that foolish girl Lydia, ever since she left my coven she did not care to visit me again. Her ambitions and duties as Mayor tie her down, locking her true potential, would she just accept it. Regardless of all that rambling, she is right. I can and will assist you in your needs, but not out of the goodness of my heart. All these ruffians marching into my woods have no business here!

What I need from you is fairly simple: Deathcap and Widow's Frill, mushrooms native to these hills. Deathcap grows in caverns and has an orange cap, Widow's Frill grows in groups of three near wet soil; search the woods at the Great Birch near Grimmen Lake. Bring me these and something personal from a recently abducted person. I am sure you will find what I desire in town.
progress: Now, now. Don't let me wait too much.
completion: Oho, splendid, darling. The Widow's Frills are especially thick this season, if we didn't need them for now I would make a loveable stew out of them. They're quite delectable, perhaps you can try them yourself once all of this is over. And this comb you've brought - it's from a young woman. Let us not tarry any longer. Now then, to mix this all together...
notes:
-Speaking with Judith Flenning**
<The woman is shaking and distressed.>

  > Gossip: *Greetings Judith, I am sorry to bother you again, but do you have something personal from one of your children? It may help me locate them.*

  What? Something personal? Excuse me, this comes as a bit of a surprise. What on Azeroth would you use it for...? I am sorry, I should not interfere with your work. If you really need it, I have this comb of my dear Sara. I brushed her hair just before I left for... Please, bring back my sweet darlings, the thought of Sara and Timothy all frightened breaks my heart!

title: Shadow's Vision
objectives:
Find the location described by the Witch of Northwind and report to Operative Hawthorne in Ambershire afterwards.
- Perpetrators found
- [Tattered Missive](Tattered Missive)
description:
<The Witch stirs the mushroom concoction, having it turn color from a light red to a vibrant blue. With a devious grin, she gulps the potion down, before entering a trance. Frozen in place, she whispers unintelligible words under her breath. After a short moment, her senses return.>

You are most fortunate, young one. I have seen who you seek - and they still remain here in Northwind. If you intend to capture them, make haste. My vision showed me the location of the young woman whose comb you brought. Ascend the hills past Amberwood Keep and follow its trails. Evil will await you there.
progress: <Name>? What brings you to me? You found the ones responsible?! Tell me!
completion:
So orcs were responsible after all; but not the Blackrocks. The way you described them doesn't match with any recent encounters we had with any of the orc clans, atleast not the ones I can recall by memory. We will take this to Stormwind and have the headquarters tackle this.

Regarding the girl... I will see to it to retrieve her body myself; I need to see this orc camp either way. Leave telling her mother to me, it is nothing that should fall to someone like you anyway.
notes:
-Inspecting Sara Flenning's body**
The young woman lies motionless on the ground. Her skin is cold to the touch and any life has long left her body.

  > Gossip: *<Inspect the body.>*

  <You turn her body to the side, making her face the cavern ceiling. An expression of terror is carved into her young features. Grey and withered eyes complete the traumatic image.>

title: To The Darkest Places
objectives:
Find Agent Deryl's comrades and potential information about your enemies using the clues he gave you. Return to [Verona Gillian](Verona Gillian) at the [SI:7 Outpost](SI:7 Outpost) on [Balor](Balor) afterwards.
- [Agent Flynn](Agent Flynn) found
- [Agent Cherys](Agent Cherys) found 
- [Agent Elroy](Green Puddle) found
- [Stormreaver Scroll](Stormreaver Scroll)
description: My corps consisted of ten operatives, surveying the perimeter around the Croaking Plateau. From the few ones that survived I was the only one locked up in this inn. For what reason I don't know. What I could see, however, was three of my comrades - Flynn, Elroy and Cherys - being dragged past the battlefield to the south of here. Luckily I understood a few of the orcish words they spoke. ‘Cave', ‘hill' and ‘master' are what I could decipher from their speech. It may not be much, but it is better than nothing, I guess. Apologies, but I won't be of much help to you with these injuries; I will report back to Operative Gillian and tell her what happened, that much I should manage. I pray you can uncover more and return safely back to the outpost.
progress: <name>, you've returned? Agent Deryl arrived here not long before you, his body strewn with grievous wounds. We've sent him back to Stormwind for recuperation. But tell me, is there anything you could find?
completion: A pity, those were valuable agents we've lost today. I'll send missives to their families, their service to the Kingdom won't be forgotten. Now, regarding this scroll...
notes:
-Inspecting Agent Flynn**
This seems to be one of Agent Deryl's compatriots.

  > Gossip: *<Inspect the body.>*

  <His skin is dried and flaky, almost brittling away under your touch. A torn and agonized expression is carved into his face, and his eyeless sockets send a shiver down your spine.>

  -Inspecting Agent Cheryl**
This seems to be one of Agent Deryl's compatriots.

  > Gossip: *<Inspect the body.>*

  <The skin of this corpse feels slimy, almost fluid, as if it is about to dissolve on its own. She has been beyond saving for a long time.>

  -Inspecting the Green Puddle**
Before you lies a puddle of green sludge.

  > Gossip: *<Inspect the body.>*

  <You are not sure what exactly it is that you're facing, but judging from the monsters you encountered so far, it must be something horrifying. Wading through the goop with your hand, your suspicion proves to be correct; in your hand is an SI:7 badge. Name: Elroy.>

title: An Echo From Beyond
objectives:
Face whatever is meddling at the Dark Portal and return to Kas'tal overlooking the Blasted Lands.
- [Fading Apparition](Fading Apparition) slain
description:
Master did great by sending you to me. I am sure we can thank his clairvoyance for that, as I witnessed something truly frightening mere moments ago. You see to your right the abominable Dark Portal, legacy of the orcish invasion of your world? Master's suspicions regarding the portal's energy were true. Just before your arrival, a huge surge in power and a terrible, crushing force washed over the red sands of this desert.

My intuition tells me whatever lingers in front of it must be terrifyingly powerful. <name>, please do not face it alone. Although the master has put your trust in you, what we are dealing with might very well be too much for you alone.
progress: Proceed with caution. We do not know what otherworldly horror might await us.
completion: A shadowed specter? And it spoke of the enslavement of the Sanv tribe and Akh Z'ador?! This is grim news, <race>. For all our sakes, let me be wrong, but I fear the Harborage is in danger, grave danger!

title: Novice In A Barren Land
objectives: Search for Akh Z'ador's apprentice in the [Blasted Lands](Blasted Lands).
description:
For now, this is all you can do here. Attuning my riftwalker staff to this new power will take longer than we have time, so I need you to continue onwards. While I energize the cane, you will go to the Blasted Lands, the desolate wastes south of the Swamp of Sorrows. Overlooking the red deserts, on top of a hill, my apprentice Kas'tal awaits. I ordered him to survey suspicious fluctuations near the Dark Portal, before all of this transpired. He is surely troubled and worried about me, assure him that there is no reason to fear for my safety anymore.

Once you find him, tell him I will meet him and you in the Harborage, so we can prepare ourselves for any eventualities that hopefully will not come to pass.
completion: Master Akh Z'ador sends you?! What a relief! Me and the tribe were worried sick, and had already feared the worst. Losing a close friend, trusted leader and masterful riftwalker like himself would've been too much for any of us to bear.

title: Sovereign of Desolation

fields.name: Sovereign of Desolation
fields.rewards: Choice of:, Felforged Nathrezan Veil,, Felforged Nathrezan Circlet, or, Felforged Nathrezan Aureole

objectives:
Deliver the Heart of Mephistroth to a sorcerer powerful enough to destroy it.
- [Heart of Mephistroth](Heart of Mephistroth)
description:
In your hands lies the still-beating heart of the Dreadlord [Mephistroth](Mephistroth), ruler of the [Rock of Desolation](Rock of Desolation). You and your expedition foiled his plans of using [Karazhan](Karazhan) as an entry point to invade Azeroth yet again. Expelled into the Great Dark Beyond forever, this is all that remains of the nefarious schemer.

You should bring it to someone able to expunge its life, just to be sure.
progress: This horrible stench! <name>, what have you brought with you?!
completion:
What a horrid prospect. To think we stood at the precipice of another invasion by the [Burning Legion](Burning Legion). <name>, your actions and those of your compatriots did not only save Azeroth from another war, but also quelled the threat of one of the most powerful dreadlords known to us. Second to only Tichondrius, the harbinger of the Legion’s invasion seven years ago, legends of his might circulated the Council of Six in Dalaran. Unimaginable to see such a commanding figure finally meet its demise.

You were correct in bringing his vile heart to me. I am able to burn the fel essence from its flesh, albeit very taxing for my body. That is but a small sacrifice, however. Nothing is too little when given the opportunity to remove such a putrid presence from our world. Whatever remains of this, you can keep. As a trophy; a remembrance of the feat you accomplished this day.
rewards:
You will be able to choose one of these rewards:
- [Felforged Nathrezan Veil](Felforged Nathrezan Veil)
- [Felforged Nathrezan Circlet](Felforged Nathrezan Circlet)
- [Felforged Nathrezan Aureole](Felforged Nathrezan Aureole)

title: Dalaran's Intentions
objectives: Speak with [Shadow Priest Allister](Shadow Priest Allister) at the [Sepulcher](Sepulcher).
description:
Of course! How could I have forgotten?

[Ambermill](Ambermill) was one of the sites earmarked by the [Kirin Tor](Kirin Tor), noted because it houses a dormant [ley energy node](Ley lines). The [wizard](wizard)s must be planning to reactivate the node and use its energies for some greater purpose.

We cannot allow this to happen...

It will take a great amount of power to activate the area's ley energies, we can stall them by taking the pendants away from the wizards.

Relay this information to Allister, he will decide a course of action.
completion:
Ill news you bring, <name>. If [Dalar](Dalar Dawnweaver) is correct—and I've no reason to believe he isn't--we must move quickly.

I must confer with him on our plan of attack. But in the meanwhile we will have to delay their progress.
rewards:
You will receive:
-100 [XP](XP) (or   60 (g/s/c) at level 70)
-+10 [reputation](reputation) with [Undercity](Undercity (faction))

title: Hidden Enemies
objectives:
Bring a Lieutenant's Insignia to [Thrall](Thrall) in [Orgrimmar](Orgrimmar).
-[Lieutenant's Insignia](Lieutenant's Insignia)
description:
One thing I will not tolerate are traitors in our midst, <name>. But I would be a fool to play my hand so early—it would not sufficiently cut the corruption out of our lands and only cause the infection to grow worse.

But you, a young adventurer, could go places my agents could not... could learn the truth... could find the true head of the beast.

If you are brave enough, then enter [Skull Rock](Skull Rock) to the east of Orgrimmar, find a lieutenant's insignia off one of the Burning Blade there, and return to me.
progress:
Do you have the insignia yet, <name>?

It will be a vital tool in infiltrating what I believe is the greatest threat to the Horde, and finally finding peace in our new home.

You will learn how intricate a web men and orcs alike can weave when they are motivated by greed and power. The hidden agendas, the corruption, all of it will become clear. You will find yourself in the midst of a war you never knew existed.
completion:
Good, <name>! The spirits be praised, perhaps you are the one who will finally put my greatest fears to rest! Who would suspect someone so young and so brave would rise up and champion our cause? You remind me of myself when I was younger. I will ensure that you are justly rewarded for your efforts if we both survive the coming storm.

But there is time for more praise later. You've not accomplished anything in comparison to what you will face... but this is a good start.
notes:
This quest becomes available only after you meet two conditions: you must reach level 10 and you must already have completed [Report to Orgnil](Report to Orgnil) quest.

You may wish to complete this quest along with the [Skull Rock (Classic)](Skull Rock (Classic)) quest, as both require you to enter this cave.

You may also wish to find and kill a Burning Blade Orc named [Gazz'uz](Gazz'uz) and retrieve the [Eye of Burning Shadow](Eye of Burning Shadow) from his corpse. This item will allow one to receive the [Burning Shadows](Burning Shadows) quest.

Thrall's gossip after completing the quest:

title: In Dreams

fields.name: In Dreams
fields.rewards: Mark of Fordring, Ornate Adamantium Breastplate, Shimmering Platinum Warhammer, Shroud of the Exile or Fordring's Seal

objectives:
Escort [Taelan Fordring](Taelan Fordring) out of [Hearthglen](Hearthglen). 
-Redemption?
description:
For so long, I have been a puppet of the Grand Crusader. What reason was there to fight against what the [Scarlet Crusade](Scarlet Crusade) had become? It has been decades, yet the memories of [my father](Tirion Fordring); those precious memories, they are what have kept me alive.

I have dreams, stranger. In these dreams my father is with me. He stands proudly at my side as I am inducted into the Order. We battle legion of [Scourge](Scourge), side by side. We bring honor to the [Alliance](Alliance), to [Lordaeron](Lordaeron).

I want not to dream anymore.

Take me to him.
progress: <Tirion regains his composure.>
completion:
The death of my son at the hands of these monsters will not pass without incident. Take solace in knowing that the Order is reborn.

I now take my place as Highlord of the new [Order of the Silver Hand](Order of the Silver Hand).

These possessions of my past - they are all that I have to offer for all that you have done. Please, take these as a symbol of my gratitude; all have served me well over the years.

May we meet again, in better times, and reminisce of days long past... battles hard fought... dreams redeemed.
notes:
*Highlord Taelan Fordring proceeds to kill every Scarlet Crusade soldier in his way as he makes his way out of Mardenholde Keep. As with most humanoid mobs, they all run in fear at low health.*
  
  *After exiting the keep.*
  
  
  *Taelan gets on his horse and continues on. He occasionally dismounts to kill more Scarlet Crusaders.*
  *After making it the the [scout tower](scout tower) on the road out of Hearthglen.*
  
  *Isillien walks out of the tower.*
  
  
  
  
  
  
  
  *The Crimson Elite attack. Taelan and Isillien battle.*
  
  *The two sides fight for a while.*
  
  *Isillien casts a mighty Holy Smite, killing Taelan.*
  
  
  
  *Lord Tirion Fordring appears.*
  
  
  
  
  
  *The two battle briefly, but Tirion easily overmatches the Grand Inquisitor while the players presumably finish off the remaining Crimson Elites. Tirion then goes to his son's side.*
  
  
  
  
  
  
  
  *The player may then talk to Tirion and complete the quest.*

title: Mathias and the Defias
description:
Not a moment too soon, <name>. [SI:7](SI:7) reconnaissance is reporting unusually heavy Defias activity in [Westfall](Westfall).

It would seem that the Defias have taken over an abandoned [Alliance watch tower](Mortwake's Tower) southeast of [Sentinel Hill](Sentinel Hill) and are using it as a base of operations to smuggle in goods from the [Redridge](Redridge) supply route.

Get to Westfall and contact Agent Kearnen for your debriefing. You will find her hidden near the tower.

...and <name>, should you be discovered, SI:7 will disavow all knowledge of your existence.
completion: Mathias finally sent another agent to back me up, eh? Well I hope he's ready to hear some bad news.

title: Learn Of My Past

fields.name: Learn Of My Past
fields.next: Rift Fatigue: Mind & Rift Fatigue: Body

objectives: Listen to Akh Z'ador's story.
description:
I have a perilous journey behind me, stranger. One that transcends worlds; yes, worlds. Riftwalkers possess ancient magic, sorcery foreign to [Azeroth](Azeroth). Large amounts of energy are necessary to perform this art, and less experienced riftwalkers often utilize the draenethyst crystals, the manifested lifeblood of our home world, for this. It was wise of [Sanv K'la](Sanv K'la) to have you seek me out, as I am both shocked and exhausted from what I endured on my excursion to my home world… to Draenor.

Sit, and listen to what I have to say.
progress: Please, I insist: sit down and make yourself comfortable.
completion: As you can see, what I have witnessed paints a grim picture for my brethren at the Harborage. I have led them to this world in search for safety, and now our past threatens to haunt us once more. I need to prevent this, yet alone I am unable to. Dear stranger, will you assist me like you assisted Sanv K'la?
notes:
-Speaking with Akh Z'ador**
The raw intensity seeping out of the ground is incredible. If I didn't know better, I'd say the land is bursting at the seams with magic.

  > Gossip: *Riftwalker, share your story with me.*

  I am of the Tribe of Sanv. Decades ago, when the orcish horde wrought destruction upon what remained of Draenor, our chieftain, the Rift Lord Sanv Tas'dal ordered the tribesmen to escape the dying world and seek refuge on another one. Sanv K'la and his brethren were under my guidance, using my riftmagic to tear open a gateway to Azeroth, your homeworld. Ironically enough, we escaped to the same place the orcs invaded.

  > Gossip: *What happened to your other tribesmen?*

  That is what I wished to uncover when I disappeared from the Harborage. Sanv Tas'dal is the most powerful riftwalker of the tribe since eons, so I had no doubt he would convene with us eventually. However, over the years I grew doubtful and began searching for him with my riftwalking. Leaving Sanv K'la and the others behind was painful, but for their and my own sake I needed to go.

  > Gossip: *What did you uncover?*

  Something I should've sensed way sooner. During my communication attempt with the remaining tribe on Draenor, I saw a glimpse of what the red wastes are nowadays. The land is crying in pain, the elements are raging and demons run abound. But what had happened to my drive shook me to my core. Now servants of the Burning Legion, practically enslaving themselves to them and abusing our sacred, ancient riftwalking for their cause. Unable to process what unfolded before my vision, I failed to notice Sanv Tas'dal locating me within the fabric of the Twisting Nether, interrupting my focus.

  > Gossip: *And then?*

  Interrupting a riftwalker is in most cases a death sentence. Luckily, I could escape such a fate. Instead, I was thrown through the Twisting Nether to this foreign place - with no means to return. Now that Sanv Tas'dal knows about my tribe's continued existence, I have now doubt in my mind that he will attempt to manipulate the Harborage into submission to the Legion.

  > Gossip: *Continue.*

  <Name>, your assistance is vital to my tribe's freedom. Please, aid me and you'll be forever in my people's debt.

title: Provisions for Refugees
objectives:
Bring 10 Young Thalassian Boar Flanks to Commander Anarileth in Brinthillien.
-[Young Thalassian Boar Flank](Young Thalassian Boar Flank)s (10)
description:
The Regency Council has bestowed upon me the responsibility of providing sustenance and shelter for all those who seek refuge in this land. A task, noble in intent, but one burdened by a stark lack of resources.

The local boar population is abundant, a potential source of nourishment for our people. However, the reality is harsh—many here lack the necessary equipment or skills to hunt them down. It falls upon shoulders willing and able to bridge this gap.

If you have the means and the skill, could you gather at least ten young boar flanks for our cause? It would be a tremendous help in easing the hunger that gnaws at the spirits of those who have sought safety here.
progress: You can find boars all over this valley.
completion: Thank you, <class>. Your willingness to contribute is like a small beacon of hope in the vast sea of our needs. It may seem like a mere drop amidst the ocean of challenges we face, but with each kind gesture, we inch closer to the restoration of our former glory.

title: The Second Wave
objectives:
Slay 7 Expedition Scouts and 7 Expedition Commandos for Warbringer Dar'nakk in Razor Hill in Durotar. 
- [Expedition Scout](Expedition Scout) (7)
- [Expedition Commando](Expedition Commando) (7)
description:
War is upon our lands, <class>.

The arrogant Kul Tirans think us weak and it is up to the brave sons and daughters of the Horde to teach them otherwise!

A second wave of their old fleet, the same we vanquished years ago, has landed just off our shores, posing a threat to our people.

On the southern edge of the Echo Isles, their scouts and commandos can be found, probing and plotting for their next move. Slay them in the name of the Horde, and return to me!
progress: Throw them back into the waves. Let the sea churn red with their blood.
completion: You have done well, but do not yet sing for victory: Our foe is as vicious as it is relentless.

title: Young and Foolish
objectives:
Interrogate the people of [Lakeshire](Lakeshire) and find out the truth. Report back to Mathias Shaw.
- Speak to [Foreman Oslow](Foreman Oslow)
- Speak to [Dorin Songblade](Dorin Songblade)
- Speak to [Magistrate Solomon](Magistrate Solomon)
description:
My agents have reported that a Scarlet caravan has started moving through various towns.

From what we know they have already gone to Lakeshire, Darkshire, Menethil and Southshore.

My only assumption is that whoever took over the Crusade after the events that transpired the Scarlet Monastery, Hearthglen and Stratholme has realised they've been running short on men.

I want you to go and speak to the people of Lakeshire. The locals should have at least seen something.
progress: How is your task going?
completion:
So we were right, this would've been valuable information if we didn't already receive another report.

Sorry about that, <name>. I will be needing your help once more.
notes:
-Speaking with Foreman Oslow**
I don't have much time for idle talk, <name>. I've got to get this bridge rebuilt before the rains come. I've finished every project on-time and under budget and I'm not about to start slipping now.

  > Gossip: *Anything strange happen recently?*

  Yes. A caravan with men and women dressed in scarlet passed through here. Many of our young ones followed them.

  -Speaking with Dorin Songblade**
I am really busy crafting this armor, so make it quick!

  > Gossip: *Anything strange happen recently?*

  Aye, our young ones left with them. Can you blame them? Look at this place.

  -Speaking with Magistrate Solomon**
Who is this <class> who goes before the Court of Lakeshire in the Kingdom of Stormwind? State your business within this township, <race>. The orc threat to the Kingdom is far too great to squander time in idle conversation.

  > Gossip: *Anything strange happen recently?*

  It's regrettable that our children left with those foolish zealots of the crusade in the middle of the night. Please, don't harm them. Send them back home to us.

title: Caravan Meets Caravan
objectives:
Follow the Caravan's route and look for clues.
- Find the [first clue](Dwarf Mountaineer)
- Find the [second clue](Oil Canister)
- Find the [third clue](Small Wooden Crate)
- Ask [Kixxle](Kixxle) if he saw anything
description:
The SI:7 have means of communication that reach us quite fast and believe it or not they are very reliable.

Sparing you any further details you should know that a dwarven caravan that was meant to reach Aerie Peak never made it out of the Wetlands.

The caravan lays in ruins and you can only find the mutilated husks of what used to be dwarves.

Our agents already poked around the zone but failed to find anything, they are currently trying to localize these newly recruited Scarlet zealots.

I'm not very sure how much of a detective you believe yourself to be, but I ask you to take a second look, maybe they missed something.

If you find the recruits, keep in mind that we aren't sure what manner of persuasion the Scarlets used to brainwash them, spare as many as you can and take them to Menethil.
progress: Now do you want to buy something or just bother me?
completion:
Listen here pal, I am trying to make a living, so you either buy something or scram!

Of course unless you got something else to talk about but make it quick!
notes:
-First clue**
Before you lies the body of a Dwarf Mountaineer.

  > Gossip: *Examine the body.*

  It appears that this dwarf wasn't only killed but also mutilated, the jaw was missing.

  -Second clue**
The canister was empty, its contents most likely were poured over what was still seemingly aflame.

  > Gossip: *Examine the canister.*

  -Third clue**
You are now certain that the new recruits were the ones to slaughter these dwarves.

The missing jaw however is something that raises your suspicions, your next thought would be to ask the Goblin that camps south of where you are, at the Crossroads if he was the one to sell them the oil.

  > Gossip: *Take Scarlet Recruit's Insignia Ring.*

  -Speaking with Kixxle**
Greetings, potential customer! I've got many rare herbs for sale. Take a look.

  > Gossip: *Were you the one to sell an oil canister to a group of men dressed in scarlet?*

  Yea boss, I sure did. I'm a merchant, you know. If I got it, I sell it.

  > Gossip: *Where did they go?*

  They went North I guess, following in the footsteps of that dwarven caravan. One of them said they'd wait by the bridge for an ambush or something. He didn't look like the sharpest tool in the shed, you get me?

  > Gossip: *Why didn't you stop them?*

  You're joking, right? There were like at least five of them!

title: The Means of Persuading

fields.name: The Means of Persuading
fields.previous: Are You True to Your Nature?

previous: Are You True to Your Nature?

objectives:
Use your persuasion skills to interrogate Vladeus.
- Obtain information from Vladeus
description:
During your many adventures through Azeroth you have faced several perils and foes, unlike the man present before you.

You are more than sure he's not a wicked sort and chose to approach this lightly, staying true to your nature.

With a table full of choices you pick the best means of persuasion and are ready to begin.
progress: The report seems incomplete, other than some basic information of the prisoner there's really nothing useful there.
completion: Reaching for the quill and ink, you note the information you extracted from Vladeus thus finalizing the report.
notes:
-Speaking with Vladeus Springriver**
What are they going to do to me? I am sorry for all I have done, I really am.

I regret all of it, and given the chance I will surely make amends.

  > Gossip: *Vladeus Springriver, from Lakeshire, is it?*

   Vladeus remains silent while slightly nodding his head, the nod is followed by a cough. You assume his throat was parched after being in chains for so long.

  > Gossip: *Offer water to Vladeus.*

  **Vladeus Springriver says:** Thank you, you're the one that captured me, right? I am grateful you spared my life but there's nothing I can tell you.

  > Gossip: *Please Vladeus, make this easier for both of us. You look like a decent man, the people of Lakeshire wanted me to bring all of you back.*

  *Vladeus cries.*
  **Vladeus Springriver says:** A bit late for that don't you think? Since you took the life of the rest, I have nothing to tell you, the man in the red hood would return home and ki... I have said too much.

  > Gossip: *There is nothing to fear with me at your side, the Alliance will protect your family. The Scarlet Crusade already failed so many times.*

  **Vladeus Springriver says:** Perhaps you are right. I didn't really want it to end this way, we were promised a better life, we... I... I didn't expect they'd make me kill innocents, you have to believe me!

  > Gossip: *I do, take my word for it. Who recruited you and why?*

  **Vladeus Springriver says:** I didn't see his face clearly, he was wearing a red hood and was simply laughing every few minutes. Looking back, it was the stupidest choice I have ever made. As to why they recruited us, I am not really sure. He said we would be taken to a hidden place of the Crusade to be trained, he was complaining that their number was low and since the death of two of their leaders they became broken. I think he mentioned a name, Aventis or Adentis?

  > Gossip: *Abbendis?*

  **Vladeus Springriver says:** Yes, that's the one! Please I don't know anything else, I wish to return home.

title: Seeking Justice or Vengeance?

fields.name: Seeking Justice or Vengeance?
fields.previous: Are You True to Your Nature?

previous: Are You True to Your Nature?

objectives:
Find out everything by any means necessary.
- Obtain information from Vladeus
description:
You've met many foes on your several adventures through Azeroth, for the first time something in you clicked.

How many more scum do you have to beat, maim and kill so that this twisted world gets its damnable peace?

The Scarlet Crusade has been a personal thorn in your sides as well, maybe it's time to deliver some sort of justice or is it vengeance?

With a table full of tools that will aid you to obtain what you need, you are ready to embrace your demons.
progress: The report seems incomplete, other than some basic information of the prisoner there's really nothing useful there.
completion: Reaching for the quill and ink, you note the information you extracted from Vladeus thus finalizing the report.
notes:
-Speaking with Vladeus Springriver**
Please, don't kill me, please!

I don't know anything else, please! I just want to go home.

  > Gossip: *You smash your right fist into his sides.*

   **Vladeus Springriver says:** Ugh, bastard! What was that for?
   Vladeus grits his teeth.

  > Gossip: *Silence mongrel, you will start talking before I do more than that.*

   **Vladeus Springriver says:** I won't te... tell you anything!
   Vladeus short speech is followed by a cough. You assume he must be thirsty after being chained for so long.

  > Gossip: *Last time I visited the Monastery I remember your people using this tool.

<You grab a hot poker and place it one Vladeus' neck.>

Now talk!*

  **Vladeus Springriver says:** I will say nothing to the one that murdered my companions!

  > Gossip: *Your COMPANIONS murdered innocents.

<You reach for the prongs.>*

  **Vladeus Springriver says:** Stop! Please stop, I will talk. I didn't want it to end up this way, I swear! The Red Hooded man said if we don't comply he'd kill my family, please, you have to understand!

  > Gossip: *He's not the one holding your life in his hands at this very moment.

<You push the prongs close to his face.>*

  **Vladeus Springriver says:** He... he said we were going to be taken to a hidden place to be trained. They were lacking numbers an- and since two of their leaders were dead they weren't doing very well. He also mentioned a name, Aventis or Adentis?

  > Gossip: *Abbendis?*

  **Vladeus Springriver says:** Yes, please, please. I don't know anything else.
   Vladeus is utterly terrified.

  > Gossip: *Kick him in the knee.*

   Vladeus squeals in pain, so harshly it'd be heard outside.

title: Thandol Span (quest)

fields.name: Thandol Span
fields.next: Are You True to Your Nature?

next: Are You True to Your Nature?

objectives:
Bring Vladeus Springriver back to Menethil Harbor and report back to Captain Stoutfist.
- Defeat Scarlet Recruits
- Bring Vladeus Springriver back to Menethil Harbor
- [Scarlet Recruit's Insignia Ring](Scarlet Recruit's Insignia Ring)
description:
Yeah bub that's all I know, now I don't say I deserve any kind of compensation for the information but it will highly be appreciated.

<Kixxle holds open his palm but you refuse to pay.>

Fine then, go on and follow the road to that bridge, Thandol Span or whatever, I hope those Scarlets get you for being such a prick!
progress: The Scarlet Crusade must be put to an end.
completion:
So this is all you could salvage from the idiots that willingly murdered our caravan, eh?

I’ll take him to the dungeon, good job.
notes:
The [Scarlet Recruit](Scarlet Recruit) ambush at the [Thandol Span](Thandol Span) is notorious for not triggering properly. In order to properly trigger the ambush, you must delete the [Scarlet Recruit's Insignia Ring](Scarlet Recruit's Insignia Ring) that is still in your inventory from  [60] [Caravan Meets Caravan](Caravan Meets Caravan), then abandon the quest and retake it from [Kixxle](Kixxle). Upon approaching the Thandol Span, two [Scarlet Recruit](Scarlet Recruit)s will appear from the shadows, soon followed by two more, and then finally [Vladeus Springriver](Vladeus Springriver) will appear. Beware, as the recruits can quickly swarm you and keep you stunned with Hammer of Justice.

  -Vladeus Springriver spawns**
  **Vladeus Springriver says:** For the Scarlet Crusade!

  -Vladeus Springriver is defeated**
  **Vladeus Springriver says:** Stop, I give up! Spare me, I will submit to imprisonment.

  -Speaking with Vladeus Springriver**
I am taking responsibility for what I have done, don't worry, I will follow you and behave.

  > Gossip: *I'm taking you to the local law enforcement.*

  **Vladeus Springriver says:** I understand.

  -Speaking with Captain Stoutfist**
I am taking responsibility for what I have done, don't worry, I will follow you and behave.

  > Gossip: *This man is the only survivor of the group that attacked the caravan that was meant to reach Aerie Peak. He has yielded, and I have spared his life.*

  **Captain Stoutfist says:** Great find. My boys and I will put him up in chains. Go get yourself an ale while we handle this.

title: Scarlet Aid
objectives: Travel to the Cathedral’s District of Stormwind and speak with Brother Crowley.
description:
My boys made preparation for the prisoner to reach Stormwind. His fate will be decided there since he’s part of their jurisdiction.

You were of great help and I am sure you want to poke around this thing even further. I might have a lead for you, not sure how much it will help though.

Under the Cathedral District’s Chapel there’s a priest in red robes. The intel I got from Shaw’s men says that his name is Brother Crowley and was sent by the Scarlet Crusade inside the city as an ambassador of sorts.

His mission was to recruit the willing to fight in the name of the Light or whatever stupid lie these Scarlets are telling to themselves.

In any case, Crowley hasn’t been that active. We are not sure if he’s the one to recruit these blokes but it’s worth a try.
progress: How can I assist?
completion:
Bold accusation, <race>, I almost feel offended.

I fear it was not me, things would’ve been simpler. I assume you got a name from your prisoner. Tell me what happened.
notes:
-Upon completion**
  **Brother Crowley says:** Brigitte Abbendis is the daughter of the former High General Abbendis and utterly hates the undead, which is not a surprise when it comes to the Scarlet Crusade, I know.
  **Brother Crowley says:** The issue is she'd go to any length and I mean any to achieve this purpose, given what you told me and the fate of the leaders she probably broke and went insane by now.
  **Brother Crowley says:** Last I heard she was in Tyr's Hand, but if there's a secret training place or whatever that prisoner called it the only one to know about it would be her, an information passed down from the Ashbringer to her father and from her father to her.
  **Brother Crowley says:** I am telling you, the Scarlet Crusade is indeed broken and we have seen better days but Abbendis will not stop at anything to take on the undead, be they Scourge or not.

title: The Price Of Information

fields.name: The Price Of Information
fields.previous: The Means of Persuading or;, Seeking Justice or Vengeance?

objectives: Report to Captain Stoutfist.
description:
You've extracted all the information you could get from Vladeus. Deciding you're done with him you let him rest and think about your next actions.

It seems news of Whitemane's death and the demonic influence over Stratholme reached the ears of Lady Abbendis, the last true leader of the Scarlet Crusade.

With one of her henchmen tricking young men and women to join their cause and force them into staying she's trying to regain some numbers.

You decide to report this to Stoutfist and ask for his opinion.
progress: <You are welcomed with nothing but a silent stare.>
completion:
It seems you got what you needed then, we will send the prisoner back to Stormwind so they decide his fate.

Whatever you did to obtain this information, I won't judge it, I just hope you are content with your own choices.

title: The Silver Covenant
objectives: Find [Commander Braedin](Commander Braedin) in the [Silver Covenant Camp](Silver Covenant Camp).
description:
I would spare you the intricacies of [Quel'dorei](Quel'dorei) politics. Nevertheless, it is imperative that you are informed. Our once-united nation has fractured into smaller factions, engaged in a regrettable bickering over influence and power. Witnessing this discord within our own ranks pains my heart, but it is a tempest we must weather.

<She pauses, a sense of resignation in her eyes.>

However, amidst this turmoil, there are those loyal to the broader vision. They have rallied beneath the banner of the [Silver Covenant](Silver Covenant), their camp positioned beyond the city to the west. I implore you to venture there and seek out Commander Braedin, my esteemed right hand. He has been diligently investigating the matter, and your assistance will be met with gratitude.
progress: Lady Windrunner shall lead us to victory!
completion: I see. I've been investigating the Blood Elf presence in this area for a considerable amount of time, but this is indeed grave news. If they truly have agents infiltrating even the city, swift and decisive action is imperative.
rewards:
You will receive:
-120 XP
-+150 [reputation](reputation) with [Silvermoon Remnant](Silvermoon Remnant)

title: Felstrider Retreat (quest)
objectives:
Find proof of the Blood Elf plot in [Felstrider Retreat](Felstrider Retreat).
-[Rommath's Orders](Rommath's Orders)
description:
Our... former brethren have fortified themselves in the mountain fortress of [Felstrider Retreat](Felstrider Retreat). They've been here even before we arrived to settle these lands, and I suspect they may be remnants of [Kael](Kael'thas Sunstrider)'s forces that did not sail to [Northrend](Northrend). Up until now, they haven't caused much trouble, and quite embarrassingly, we've been overlooking their presence. However, if what you say is true, they must be plotting something.

I need you to find evidence of their plot. Perhaps one of their soldiers carries orders that could shed more light on the matter. May the Light guide you, friend.
progress: Have you found anything?
completion:
Rommath?

That rat, that vermin! He's the one who betrayed [Vereesa](Vereesa Windrunner), siding with [Astalor](Astalor Sunsworn), and now this? He will hang for his treachery.

But first, deliver this news to Lady Vereesa. I sense there's something more to it...
rewards:
You will receive:
-850 XP
-+150 [reputation](reputation) with [Silvermoon Remnant](Silvermoon Remnant)

title: The Deeds of Sir Danuvis
objectives:
Bring The Deeds of Sir Danuvis to the Cathedral of Light in Stormwind.
- [The Deeds of Sir Danuvis (item)](The Deeds of Sir Danuvis (item)) (Provided)
description:
It has been a long, and exhausting journey. I have fought many battles, and vanquished many foes.

Before I left my home, I yearned to behold the Cathedral of Light following its restoration. Instead, I was told I would be sent here, rather than to the Embassy in Stormwind. I will not lie to say it hurt me, for I fear I may not see it at the end of all this.

I would still like to pay homage to the Cathedral, however, and I ask you, friend, to do it for me.

Bring this tome containing all of my deeds to the Cathedral of Stormwind, and let it be recorded, lest I fall unremembered on this forsaken edge of the world.
progress: Light's blessing, <name>. Have you come to join our service?
completion:
A Kul Tiran paladin gave you this book?

In Kul Tiras, the Holy Light is not as widespread as it is in Stormwind and Lordaeron; places where the tradition of the faith has long been established.

Yet I am gladdened to see that our church has touched the heart of such a worthy man. I will make sure all its contents are kept safe in our archives.

Thank you, and may the Light ever be with you, <name>.

title: The Dragonmaw Conflict
objectives:
Bring 20 Dragonmaw Heads from Dragonmaw Orcs in the Wetlands to Lieutenant Alverold at Anchor's Edge in the Barrens.
- [Dragonmaw Head](Dragonmaw Head) (20)
description:
During the Second War, Kul Tiras proudly put an end to Orgrim Doomhammer's ramshackled fleet. Others, however, eluded our grasp: The craven orcs of the Dragonmaw Clan, who brought us untold ruin astride their winged slave-beasts, took flight into the dark corners of the world.

All Kul Tiras craves vengeance against them, as it was by their fire that so many of our noble comrades faced agonizing deaths at sea.

The same fate was served to my own father, and I have not forgotten...

In the Wetlands, these Dragonmaw animals have had the gall to finally scurry out of their hiding holes. For this error, I will have their heads.

Do this, and you will prove yourself a friend of Kul Tiras.
progress: If it were in my power, I would nail their entire race to stakes and watch the life burn out of them. The way my people burned. The way my father died.
completion:
The souls of our honored dead sing of your name, <class>.

But there shall be no peace for me, not until all of Lord Daelin's murderers are dead and their accursed nations gone with them.

title: Back to Lady Windrunner
objectives: Report your findings to Vereesa Windrunner.
description: Make haste, <class>! You may still have time to stop [Rommath](Rommath)'s scheme. Go with the wind, and let no one know about this, but Lady Vereesa! The fate of our kin is in your hands.
progress: How was your investigation?
completion:
<Vereesa's countenance pales as you explain the situation to her.>

I... I didn't anticipate that it would be someone from the Regency Council, even in my darkest dreams. Who else is conspiring against us? [Voren'thal](Voren'thal)? [Astalor](Astalor)? This is profoundly grave news, <name>.
rewards:
You will receive:
-350 XP
-+150 [reputation](reputation) with [Silvermoon Remnant](Silvermoon Remnant)

title: Rommath, the Traitor
objectives: Report to Grand Magister Rommath. He can be found on the top of the Regency Tower.
description:
With the current situation in the [Regency Council](Regency Council), my hands are bound. No one but [Lor'themar](Lor'themar) would believe me, even with the letter in our possession. They would undoubtedly perceive my actions as an attempt to usurp the title.

However, all is not lost. If you can convince Rommath that you are, indeed, a delegation from [Felstrider Retreat](Felstrider Retreat), he may inadvertently reveal more about his plans. The letter is exceedingly vague, and this approach may unveil additional details. Go, but exercise caution to avoid exposing your true identity. Rommath is unpredictable, and he could dispose of you in the blink of an eye.

He is on the top of the tower.
progress: Who dares interrupt my meditation?
completion:
Ah, you are from Felstrider, correct? You are safe; no one can hear us.

<Rommath scrutinizes you, studying your face for an extended moment.>

Very well. I have made all the necessary preparations. If my calculations are correct—and they are—we should be able to establish contact with Prince Kael'Thas.

By the way, is everything well with [Eldin](Eldin)? That fool [Astalor](Astalor) has been attempting to amass a force to attack Felstrider, but he has been unsuccessful, as usual.

Good, good. Inform me when you are ready.
rewards:
You will receive:
-90 XP
-+150 [reputation](reputation) with [Silvermoon Remnant](Silvermoon Remnant)

title: The Power of Aqua
objectives:
Collect a Refined Aqua Core from the water elementals of Ashenvale for Hydromancer Shaleborn at Anchor's Edge in the Barrens.
- [Refined Aqua Core](Refined Aqua Core)
description:
It has been a long and arduous campaign for all of us. Through many months of struggle I made do with what implements I brought from Boralus, but my stocks are running dangerously low.

If I am to retain my dominion over water long enough to expedite the fleet on our return journey, I will require a new source.

To the northwest lies the foreign, bewitched forest of Ashenvale. I have scryed the presence of strong, yet volatile elemental spirits within the region's heart, in the Mystral Lake.

Travel there, claim a rare Refined Aqua Core from those beings and Kul Tiras will not soon forget your service.
progress:
Has the Aqua Core been recovered?

I know it may take you some time to find, but it is imperative it comes into my possession.
completion:
The Aqua Core, and even more potent than I had hoped!

In this arid land of beasts, mongrels and demi-humans, I dared not hold faith in assistance from anyone. But now, my control of the tidal elements is secured.

You have my thanks, <class>.

title: Kul Tiran Provisions: Food
objectives:
Collect 5 Kodo Meat from wild Kodo’s in the Barrens for Deckmaster Darkhollow at Anchor’s Edge in the Barrens.
- [Kodo Meat](Kodo Meat) (5)
description:
You there, RECRUIT!

I don’t see you wearing your tabard, what in- wait a second. What are you doing here <race>, do you not see that we Kul Tirans are at a war?

Bah, why don’t you make yourself useful, we are going to be needing all the provisions we can account for, perhaps you can find some spare food to feed some bellies for a few extra nights.

Each day we keep the Horde at bay, is another day you can sleep safe at night. How about some Kodo Meat from the beasts in the Barrens? The horde use the beasts as pack mules, fighting beasts, and breed them for food, their heavy flanks should serve well to feed a few squadrons.
progress: You get that food yet maggot?!
completion: Well, look at that, not even part of the Old Alliance, and still making yourself useful as a <race>. Perhaps you do have it cut out to be part of the navy after all.

title: Kul Tiran Provisions: Special Goods
objectives:
Collect the Smuggled Gunpowder from Ratchet and the Smuggled Procurements from Theramore for Deckmaster Darkhollow at Anchor's Edge in the Barrens.
- [Smuggled Gunpowder](Smuggled Gunpowder)
- [Smuggled Procurements](Smuggled Procurements)
description:
Nice work collecting that food recruit, you've done good work, even if you're not apart of our navy. If you're still looking to help out around here, I do have one last thing I need.

You see, as a Deckmaster it is my job to secure, and guarantee supplies for the boat, and since we are docked here for some time, I called in a few favors that just need to be picked up.

Down in Ratchet I have an order waiting for a barrel of Gunpowder, grab it for me, it should be tucked away on the left side of the bank there. Lastly, head to Theramore, it is a place that still holds many loyal allies, at the docks, there should be some docked ships, explore them, and find a crate stamped with a green anchor, bring that to me as well.
progress: So, you had any luck then?
completion:
Well, I was right to trust my hands in you. Perhaps not all is so bad in this 'New Alliance' afterall, or so I was believed to think you were all just too lazy to work on behalf of this war.

You've done well, and for your hard work, you've earned this commendation, wear it with pride soldier.
notes:
-Upon completion**
  **Deckmaster Darkhollow says:** Well done on your missions, recruit. You make Kul Tiras proud!

title: The Skardyn
objectives:
Listen to the tale of Sarthyss Scaleheart.
- Listen to Sarthyss
description: Now, mortal, listen well. If you are to grasp the gravity of what we face, you must first understand the skardyn and the vile origin that birthed them. Their story is one of betrayal, corruption, and a darkness that should have remained buried. Pay heed, for this knowledge is as dangerous as it is necessary.
progress: Dire times indeed.
completion:
Now you see the truth, mortal—clear as the moon over the frozen peaks. This skardyn sorcerer must be struck down before his vile work can seep further into the heart of this land. His very presence here is no accident; it is the herald of greater darkness, the echo of a curse long thought buried beneath stone and time.

Whatever foul purpose brought him to Grim Hollow, it festers like a wound—and if left unchecked, its rot will spread. These swamps, already choked with corruption, are but the beginning. Mark my words: the magic he weaves will not stop here. It will slither beyond the Hollow... to Dun Kithas, and perhaps even farther, poisoning the land, the skies, the very soul of Khaz Modan.
notes:
-Speaking with Sarthyss**

  After the civil war between the Bronzebeards, Dark Irons and Wildhammer clan, Thane Khardros of the Wildhammers led his people northward, passing through the barrier gates of Dun Algaz to forge a new kingdom within the mighty mountain of Grim Batol.

  Bitterness from the war festered like a wound. From his city of Thaurissan in the Redridge Mountains, Sorcerer-Thane Thaurissan of the Dark Irons plotted his vengeance. He unleashed a two-pronged assault against the Bronzebeards and the Wildhammers, seeking to claim all of Khaz Modan. While he marched against Ironforge, his sorceress wife, Modgud, led a separate force to assail the Wildhammers at Grim Batol.

  > Gossip: *<Continue>*

  Thaurissan's assault on Ironforge failed, and his forces were driven back. Yet, Modgud, wielding dark sorcery, had greater success. Her war golems battered the gates of Grim Batol, and she summoned living shadows from the depths of the earth to terrorize the dwarves within. The Wildhammers fought valiantly, their spirits unbroken despite the horrors they faced. Thane Khardros, with unyielding resolve, led his warriors into the heart of the battle. It was there, amidst the chaos, that he confronted Modgud herself. With one mighty swing of his hammer, Khardros struck her down, ending her dark reign.

  > Gossip: *<Continue>*

  The Wildhammers drove the retreating Dark Irons from their halls, but not all the invaders escaped. Those who delved too deep into Grim Batol's cursed depths were twisted by Modgud's vile magic, their bodies and minds corrupted until they became the skardyn—creatures of shadow and malice, far removed from their former selves.

  The curse that befell Grim Batol rendered it uninhabitable, its halls steeped in a darkness so profound that even the Wildhammers could not reclaim their home. The skardyn, however, thrived within this taint, claiming the deepest, darkest reaches of the fortress as their domain. Few knew of their existence, for the Red Dragonflight sealed Grim Batol after Modgud's fall. For centuries, its darkness was contained—until the Second War, when the Dragonmaw clan made the fortress their stronghold. Even then, the orcs dared only to occupy the upper levels, unwilling to venture into the depths where shadows held dominion.

  > Gossip: *<Continue>*

  Now, I fear the darkness has at last seeped into the hearts of the Red Dragonflight defenders who stood watch over Grim Batol. The corruption festering there may have broken their resolve, making it possible for the skardyn to emerge from their realm and spread their malevolence into the world once more.

  As for the powers that cursed Grim Batol and twisted the skardyn into what they have become—this knowledge is lost, even to me. Whatever forces are at work here are older and far mightier than we can comprehend. Take caution, mortal. The darkness within Grim Batol is no ordinary shadow—it is ancient, insidious, and ever hungry.

title: The Dragonmaw War (3)
objectives:
Recover the Banner of Baggoth from the top of [Baggoth Rampart](Baggoth Rampart) and return it to [Mountaineer Steelwind](Mountaineer Steelwind).
-[Banner of Baggoth](Banner of Baggoth)
description:
There's one thing I can't abide — leaving behind the banner of a true dwarven hero.

When the [Dragonmaw](Dragonmaw) overran [Baggoth Rampart](Baggoth Rampart), we were forced to retreat faster than I'd care to admit. In the chaos, our standard — the personal banner of [Commander Baggoth](Commander Baggoth) himself — was left behind atop the central tower.

It's more than just a piece of cloth. That banner stood through a dozen battles and carries the pride of every dwarf who served beneath it. Letting it remain in orcish hands is an insult we can't stomach.

Climb the rampart, fight your way through the Dragonmaw scum, and retrieve that banner. Bring it back in one piece. For Baggoth. For the Reaches.
progress: I'll not rest easy until that banner is back where it belongs.
completion:
You've done us proud, lad.

To see this banner again… aye, it stirs the heart. The orcs defiled our walls, but they couldn't claim our spirit.

With this flying once more above Dun Kithas, our people will remember who we are — and what we're fighting for.

Well done.
rewards:
You will receive:
-[Shield of Baggoth](Shield of Baggoth)
-2600XP
-+200 [reputation](reputation) with [Wildhammer Clan](Wildhammer Clan)
-+200 [reputation](reputation) with [Ironforge](Ironforge (faction))

title: The Sanv Charm
objectives:
Head to the Misty Valley and find the Sanv Charm.
-[Sanv Charm](Sanv Charm)
description:
The world we come from is a hellish place. One filled with danger, with demons, and hostile to life in all ways imaginable. Food was scarce, and water even scarcer. I led my people to the safety of this world through our magic by way of the Rift. In the ancient days, my people created a charm that attuned them to the old world, and it held great magic. This allowed for Riftwalking, the ability to travel great distances.

Much of this skill is lost to us now. From stories told to me by the older generations, it was much more powerful than the primitive means we currently use.

The Sanv Charm, a powerful item, was lost on one of my trips to the Misty Valley. I have been attempting to communicate with a Riftseeker that was from the Harborage. As I was attempting communication in the valley, swampwalkers approached and attacked me. I was unable to gather the charm, so I left it in a small chest and fled for my life. Get it for me. It is of great importance.
progress: The Sanv Charm must be recovered, outsider. Be quick.
completion: The Sanv Charm means a lot to me, outsider. The Sanv were once a large tribe in Outlands. Sadly, I am the only that remains. Let me prepare the communication with the lost one.

title: Draenic Communication
objectives:
Gather 6 Tangled Essence and a Marsh Murloc Eye for Sanv K'la.
-[Tangled Essence](Tangled Essence) (6)
-[Marsh Murloc Eye](Marsh Murloc Eye)
description:
[Akh Z'ador](Akh Z'ador) is a Riftseeker who led us to this world. He was one of the few of our kind that knew the magic of our ancient ancestors. He was skilled enough to bring our entire tribe here, and that of the Fallow Sanctuary, with the help of the other lesser Riftseekers.

A few weeks ago, he attempted to return to the old world in search of more exiles to bring to the Harborage. I suspect something went terribly wrong, for I could not detect his presence upon our old world with the Sanv Charm. You see, the magic he is using is old, and somewhat unstable. We barely understand its usage, and only the bright minds like Akh Z'ador can manipulate it enough to travel.

I need you to gather materials in order to cast a spell to find his location and see perhaps where it is he has gone. Local materials should work just fine. Gather six Tangled Essence from the Tangled Horrors to the east, and a Marsh-Murloc Eye from Murlocs at the coast.
progress: We must attempt to find Akh Z'ador, and quickly outsider.
completion: We shall begin the communication at once. Stand back, outsider. Our magic is unstable.

title: Finding Akh Z'ador
objectives: Find Akh Z'ador.
description:
My strength is sapped. I feel aged and weak, but I saw a city. A city that was submerged beneath the waves, as if the tides themselves had come and drowned it all. There were tall cliffs, massive in scale, and it seemed as if the spirits there wallowed in misery. Red leaves fell from the trees and a strong magic lingered and pulsated as if it wanted me gone. It weakened me and made it hard to focus.

I am certain that Akh Z'ador is on this world right now. He must have faced something on Outland and been forced to leave. That, or his rift's instability sent him to this foreign landscape.

This is but all I can remember, outsider. It seemed as if whatever resided there was strong -- much stronger than the wildlife here. Much stronger than even you. I beg of you to try to find Akh Z'ador wherever he may be, no matter how long it takes you.
progress: I come from a far away land, and I seek no hostility. What is it you need?
completion: Sanv K'la sent you? I am happy to hear his name once more. I thought I would never hear from him again, nor would I think he would send someone so far to seek me.

title: Rift Fatigue: Mind
objectives:
Bring Akh Z'ador in Azshara three Siren Brains for his ‘mental recovery'.
-[Siren Brain](Siren Brain) (3)
description:
Before we can tackle the saving of my tribe, we need to prepare, both myself and my belongings. Riftwalking is very taxing on the user's mind, an interrupted riftwalk even more so. Without my mental strength returned, a rescue will not be possible.

My people have discovered that a creature's brain can accelerate one's mental recovery immensely, if devoured. The more intelligent the beast, the quicker you feel renewed. Down at the shore I saw serpent people slither around, some of them casting spells on their own. Bring me a few undamaged brains from these spellcasters.

Let us hope your world's species are as smart as I envision them to be.
progress: It has been a long time since I've tasted brains.
completion:
<Akh Z'ador takes the slimy, bloody brains and chomps them piece by piece. It is revolting to look at.>

Hm, a bit on the spongy side, but not disgusting. I've had worse, trust me. Thank you, <name>, I can feel the mental weakness fading already.

title: Rift Fatigue: Body
objectives:
Akh Z'ador in Azshara requires herbs from the furbolgs to the west and flesh of the makrura to the east.

-[Zesty Makrura Claw](Zesty Makrura Claw) (6)
-[Timbermaw Herb Bundle](Timbermaw Herb Bundle) (10)
description:
Being exposed to the currents of the Twisting Nether is a dangerous act, its ramifications are still felt on my body. The draenei have ancient recipes, passed on between generations, to combat the side effects of prolonged riftwalking. While I do not have access to the traditional ingredients, I am sure the native wildlife here are fit enough to create a substitute cure.

When I ventured east to scout the area, I encountered intimidating creatures with big, meaty claws - their flesh should bring enough sustenance. To the west, not far actually, furry beings gather herbs of intense smell. Judging from their scent, I am certain they harbor medicinal properties. Bring me enough of both and I can cook a remedy for my tired body.
progress: Despite knowing many of my people's recipes, I am not a good cook. You can ask anyone in the Harborage, even [Noburo](Noburo) was considered a better cook than me!
completion: Zesty and spicy - a combination typical for draenei cuisine. Thank you for providing me with enough food to regain my vitality. Your kindness goes a long way, and I wish I could repay you with a traditional meal of my people, one prepared with ingredients from Draenor. But I digress, sentimentalities are of no use here.

title: The Riftwalker's Cane

fields.name: The Riftwalker's Cane
fields.previous: Rift Fatigue: Mind & Rift Fatigue: Body

objectives:
Return with Akh Z'ador's Riftwalker Cane and the Mojo of Jammal'an to Akh Z'ador in Azshara.
-[Akh Z'ador's Riftwalker Cane](Akh Z'ador's Riftwalker Cane)
-[Mojo of Jammal'an](Mojo of Jammal'an)
description:
Now that I feel rejuvenated, our next step is retrieving my most prized possession: my riftwalker staff. When I was stranded on the auburn grass of these cliffs, I was surrounded by rabid creatures left and right. One of them, horned fiends wielding sinister hexes and curses, their features reminding me of the terrors of the Burning Legion. While I lay defenseless on the ground, they approached me like predators descending on a wounded animal. Barely able to escape, I had left my riftwalker staff behind - a mishap hurting me deeply.

Regardless, even if we recover it, my failed riftwalk rendered it drained and useless. I need to infuse it with an echo of power - from an expert of forbidden arts. Back in the Swamp of Sorrows, a submerged temple towers over the canopies. Within, a masterly witcher resides exerting authority over dead trolls and dragons. End his influence over the temple and swamp; and bring a figment of his power to me.
progress: I am not naive to think our escape to Azeroth would shield us from every evil there is, yet I cannot feel disheartened by the fact a breeding ground of depravity would have its heart right at the center of our new home.
completion:
My cane! I've only seen it this disheveled after we escaped Draenor years ago. Eternal gratitude to you, <name>. And this… mojo, you call it? This swirling energy is completely foreign to me. Your world will probably never cease to bewilder me.

<Akh Z'ador hits his chest with his fist in respect for your deeds.>

title: Manifested Oddities
objectives: Speak with Akh Z'ador in the Harborage.
description:
Much needs to be done, the Harborage is in disarray and many have been injured. You have to excuse me, as I need to tend to my brethren. While any help would be appreciated, I must insist on leaving this to us for now. You have done enough already and it'd be rude to ask for more.

Before you depart however, Akh Z'ador wishes to speak with you again about something urgent. You can find him outside. Enkil Toralar, friend, and good tidings to you.
completion:
<name>, I thank you from the bottom of my heart for all you have done for the Harborage. Kas'tal managed to contact me just in time. Any later and I fear for what might've happened. Now, to what I wanted to talk with you about…

<Akh Z'ador presents a flawlessly round and shimmering teal crystal to you unlike anything you've seen before.>

What you see here is a pure draenethyst gemstone, one of the most rare commodities my people valued back on Draenor. Its status is akin to myth, although they are not the fairytale one might assume. Althoug it is just a theory, I assume this one was created between the clash of Tas'dal's and my own rift magic. I want you to have it, as thanks - but also as a promise. The draenei of the Harborage will aid you if needed, for without you, we'd be no more. Enkil Toralar, friend, and may the winds of the Twisting Nether be in your favor.

title: Highly Unexpected Event
objectives:
Kill Fazgel Mechaflame.
- [Fazgel's Shrink Ray](Fazgel's Shrink Ray)
description:
It's done! Quite boring little thing but you know gnomes, blah, I hate gnomes. No refinement when it comes to these things, just look at this thing, the perfect way to steal stuff, and not to mention increase your own profit!

This thing was only supposed to shrink the statues, but guess what, it can now enlarge them too! Anyway let's be done with it yeah, no reason to wait any longer.
progress: You stare at the statue with the engraved name once more and get ready to pull the trigger.
completion: As you push the button the shrink ray activates! Mumbling all sorts of sounds at first you start cursing the corpse of the goblin who built this, not only was he a double-crosser but he was no engineer! Or so you'd think, sooner than later the statue began to shrink, no weighing less, and could easily be placed in your backpack.
notes:
-Aggro**
  **Fazgel Mechaflame says:** Yeah, I don't think so bub!

title: A Historian Finds You
objectives:
Speak with Arcanist Sovatir.
- Speak with Sovatir.
description:
On a cold and rainy night you decide to once more look at the notes as they remind you of your own first haul. As you reminisce about the past you also remember the wish you've had to find a historian or someone knowledgeable enough to aid in the future.
