As thoughts drift through your mind you reach the end of Sovatir's journal and you find a rune accompanied by some words that felt very natural for you to say at this exact moment. As you mumble the incantation your head feels rather dizzy as you can now depict a ghostly figure that looks like the former owner of this journal.
progress: Am I dead?
completion: And so you have it <name>, or is it Captain <name>? I guess I'm a crewmate from now on, well, one only YOU can see.
notes:
-Speaking with Sovatir**

  I bear the knowledge of the Shen'dralar, I am a highborne of Eldre'thalas and I know a great deal about our world. Since you can aid me to gain even more knowledge I am at your service, Captain.

  > Gossip: *Arcanist Sovatir, how is this possible?*

  It seems death claimed me <race>, I am Sovatir, Arcanist and Lorekeeper of Eldre'thalas, I have placed a part of my soul and memories in that journal, when you spoke the incantation you brought it up. I should let you know that it ate at your life force however, not too much I trust.

  Since you're now the owner of the journal, you're also mine, my knowledge is yours as long as you keep me entertained and allow me to find even more. Do note, that nobody else can see me.

title: Errand for Quel'Danil

fields.name: Errand for Quel'Danil
fields.rewards: Choice of:, Greatblade of Quel'Danil,, Dagger of Quel'Danil, or, Bow of Quel'Danil

objectives:
Kill 10 Witherbark Sadist and 8 Witherbark Broodguards in Shadra'alor
- [Witherbark Sadist](Witherbark Sadist) (10)
- [Witherbark Broodguard](Witherbark Broodguard) (8)
description:
I hope it is not too much to ask for, but you look like the strong type.

The people of Quel'Danil are my family and they've been at odds with the terrible Witherbark Trolls for a long time! I am asking you to reduce their numbers, I don't want to see any more suffering, we have all lost so much already.

Shandra'lor hosts sadistic trolls and their pet spiders, I would like you to focus on those.

Once the job is done please report to my adoptive mother Voldana. She is deeper inside the lodge!
progress: Yes, <class>? What brings you here?
completion: You have my deepest gratitude, <class>, and of course I'll make sure to thank Loania, too. You must be curious why a human is among us. If you are interested, then I shall tell you...
notes:
-Upon completion**
  **Voldana says:** Loania and her sister Lieren are the daughters of a Human paladin named Dougan. I have known Dougan since the Second war when we fought the Horde together.
  **Voldana says:** During the Second war, Dougan, myself, and a dwarf of the Wildhammer clan known as Kardan were close companions. After the war, Dougan and his wife Adena settled down in Grand Hamlet.
  **Voldana says:** Grand Hamlet later fell under a curse and became known as Darkshire, but I digress. One day, Dougan heard reports of villagers disappearing in the nearby cursed tower known as Karazhan. He summoned Kardan and I, and together we entered the tower to attempt a rescue.
  **Voldana says:** It didn't go well, Karazhan was far more treacherous than we could have anticipated... Dougan didn't make it, and his wife subsequently lost the will to live. Kardan and I each adopted one of his infant twin daughters and raised them as our own.
  **Voldana says:** I believe the girls have a destiny before them, perhaps you will play a part in it too. For now, take this as your reward with my blessing.

title: An Extravagant Book
objectives:
Find the owner of the book.
- [Great Virtue](Great Virtue)
description: <The barrel appears to still be held together quite well and looks to be sturdy. Upon searching further, you find an extravagant book. It is certainly old but still has a golden thread on the spine. It has the label 'Great Virtue - Father Ben' written upon the front. Perhaps this belongs to someone.>
progress: Yes, child? Are you here to learn about the Light?
completion: Oh... I had left this book upon an elvish vessel quite some time ago. Did you manage to recover it? I must say, I had considered this lost after the news of what happened. Thank you so much, my child, for returning this book.

title: The Rotten Renown
objectives:
Find someone who can find a use for the Logbook of the Rotten Renown.
- [Logbook of the Rotten Renown](Logbook of the Rotten Renown)
description: <The chest appears to be covered in muck and incredibly damaged by the salty seawater. Inside, a few small items and a rather heavy book look well kept and quite elegant. Upon further inspection, it is obvious that this is the logbook of the pirate ship, 'Rotten Renown', and holds information that may be of use to someone.>
progress: Is there something that I can help you with?
completion: You found this in the wreck of the pirate ship? I must say, that is some rather adventurous exploring! This logbook will help us learn quite a lot about pirates' charts and patrol pathing and may help us locate some of their bases at sea.

title: Into the Dream I
objectives: Listen to the story of Ralathius.
description:
I am Ralathius, a servant of the Green Dragonflight. It is unusual to find me outside of the Dream, but there is a pressing reason for my presence here.

Our sacred realm has been tainted by an unknown darkness. This corruption emerged suddenly and without warning, spreading its foul touch throughout the Dream. Druids, dragons, and all denizens of the Dream are engaged in a valiant struggle against this insidious force, but we are facing significant losses.

Among those lost is Solnius the Awakener, a noble soul and one of Ysera's most cherished children. Solnius carried the responsibility of safeguarding our most sacred ritual, known as the Awakening. Yet, he has succumbed to the alluring whispers of the Nightmare, and now this sacred power rests in the hands of darkness.

Please, listen to my tale. He must be stopped at any cost.
progress: The Emerald Dream is in danger.
completion: So now you know. Solnius must be stopped.
notes:
-Speaking with Ralathius**
Hidden beneath the veil, a great shadow lurks within the dream, already much of my kind have been disturbed by the presence.

You may not know this, but the awakening has begun.

An ancient ritual of my kin intended to draw us from the dream, I have resisted its temptations already, but not all are willed so strong.

  > Gossip: *Tell me your tale Ralathius.*

  Are you familiar with what the Emerald Dream is, mortal?

  In essence, Azeroth and the Emerald Dream can be perceived as parallel reflections of each other, intricately intertwined yet distinct in their nature. The Emerald Dream acts as a mystical lens, offering a pristine vision of Azeroth untouched by mortal intervention.

  Within the Emerald Dream lies the original landmass of Kalimdor, unmarred by the cataclysmic Shattering, covered in lush, emerald-green forests that have flourished for aeons.

  > Gossip: *<Continue the story.>*

  Are you familiar with what the Emerald Dream is, mortal?

  In essence, Azeroth and the Emerald Dream can be perceived as parallel reflections of each other, intricately intertwined yet distinct in their nature. The Emerald Dream acts as a mystical lens, offering a pristine vision of Azeroth untouched by mortal intervention.

  Within the Emerald Dream lies the original landmass of Kalimdor, unmarred by the cataclysmic Shattering, covered in lush, emerald-green forests that have flourished for aeons.

  > Gossip: *<Continue the story.>*

  Visitors from the waking world of Azeroth, both sentient and wild, unknowingly or knowingly, find themselves wandering into this ethereal domain.

  These creatures enter the Dream through their slumber, bringing with them the whispers of the mortal realm. In this enchanted realm, dreams take on a profound significance, often weaving visions of prophecy and guidance for those who dare to listen.

  > Gossip: *<Continue the story.>*

  The Emerald Dream stands as the dominion of Ysera, the venerable Green Aspect, and we, the green Dragonflight, stand steadfastly by her side, resolute in our duty to protect this realm at all costs.

  The majority of our kin dwell within the Dream, their spirits and physical forms intertwined with its ethereal embrace. Ages ago, guided by her infinite wisdom, Ysera selected one of our own, Solnius, to fulfill the pivotal role of the Awakener.

  Bestowed with the power to rouse the green dragons from their slumber within the Dream in the face of dire perils, Solnius held a position of great responsibility.

  > Gossip: *<Continue the story.>*

  However, none among us could have foreseen the insidious emergence of the Nightmare. The Nightmare, a malevolent force of unknown origin, engulfs everything it touches, leaving naught but ruin and madness in its wake.

  Alas, Solnius has succumbed to the clutches of this vile corruption, his very essence ensnared within the grasp of the Nightmare.

  > Gossip: *<Continue the story.>*

  We must prevent Solnius from awakening our kin from the Dream. Should their physical forms return to the mortal realm while fragments of their souls remain tethered to the Dream, they shall become profoundly susceptible to the insidious corruption of the Nightmare.

  The corruption shall permeate their souls, eventually corrupting their physical forms, and the Nightmare shall find its pernicious path into Azeroth - a force that knows no bounds and defies all attempts to halt its advance.

  > Gossip: *<Continue the story.>*

  Our only hope lies in the daunting task of halting Solnius and restoring him to the embrace of the Dream, even if it means resorting to the ultimate act of ending his life. It is our only hope.

title: Answers from Father

fields.name: Answers from Father
fields.previous: Hooves and Horns, Clad in Red

previous: Hooves and Horns, Clad in Red

objectives:
Confront Moro'gai K'la in Moro'gai Village about your newfound insights. 
- Confronted [Moro'gai K'la](Moro'gai K'la)
description:
This new god Bhu'robi talks about in the letter… us draenei have never prayed to any god, but instead worshipped the grandeur of the Draenethyst, symbol of the lifeblood of our homeworld. To even think a draenei would devote itself to a singular entity is bewildering, to put it bluntly.

Father must've known that the Elder had forsaken his faith in the Draenethyst, he must've. <name>, we should confront him about what we have learned. Perhaps we can convince him to tell us the truth. Go ahead, I will follow shortly.
progress: <The chieftain gazes into the horizon with a melancholic expression.>
completion:
My son has matured a lot in these past years, it seems. Another regrettable thing I have failed to notice. He is becoming a man far sooner than I had given him credit for.

Ar’lia is right. The time of lamentation and idleness is over. We have not survived one genocide to succumb to another conducted by our own kin. Raise your arms, <name>. We will silence this false prophet.
notes:
-Confronting Moro'gai K'la**
  **Moro'gai K'la says:** My son? What is the meaning of this?
  **Ar'lia says:** Father, you haven't told me the truth, have you?
  **Moro'gai K'la says:** Ar'lia, just what are you talking about? What are you accusing me of?
  **Ar'lia says:** Don't deny it, Father. We have discovered Bhu'robi's true goal. It was never merely a simple dispute about our traditions and beliefs, was it? Tell us what really happened that night you talked.
  **Moro'gai K'la says:** Son, your words are bold and unruly towards me, your father. They cut deep, but can only do so because they are the truth. Yes, I hid things from you, out of shame and in fear of my own weakness.
  **Moro'gai K'la says:** Bhu'robi had always been critical of our ways, especially after our escape to this world. Our inaction towards the advances of the demonic orcs, while possessing the power of the Draenethyst, is a flaw he was deeply revolted by.
  **Ar'lia says:** But the Draenethyst are sacred relics to the draenei. Out of all people, he should've known this the most as an Elder.
  **Moro'gai K'la says:** My son, tell me: if you were in mortal danger, would you not do everything you can to survive? In such situations, rationality often subsides in favor of our instincts. Bhu'robi knew this all too well. I still remember his last words to me as if they were uttered mere moments ago.
  **Moro'gai K'la says:** You are shackled by your traditions, stuck in the mire of your self-inflicted lethargy. If you wish to rot dwelling on the past, so be it. But I will usher in a new dawn for our people. And then you will see the truth yourself.
  **Ar'lia says:** Bhu'robi...
  **Ar'lia says:** I have much to contemplate, father. Before I leave, let me say this: The father I knew would have taken action in the face of danger. Just like he braved the horrors of Draenor. With resolve and determination.
  **Moro'gai K'la says:** Ar'lia...

title: Yor'thegg's Ritual
objectives:
Gather 5 Ornate Feathers, 3 Binding Flame, and a Pristine Stonehide Heart for Yor'thegg the Wise in Grim Reaches. 
- [Ornate Feather](Ornate Feather) (5)
- [Binding Flame](Binding Flame) (3)
- [Pristine Stonehide Heart](Pristine Stonehide Heart)
description:
The situation is as I feared, the land is corrupt, and in a state of turmoil. I will need to commune with the elements at haste.

This ritual will require local, natural materials to conduct. First, I require five Ornate Feathers from the nearby thrashers. Three Binding Flame from the Dragonmaw Flamebinders to the northwest. And finally, I require a single pristine Stonehide Heart from the Elder Stonehide Boars. Gather all of these materials, and return to me.
progress: The land yearns for peace, and it is our responsibility to comply.
completion: The materials have been gathered. You have done your duty, now let me conduct mine...
notes:
-Upon completion**
  **Yor'thegg the Wise says:** Elements of Grim Reaches, hear me, for I have come to listen!
  *An [Anguished Elemental](Anguished Elemental) appears.*
  **Anguished Elemental says:** Long has it been since we have been heard... The land is disturbed, the airs stir with volatility. A foul magic poisons all it touches...
  **Anguished Elemental says:** Return the balance to the land, and bring harmony, once again...The Grim Hollow... The Flame of Dagnoth, banish the corruption within...
  *The Anguished Elemental disappears.*

title: Through Greater Magic
objectives:
Find the Eye of Xythos in Desolace, then return to Dark Bishop Mordren at Stillward Church in Gilneas.
- [Eye of Xythos](Eye of Xythos)
description:
The wretched Greymane forces, perpetrators of my demise and desecrators of my church. Why did they target me?

The answer remains an enigma, yet I sense it is intertwined with the significance of this place. Centuries ago, a battle unfolded upon this very hill, where the forces of Gilneas, against all odds, triumphed over Arathor. I am convinced that the key to their triumph lay buried within these grounds, and the Regent's bloodlust coveted this dormant power for their own malevolent purposes.

We must delve deep into this mystery. Unearthing such power would bestow upon us a formidable advantage. I shall sift through these weathered tomes, unearthing knowledge that may shed light on our quarry.

In the interim, I ask you to embark on a perilous journey to Desolace. There, amidst the demons, seek out and retrieve the Eye of Xythos—an artifact rumored to possess the ability to uncover the secrets of the past... if one can channel the energies of the Forgotten Shadow, of course.
progress: Eye of Xythos is rumored to be in the possession of the Shadow Council in Desolace. I have caught wind of dark whispers that speak the name... Shadowbreak.
completion:
The Eye... Ah, yes. Its malevolent aura was unmistakable as you drew near.

Draw nearer still. Through tireless research and countless tomes, I have unearthed a revelation of great intrigue. It appears that during the fabled Battle of Stillward, the first Greymane wielded an unfathomable darkness.

Now, with the Eye of Xythos firmly in my grasp, I shall delve into the depths of time itself. I seek to unveil the true nature of this formidable power that we now confront.
notes:
-Upon completion**
  **Dark Bishop Mordren says:** Now witness... The Eye!
  **Dark Bishop Mordren says:** I see... Stillward as it was... the battle.
  **Dark Bishop Mordren says:** This cannot be. A Greymane... holding such power.

title: Endless Vigil
objectives: Travel to Narvalis Point on Moonwhisper Coast and offer your services to Sentinel Commander Silverstreak.
description:
We are the Sentinels. We swore an oath to protect the lands of Kalimdor. Distance does not weaken that duty, and time does not erase it.

I have heard reports of strange events along the forgotten shores of Moonwhisper.

These lands were once a jewel of our empire. Now they lie abandoned. Nendis was broken when the Betrayer and his naga struck, and its scars still remain.

Even so, we cannot allow darkness to take root where vigilance has faded.

I have sent one of my commanders ahead. She has made camp near the ruins of Elun’aran, once a thriving town. Seek her out. Lend her your aid, and let your actions honor the oath we all share.
progress: Welcome to Narvalis Point.
completion:
You have seen it, I am certain. The corruption that grips this land. The twisted creatures that now call it home.

The Sentinels will not allow this suffering to continue. These shores are part of Kalimdor, and they will not be abandoned to darkness.

By oath and by duty, we will bring justice to this place. When the corruption is cleansed, peace will follow.

title: An'she's Respite (quest)
objectives:
Slay 12 Shadewalker Bonerattlers, 8 Shadewalker Brutes and 8 Shadewalker Sharpshooters at An'she's Respite, then return to Sentinel Commander Silverstreak at Narvalis Point.
- [Shadewalker Bonerattler](Shadewalker Bonerattler) slain (12)
- [Shadewalker Brute](Shadewalker Brute) slain (8)
- [Shadewalker Sharpshooter](Shadewalker Sharpshooter) slain (8)
description:
The tauren of these lands have never been our enemies.

We keep our distance. They keep theirs. Sometimes we even trade. It is not friendship, but it is peace, and peace is rare enough in these times.

That is why this troubles me.

A splinter group has taken refuge at An’she’s Respite to the south. They no longer answer to their chieftains, and they do not behave like the tauren we know.

My sentinels approached them under banner of parley. Two of my sisters did not return.

Something has twisted them. Madness, corruption, or some darker influence. I do not yet know which. What I do know is this: they are attacking anyone who passes near their camp. I will not allow that threat to remain at our doorstep.

Travel to An’she’s Respite and cut them down before their violence spreads any further.
progress: Tauren are formidable opponents. Their strength alone is enough to shatter shields and bones alike. Do not let their size fool you into thinking them slow.
completion:
So it is done.

I take no satisfaction in this. Still… if they had been left unchecked, more would have died. We will keep watch on the rest of their tribes. If this corruption spreads, we will know. Until then, Narvalis Point remains secure. That is what matters.
rewards:
- You will receive: [Boots of Krethis](Boots of Krethis)
- 5100 [XP](XP)

title: Scales of the Tideblade
objectives:
Bring 30 Tideblade Scales to Sentinel Commander Silverstreak at Narvalis Point.
- [Tideblade Scale](Tideblade Scale) (30)
description:
The naga have infested the ruins of Nendis like parasites. Once it was a quiet settlement of our people. Now the streets are flooded with serpents loyal to the Betrayer. Their warriors call themselves the Tideblade. Veterans of the army Illidan unleashed when he first struck these shores.

We have skirmished with them for weeks, but they are persistent. For every naga we slay, two more seem to slither out of the surf. If we are to weaken their presence here, we must thin their ranks directly.

Go to the ruins of Nendis and hunt the Tideblade naga. Bring me thirty of their scales as proof of their deaths.
progress: Watch the water. Naga favor ambush. They will wait beneath the surface until you step too close to the shore. More than one patrol has learned that lesson the hard way.
completion:
Thirty scales.

<She turns one over in her gauntleted hand, inspecting the deep green sheen.>

These belonged to seasoned warriors. Killing this many will have been noticed among their ranks.

Good.

Still... their true leaders remain. And until they fall, the Tideblade will not abandon these ruins.

title: Serpents Without Heads

fields.name: Serpents Without Heads
fields.rewards: Choice of:, Moonlit Hauberk, or, Moonstride Leggings

objectives:
Slay Lady Serpentia and Lord Ta'jax in the ruins of Nendis, then return to Sentinel Commander Silverstreak at Narvalis Point.
- [Lady Serpentia](Lady Serpentia) slain
- [Lord Ta'jax](Lord Ta'jax) slain
description:
You have proven the naga can bleed. Now we make certain they cannot recover. Two commanders direct the Tideblade forces occupying Nendis. Veterans from the day Illidan’s armies burned the town to the ground.

Lady Serpentia.

Lord Ta'jax.

They served as lieutenants during the assault. It was their warbands that swept through the streets while the town burned. They have ruled the ruins ever since.

If the Tideblade are to lose their hold here, those two must fall. Without their leadership the naga will fracture into smaller broods, easier to drive back into the sea.

The naga have ruled those ruins long enough.
progress:
Do not underestimate them.

These two commanded armies during Illidan’s campaign. They survived battles that slaughtered hundreds.

Creatures like that do not fall easily.
completion:
Lady Serpentia… and Ta'jax as well.

<For the first time, Silverstreak allows herself a small, satisfied nod.>

Good. Very good.

Without them, the Tideblade will splinter into rival broods. Naga are not known for unity when strong leaders are absent. That gives us the advantage. The ruins of Nendis may finally know peace again.

The High Priestess should hear of it.

title: Word to the High Priestess
objectives: Bring news of the victory at Nendis to Tyrande Whisperwind.
description:
Narvalis Point stands secure, thanks in no small part to your actions.

The naga presence in Nendis has been broken, and their commanders lie dead. For the first time since Illidan’s invasion, the ruins may finally be free of their grasp. Still, this victory belongs not only to my sentinels.

The High Priestess must be informed.

Tyrande Whisperwind watches over all our people, and she should know what has been accomplished here. The fall of Illidan’s lieutenants is no small matter.Travel to her and deliver this news.

Tell her the Tideblade are broken, and that Narvalis Point still stands vigilant.
progress: Yes?
completion:
Lady Serpentia and Ta'jax are dead?

Those names were spoken often during the war against Illidan. Their warbands left scars along this coast that have not yet faded. If they have truly fallen, then one of the last shadows from that time has finally been lifted.

Nendis has been silent for far too long. With the naga driven out, the ruins may finally be reclaimed. Not quickly. Wounds like these take time to heal. But in time… our people will return. Homes will be rebuilt. Temples restored. The forests will hear our voices again.

Moonwhisper Coast was once a place where the kaldorei lived in peace beneath Elune's light. Perhaps, slowly, it may become so again.

You have helped make that future possible, <class>. Know that the sentinels of Narvalis Point have my gratitude… and so do you.

title: The Moth's Heresy
objectives:
Slay 8 Druid of the Moth, 8 Disciple of Lo’sho, 8 Lucid Dream Protector, and 8 Lucid Dream Stalker in the Grove of the Moon, then return to Arch Druid Renethra at Narvalis Point.
- [Druid of the Moth](Druid of the Moth) slain (8)
- [Disciple of Lo'sho](Disciple of Lo'sho) slain (8)
- [Lucid Dream Protector](Lucid Dream Protector) slain (8)
- [Lucid Dream Stalker](Lucid Dream Stalker) slain (8)
description:
The wilds whisper to those who know how to listen.

Most hear the wind in the trees. The rustle of leaves. The quiet breath of the forest at rest.

And lately… the forest has been uneasy.

To the south lies a place once known as the Grove of the Moon. A quiet sanctuary where druids studied the cycles of sleep, dreams, and the hidden paths of the Emerald Dream.

But those who dwell there now no longer follow Cenarius’ teachings.

They call themselves the servants of the Moth.

Strange rituals. Distorted dreams. They have begun shaping the wilds according to their own designs, ignoring the balance that has guided druids since the first teachings of Malorne’s son.

Such arrogance always leads to ruin.

Travel to the Grove of the Moon and thin their ranks. End eight Druids of the Moth, eight Disciples of Lo’sho, eight Lucid Dream Protectors, and eight Lucid Dream Stalkers.

Perhaps when enough of them fall, the rest will remember what it means to be druids.
progress:
Be wary when dealing with druids who have abandoned balance.They still wield the same powers we do. The Dream still answers them… though it should not.

That alone makes them dangerous.
completion:
So the grove has been quieted… for now.

I hoped the corruption had not spread this far, but the signs are unmistakable. These druids no longer serve the balance of the wilds. Something has guided them down this path.

The Grove of the Sun on the Isle of Tyrandas may hold answers. One of my allies tends the groves there.

Seek out Sister Mirallun. She watches the forest more closely than most. Tell her what you have seen.

title: A Dryad's Counsel
objectives: Speak with Sister Mirallun in the Grove of the Sun on the Isle of Tyrandas.
description:
If the corruption in the Grove of the Moon spreads further, we will face more than a handful of misguided druids.

We will face a wound in the wilds themselves.

Sister Mirallun watches over the Grove of the Sun on the Isle of Tyrandas. She is a child of the forest, born of the old woods, and her senses reach far deeper into the living world than ours.

If something is stirring within these lands, she will know.

Travel to the Grove of the Sun and speak with her. Tell her what you witnessed in the Grove of the Moon.
progress: Yes?
completion:
The Grove of the Moon has fallen to them as well?

I had feared as much.

The forest has been restless for many nights now. Roots twist where they should grow straight. Dreams drift through the groves where none should linger.

The corruption runs deeper than a single grove.

title: The Rot of Elun'aran
objectives:
Slay 10 Sisters of Rot, 10 Whispering Satyrs, and 5 Rotting Ancients in Elun’aran, then return to Sister Mirallun in the Grove of the Sun.
- [Sister of Rot](Sister of Rot) slain (10)
- [Whispering Satyr](Whispering Satyr) slain (10)
- [Rotting Ancient](Rotting Ancient) slain (5)
description:
The corruption you saw in the Grove of the Moon is only the beginning.

To the north lies Elun’aran, a sacred village once tended by druids who honored both the forest and the moon.

Now it festers.

The same druids who abandoned Cenarius’ teachings have spread their influence there. Their rituals twist the land, and creatures of rot now roam beneath the ancient trees.

Even some of my own kin have fallen.

Dryads corrupted by their magic now call themselves the Sisters of Rot. Satyrs whisper in the shadows, feeding the madness that spreads through the groves.

And the ancients… the great guardians of the forest… they have begun to decay while still walking.

This cannot continue.

Travel to Elun’aran and cleanse the grove. Slay ten Sisters of Rot, ten Whispering Satyrs, and five Rotting Ancients.
progress:
Do not linger too long in Elun’aran.

The forest there no longer dreams peacefully. Something darker watches through its roots.
completion:
You have done what was necessary.

The forest breathes a little easier already.

But the druids who began this corruption still remain… and one of them leads the others.

title: Keeper of the Broken Grove
objectives:
Slay Keeper Krothis in Elun’aran and return to Sister Mirallun.
- [Keeper Krothis](Keeper Krothis) slain
description:
The druids behind this corruption do not act alone. Their leader is a keeper of the grove named Krothis.

Once he was respected among the druids of these lands. A guardian of the forest, patient and wise. Many sought his counsel when the wilds fell out of balance.

Now he serves another. The druids you fought speak of a figure they call Mothshroud.

Long ago, before many of these groves fell silent, an archdruid guided the druids of this region. A teacher of dreams, of night, of the hidden places between waking and the Emerald Dream. He walked paths few druids dared to study.

In time, those paths carried him somewhere… we could no longer follow. He vanished, and the groves slowly returned to simpler teachings.

But it seems his shadow has returned. Krothis now serves Mothshroud, carrying out his will across the groves.

If the forest is to heal, Krothis must fall.
progress: Krothis was once a keeper of the grove. Creatures like that do not fall easily and those who follow Mothshroud rarely fight alone.
completion:
Krothis has fallen…

The forest mourns when a keeper dies, even one who lost his way.

Without Krothis guiding them, the corrupted druids will scatter. Some may yet remember the teachings they abandoned.

Others will follow Mothshroud deeper into shadow.

This is not the end of the matter. If Mothshroud truly walks these lands again, then the groves face a danger older than most remember.

But for now, the forest breathes a little easier.

You have done well.

title: Led Astray

fields.name: Led Astray
fields.rewards: Choice of:, Bloom of the Sun,, Keeper's Boots,, Crown of Bandalar, or, Dryadroot Necklace

objectives:
Stop the misguided druids on Tyrandas and return to Keeper Bandalar in the Grove of the Sun on Tyrandas afterwards.
- [Misguided Naturalist](Misguided Naturalist) slain (10)
- [Adherent of Mothshroud](Adherent of Mothshroud) slain (10)
- [Withered Druid](Withered Druid) slain (20)
- [Deranged Druid](Deranged Druid) slain (20)
description:
Our brothers and sisters of the Grove of the Moon have begun treading a misguided path towards destruction. They have abandoned Cenarius' teachings, desecrated his enclaves and endangered countless other peaceful druids. As a warden of nature, I cannot let this transgression pass.

<name>, the intruders have laid claim to Elun'aran and the temple above, pillaging its sacred ruins for powerful artifacts. Stop them and return to me afterwards.
progress: Whatever they hold in higher regard than my father Cenarius, it must be immensely powerful.
completion: It pains me it had to come to this, but their delusions have brought them too far away from redemption. For the sake of nature and its inhabitants, they had to return to the cycle.

title: Feathers on Point
objectives:
Bring 12 Azureshimmer Hippogryph Feathers to Elendon Truebough at Narvalis Point on Moonwhisper Coast. You can find them scattered throughout Moonwhisper Coast.
- [Azureshimmer Hippogryph Feather](Azureshimmer Hippogryph Feather) (12)
description:
Narvalis Point may look quiet, but quiet places still need defenders. Sentinels patrol these woods day and night. Most people see their glaives and forget the other half of their craft.

The bow.

<Elendon lifts a bundle of unfinished arrows from his workbench.>

Good arrows are not simple things. Straight shafts, balanced heads… and proper fletching. Without the right feathers, even the finest arrow will fly crooked. Normally we would import materials from deeper kaldorei lands, but supply lines to this coast are… unreliable.

Fortunately, the forests here offer an alternative. Azureshimmer hippogryphs nest along the cliffs and high branches of the surrounding woods. Their feathers are light, strong, and remarkably stable in flight. Perfect for sentinel arrows.

I only need a handful. Gather twelve of their feathers and bring them to me. Do try not to harm more hippogryphs than necessary. They are proud creatures, and they have lived on this coast far longer than we have.
progress: Take care when approaching the hippogryphs. They are not hostile by nature, but they defend their nests fiercely. If one takes flight above you, keep your eyes open. They strike from the air faster than most people expect.
completion:
Ah, excellent feathers.

<Elendon runs one of them between his fingers, testing its strength.>

See the structure along the spine? Flexible, but firm. That is exactly what we need. With these I can finish a proper batch of arrows. The sentinels will appreciate the difference the next time they loose a volley across the treeline.

You have my thanks, <class>.

title: Echoes of Nendis
objectives:
Recover 30 Nendis Mementos from the ruins of Nendis and return them to Talanis Amberscribe in Narvalis Point on Moonwhisper Coast.
- [Nendis Memento](Nendis Memento) (30)
description:
Nendis.

Even after all these years, the name still lingers in my mind. A place where the people of our kind once lived in quiet devotion to the forests and the moon.

When Illidan and his naga came to these shores, Nendis was among the first places to fall. The town burned in a single night. Those who were not slain fled into the wilds… and many never returned. What remains now are only ruins. Broken homes. Collapsed towers. And memories scattered in the dust. The naga infest the place these days. They crawl through the streets where our people once walked.

History deserves better than to be left in their coils.

Go to the ruins of Nendis, to the south. Search what remains of the town and recover what relics you can. Letters, charms, fragments of old tools… anything that once belonged to those who lived there.

Bring me thirty such mementos.
progress: Take care while you search the ruins. Even the smallest relic may hold a story worth remembering.
completion:
Ah… yes.

<Talanis carefully lifts one of the objects you recovered, turning it slowly in the light.>

A child’s carving knife. See the worn handle? Used for years. Passed from hand to hand, perhaps. And this… a moon pendant. The silverwork is crude, but earnest. Likely made by someone learning their craft.

<He exhales quietly.>

Thirty small pieces of a forgotten life. That is what you have brought me. History is not only written in great battles and kings, you know. Sometimes it survives in the things ordinary people carried with them each day. Thank you for retrieving these, <class>. The naga may have taken the town, but they will not erase its memory.

title: The Light of Elunaris
objectives:
Find the source of power within the Temple of Elunaris on the Isle of Tyrandas and return it to Talanis Amberscribe in Narvalis Point on Moonwhisper Coast.
- [Relic of Elunaris](Relic of Elunaris)
description:
You have done well recovering those relics from Nendis. More than I hoped for, if I am honest. But there is another place nearby whose story troubles me far more.

To the east lies the Isle of Tyrandas. In older texts it is called a place of quiet reflection. Long before the great temples rose in our cities, priestesses of Elune once trained there. At its center stood the Temple of Elunaris. A modest sanctuary by the standards of later ages, but deeply revered in its time. The priestesses who studied there were said to guard a sacred artifact, one touched by the moon’s light itself.

The temple was abandoned long ago. Time and war saw to that. Yet some of our oldest records insist the artifact was never removed. If it still rests within those ruins, it would be a relic of immense historical value… and perhaps spiritual importance as well.

Travel to the Temple of Elunaris on the Isle of Tyrandas. Search the sanctuary and discover what power still lingers there.
progress: Now, the maddened druids and their lackeys walk in these once sacred halls. Be wary.
completion:
So… it truly remained there all this time.

<Talanis studies the artifact in silence for a long moment.>

Remarkable. The craftsmanship alone places it centuries before the founding of Zin-Azshari. And the lunar resonance… yes, I can feel it even now. This was no mere ceremonial piece. It was used. Studied. Revered. The priestesses of Elunaris must have trained beneath its light, learning to channel Elune’s blessing through it.

You have brought back more than a relic today. You have returned a fragment of our past that might otherwise have vanished with the temple itself.

title: Sunsworn Expedition
objectives: Find what remains of Andanil’s expedition on Moonwhisper Coast.
description:
Ah. An adventurer.

<Astalor’s lip curls slightly.>

How fortunate... I find myself in need of someone… expendable.

I dispatched my cousin, Andanil, to the distant shores of Moonwhisper in northern Kalimdor. The task I entrusted to him was of significance. Regrettably, his competence was not.

It has been weeks. No word. No report. No reassurance that he has not embarrassed our name beyond repair.

<Astalor places a hand to his chest, his expression shifting into a pale imitation of concern.>

I would be… devastated… if some misfortune befell him.

You will travel to Moonwhisper. You will determine his condition. If, by some miracle, he is alive and the mission proceeds as intended, you will observe and report. If it is not, you will ensure that it does.

Ships bound for Kalimdor depart from Windrunner Pier. Do not keep me waiting.
progress: A friendly face? Here?
completion:
Oh, thank the Light.

Astalor finally sent someone. Good. Very good. I was beginning to think he had… forgotten.

As you can see, everything here is proceeding exactly as planned. Perfectly, even. Nothing has gone wrong. At all.

The expedition force is… mostly intact. Entirely intact, really. I certainly did not lose most of it. That would be absurd.

And even if I had, which I have not, the situation would still be well under control. Completely.

Still. It is… reassuring that you are here now.

My mission here is of great importance to our house. Critical, in fact. I simply require a bit of… assistance.

title: Expedition Gone Wrong
objectives:
Listen to what Andanil Sunsworn has to say about the expedition.
- [Andanil Sunsworn listened](Andanil Sunsworn#Quotes)
description:
Apologies for the sorry state of our camp. These lands are strange, and their inhabitants even stranger. And… we have suffered a major setback.

<Andanil shifts, tension plain in every movement.>

Let me explain what happened.
progress: Yes?
completion:
Our people have endured exile, betrayal, and slow decay, and still we stand. We will endure this as well. I believe that. I have to.

That said, belief alone will not carry us through what waits in that den. Pride has already cost us enough.

I will admit this, if only once. I could use a steady hand at my side in this matter.

title: The Withered Den

fields.name: The Withered Den
fields.rewards: Choice of:, Sunsworn Glaive, or, Robes of Nox

objectives:
Find what caused the expedition to wither in the Barrow Den north of Sunsworn Camp, then return with your findings to Andanil Sunsworn in Sunsworn Camp on Moonwhisper Coast.
- [The Nox Star](The Nox Star)
description:
I cannot spare any of my people. They are scholars, arcanists, minds trained for study, not slaughter. I need them lucid, focused, working. If I send them into that den, I lose more than soldiers. I lose what little progress we have left.

You are different. You carry no obligation to my house, no oath to my cousin’s ambition. And you handle yourself like one who has seen real battle. That is what I require.

Listen carefully. I need your help, and I will see you rewarded in a manner worthy of the risk.

Go to the den. Find what they uncovered. Find what drained them so completely, so quickly. It must still be there. An artifact. A stone. Whatever it is, it is the source.

Bring me proof. Bring me the object itself if you can.

And… if there is any chance, any at all, do not kill them. Not unless you must. If this was caused by magic, then magic may yet undo it.

<Andanil turns his gaze aside, jaw tightening.>

I am aware of how that sounds. Even so. Try.
progress:
Do not stray too far.

There is another Barrow Den farther north, within a druid grove. The druids there have made their feelings toward us very clear, and they were not welcoming.

Whatever they guard is not meant for us, and I will not have you provoking another enemy while we are already stretched thin.

Stay away from that place.
completion:
What is this?

<Andanil stares into the artifact you retrieved. His eyes linger too long, as if it is staring back.>

This is it?

Yes… of course it is. I see it now.

The magic is spent, drained dry, but there is no doubt. This is the source. This is what they found. Even emptied, it hums with purpose.

<He lifts the object carefully, almost reverently, turning it in the light.>

Such precision. There is no waste here, no ornament for vanity’s sake. This is not elven craft.

I have studied relics from every corner of our past. Highborne vaults. Pre-Sundering ruins. Nothing even approaches this. Whatever made it did not think like us. It did not feel like us. And whatever power once flowed through it was enough to drain trained arcanists in moments and leave them wandering husks.

And still, I cannot shake the feeling that this is only a shell. A key, perhaps. Something meant to be used again.

I must return to Alah'thalas at once. Oh cousin… this time, I did not fail you.

title: Ghosts of Maras'ethil
objectives:
Find four valuable magical artifacts in Maras’ethil, then return to Tesania Shadewind in Sunsworn Camp on Moonwhisper Coast.
- [Eye of Dreams](Eye of Dreams)
- [Blade of Xoroth](Blade of Xoroth)
- [Emerald Scepter](Emerald Scepter)
- [Moonveil](Moonveil)
description:
Those fools think draenethyst crystals are our salvation.

<Tesania laughs, sharp and bright, like she just heard a perfect joke.>

Salvation. For us. That is a good one. There is no saving our people. Still, I intend to delay the inevitable for as long as I can.

<She glances at the two withered nearby, her smile fading into open contempt.>

I have no desire to end up like that. To the east lie the ruins of Maras’ethil. Once a Highborne center of learning. Now a broken monument to our arrogance. Typical. My research suggests there are still artifacts there. Old ones. Potent ones. The kind certain parties would trade generously for in mana crystals. Very generously.

Bring me at least four artifacts worth my time. I promise, you will find the reward far more pleasant than whatever fate awaits the rest of us.
progress:
The Highborne ghosts still think they are alive. They haunt the ruins, patrolling streets that no longer exist, guarding cities that fell centuries ago. In their minds, nothing has changed.

They will not part with their secrets willingly. Nor their artifacts. Expect resistance. Ferocious, stubborn, and very offended that you dare disturb their illusion.
completion:
Oh, these are potent.

The magic on them is still alive. Old, refined, dangerous. Otherworldly, even. And the craftsmanship… honestly, it is almost enough to make me nostalgic. Almost.

Yes, these are very much worth investigating. Possibly worth more than that, depending on who is asking.

Well done, <class>. You earned your keep.

title: Blackroot Hold (quest)

fields.name: Blackroot Hold
fields.rewards: Choice of:, Blackroot Wraps, or, Shield of Alah'thalas

objectives:
Recover the stolen expedition supplies from the Blackroot furbolgs for Rhys Dawnbreeze in Sunsworn Camp on Moonwhisper Coast.
- [Sunsworn Supplies](Sunsworn Supplies) (12)
description:
As a captain of the guard, keeping the expedition alive is my charge.

I failed at that. Not to the enemy, but to fools who thought this land would forgive mistakes. It does not.

However, what truly crippled us was theft. Supplies. Ammunition. Food meant to last the month - gone.

The furbolgs to the south took them. They did not always prey on the desperate. Something twisted them. Timbermaw Hold reeks of bad magic, and they carry it with them. I see their scouts closer each night. Testing us. Counting fires. Waiting.

Without those supplies, this camp will starve or freeze before the enemy ever strikes.

Go south, to their village. Find what they stole from us. Take it back.

If they stand in your way, deal with them. Quietly if you can. Brutally if you must.

We cannot afford mercy. Not anymore.
progress: They are always watching.
completion:
Good. This will keep us alive a while longer.

Do not think this ends anything. The theft was not desperation - it was intent. They wanted to see how we would respond. Whether we were weak.

Now they know better.

They will test us again. They always do. Wounded beasts grow bold when cornered. If we wait, they will gather, and they will come for us in the dark.

Next time, we do not recover what was taken.

Next time, we burn the hand that reaches for us.

title: Falling the Fallen
objectives:
Bring 40 Fallen One Heads to Rhys Dawnbreeze in Sunsworn Camp on Moonwhisper Coast.
- [Fallen One Head](Fallen One Head) (40)
description:
The draenei.

Strange beings from a broken world. The same world our traitor prince chose over his own people.

<Rhys spits.>

There is a village to the northeast. They keep to themselves. We traded for their crystals. Curious things. They hum when no wind blows. I do not trust them, but they have not raised steel against us. Not yet.

In the swamps and forests, it is different. Those who call themselves the Fallen Ones stalk the reeds and the tree line. They do not parley. They rush you without warning and strip the flesh from your bones. I have seen what they leave behind.

We cannot build anything here while they breathe. The expedition will never be secure with them prowling our flanks.

Hunt them. Kill them where they hide. Bring me forty of their heads as proof. Yes, forty. Do not question the number. These swamps crawl with them. You will not struggle to find your count.

Thin them out until even the mud runs red.
progress:
Beware their daggers.

They coat the blades in venom not born of this world. It burns cold in the blood. I have watched strong warriors fall to their knees from a scratch no deeper than a thorn.

Do not trust your armor to save you. Do not trust your healers to mend you in time. Even they struggle against that poison.
completion:
Forty heads.

It brings a measure of peace, seeing them laid out like that. Not enough, but some. We have only carved a dent in their numbers, nothing more.

Still, it should give them pause. Fear lingers longer than pain, and they are not brave creatures when faced with open slaughter.

With luck, it will be enough to keep them from testing our encampment while we are still here.

title: Heaven Falling Down
objectives:
Retrieve the Meteor Shard for Arcanist Cerulon in Sunsworn Camp on Moonwhisper Coast.
- [Meteor Shard](Meteor Shard)
description:
Before the… incident, we managed to secure a fair number of draenethyst crystals. They are potent, yes, and full of promise. Still, something is missing. I can feel it.

Some time ago, a great meteor fell north of here. It tore the earth apart when it struck, and its arrival drew many of the blue dragonflight to the site. That alone tells me enough.

The stone is saturated with arcane energy. In the right context, it could be invaluable to my work. I believe it would resonate with draenethyst in a way we have not yet seen. The exact mechanisms are not important.

What matters is this. I need a sample.

The dragons guarding the impact site are hostile, and I will not ask you to walk into certain death. However, the Fallen Ones do not share such reservations. They place little value on life, their own included. It is possible they scavenged shards from the meteor. If so, you will find them in the Servitor’s Sanctuary to the north. Search there, and bring me what you can recover.
progress:
Proceed with caution.

The Fallen Ones are not to be underestimated. They are reckless, but not foolish, and they fight with a cruelty born of desperation.

Do not take them lightly. Many have died that way.
completion:
So… you actually found one.

Yes. This resonance. I can feel it even through the wards. The arcane pattern is unstable, but not chaotic. That is rare. Very rare.

You did well to survive long enough to bring it back. Many would not have.

With this shard, the draenethyst may finally reveal its purpose. Or confirm my fears about it. Either outcome is preferable to ignorance.

Rest now. I will begin the work immediately, and carefully.

title: A Plea for Help
objectives: Speak to Grovetender Sellais in the Grove of the Sun on Tyrandas in Moonwhisper Coast.
description: <name>, I have received an urgent message from one of the Circle's druidic enclaves in Moonwhisper Coast. Tragedy has befallen our brethren and they seek immediate aid. Please, seek out their grove on the island of Tyrandas in the northeast of Moonwhisper Coast and report to Grovetender Sellais.
completion: Loganaar received my message? What a relief.

title: Belated Preservation
objectives:
Collect Elunaris Relics for Grovetender Sellais in the Grove of the Sun on Tyrandas.
- [Elunaris Relic](Elunaris Relic) (10)
description: The city above us had been laying silent for millennia, an unspoken oath by all Kaldorei and druids to not enter the forlorn ruins of the Sisterhood. Thus, we had not secured the numerous relics inside for safekeeping, but let them rest in the embrace of time instead. However, now that the deranged defectors have begun trangressing and pillaging the temple, we cannot look idly by any longer. Gather allies and fight your way through their defenses. Retrieve as many artifacts as you can and bring them here to the grove.
progress: Beware, unseen powers linger in your adversaries. It is best to heed caution.
completion: Some look worse for wear, but none of them should truly be irreparable. Great work, <name>. We will ensure that they arrive safely at Nighthaven, so that they can be properly archived once and for all. Thank you for your diligence, truly.

title: A Star That Calls Back
objectives:
Slay Starcaller at the Starshard Cradle, then return to Zarazar on Moonwhisper Coast.
- [Starcaller](Starcaller) slain
description:
You have seen the crater to the west, yes? The one they call the Starshard Cradle.

A most unfortunate name. Romantic, even. I assure you, there is nothing romantic about a rock falling from the heavens with enough force to crack the earth open.

What interests me is not the crater itself, but what came after - blue dragons. Not one or two passing through, but an entire brood circling the impact site as though it were a shrine. One of them in particular has drawn my attention.

Starcaller.

It patrols the skies above the crater and drives away anything that comes too close. Adventurers. Scholars. Even the naga have learned to give it a wide berth.

Which leaves us with two possibilities.

Either the meteor drew the dragons here… Or the dragons themselves caused it to fall.

Neither answer sits comfortably with me.

Slay the drake known as Starcaller at the Starshard Cradle. With it gone, we may finally learn what the dragons are guarding there.
progress:
Starcaller will not fight like the creatures you are used to.

Blue dragons wield arcane power as easily as most people breathe. Expect spells. Expect sudden bursts of energy that turn the air itself against you.

And if the meteor truly empowers the creature…Then the fight may be more interesting than I anticipated.
completion:
Starcaller is dead?

Good. That removes the most immediate obstacle.

The blue dragonflight rarely commits to guarding something so aggressively unless it carries great arcane significance.

A meteor saturated with arcane energy… and dragons circling it like vultures.

Yes. There is definitely more to this crater than a simple rock from the sky. With that drake gone, perhaps the others will grow less bold. Or perhaps they will become curious enough to reveal what they were truly protecting.

Either way, you have given us an opportunity to learn the truth.

And I very much intend to take it.

title: The Fantastical Farewell Faire
objectives: Speak to Wiz Silverpocket at the Farewell Faire north of Moonhoof Village in Moonwhisper Coast. A Farewell Faire Barker in any capital city can bring you there with ease.
description: I extend my greetings to you, <Class>! Have you heard of the Farewell Faire in Moonwhisper Coast? It is a special occasion where all citizens of Azeroth gather round and reminisce about the wonderful memories they have made with their loved ones, friends and even strangers! We celebrate this feast to show gratitude towards our past and to look forward into the future with steadfast resolve. If you wish to join the festivities, speak to me again, and I will transport you there with a little magic trick of mine.
completion: Hello, hello! Like I always say, the more the merrier! Check out the booths, our dancefloor and take a visit to the pier and plant some lanterns into the water! Here, have this coin for a starter! Gather more and you'll be able to purchase wonderful souvenirs from my brother Wez right next to me!

title: A Unknown Letter
objectives: Speak with Kilrogg Deadeye on Balor.
description:
A terrible darkness emerged from our past, young one. A darkness threatening not only the Horde, but all life on Azeroth. Not long ago, we received a mysterious letter from an unknown sender, written in pitch black ink. It warned us of a relic from the Second War, reborn to spread its seed of chaos throughout the world. The Stormreaver Clan, Gul'dan's puppet clan, returned and joined forces with its old allies, the Shadow Council. Their warlocks have committed innumerable atrocities in the past, and if we do not stop them, I fear we may be facing a new age of terror. I ordered one of my advisors and chieftain of the Bleeding Hollow Clan, Kilrogg Deadeye, to quell their uprising. He departed to the island of Balor, their former base of operation countless years ago.

<name>, I want you to follow suit and assist the Bleeding Hollow Clan. Take the zeppelin to Grom'gol Base Camp and speak to the local Wind Rider Master. She can bring you to the island west of Stormwind.
completion: Whelpling, what we are facing is an abyss of unseen depth. Be absolutely sure your heart is steeled for what is to come. Lest you'll be devoured by the void festering on this island.

title: Bugs on My Island
objectives:
Slay 7 SI:7 Scouts and return to Kilrogg Deadeye in Stormbreaker Point.
- [SI:7 Scout](SI:7 Scout) slain (7)
description:
Years ago, when our people first set foot in this world, we believed ourselves invincible. Before the First War truly began, joined by that filthy two-headed mongrel Cho'gall, we brought ruin to the human lands. Our armies marched to the gates of Stormwind City, and victory was within reach. We were clearly the superior warriors.

Arrogance, young one. The greatest enemy of those who deem themselves strong. From the gates, mounted warriors struck like lightning. Backed by magic, these knights forced this proud chieftain to retreat with his tail between his legs. Humility—a trait every warrior ready to die in battle must carry. Always assume your enemy is stronger. Always believe that, if you survive, you will be stronger than before.

Do not underestimate humanity. Leave this camp without caution, and you may find a dagger in your back. They skulk in the shadows, closer than is comfortable. They may not be our main focus but find and slay them.
progress: Done yet?
completion: Stand proud child of the Horde. Victory is honorably achieved by those with strength and thunder in their blood.
rewards:
You will receive:
- [Repurposed Si:7 Dagger](Repurposed Si:7 Dagger)
- 2400 XP

title: Deep in the Mines
objectives:
Slay 5 Stormreaver Necromancer, 8 Foul Overseer and 8 Spikebone Miner and return to Kilrogg Deadeye in Stormbreaker Point.
- [Stormreaver Necromancer](Stormreaver Necromancer) slain (5)
- [Foul Overseer](Foul Overseer) slain (8)
- [Spikebone Miner](Spikebone Miner) slain (8)
description:
I bid you welcome to the legacy of crime of that which you call home—shelter, family. Witness the havoc brought by the hands of the slaving Horde. This is what would have remained of all Azeroth, were we not rid of our demonic masters. Take it in. And then focus—we are not here to conquer, nor to save. We are here to assume responsibility.

As always, the cursed mongrels of the Shadow Council do not fail to make their sort as detestable as one could be. Were it not enough that their numbers plague this war-scarred land, they have gone above and beyond to raise both flesh and soul beyond the veil of death.

In what was Breezehaven, you will find a mine. Dispatch the numbers of bones and rotting flesh that stand between you and their pitiful masters. Find these so-called necromancers and stain your blade with their fel-ridden blood. I owe a personal debt to the scum that dared call themselves Stormreaver. What even is a storm in the face of a hollow that will swallow all there is?
progress: We owe apologies to none. It is not guilt that brought us here—but honor.
completion: I see the color of blood and smell the stench of death on you. Well done. Now, onto other matters.

title: Colony of Ants

fields.name: Colony of Ants
fields.next: It Can't Rain All the Time

next: It Can't Rain All the Time

objectives:
Slay 6 Stormreaver Brute, 6 Stormreaver Torturer, 4 Stormreaver Shadowcaller, 2 Stormreaver Stormblade and return to Kilrogg Deadeye in Stormbreaker Point.
- [Stormreaver Brute](Stormreaver Brute) slain (6)
- [Stormreaver Torturer](Stormreaver Torturer) slain (6)
- [Stormreaver Shadowcaller](Stormreaver Shadowcaller) slain (4)
- [Stormreaver Stormblade](Stormreaver Stormblade) slain (2)
description:
Are you one to care for insects, soldier? I have taken a keen interest in ants. You see, while they differ in species, hierarchy, and even customs, were you to open your mind to see them so—there is only one truth. The moment the queen dies, three things can happen: the colony falls apart, slowly dying without new workers; it has more than one queen, so they still survive; or it raises a new queen to ensure the colony endures.

Just like ants, the Stormreaver Clan numbers many. Your efforts, while not in vain, have barely dealt any damage to their true strength. So, to ensure the goal of our mission, you must go once again and clear us a path—this time, closer to their nest. Travel to the Ruins of Stromwrought Castle. Do not hold back. Go as far as you can. In that everlasting battlefield, you will be the boot that stomps over the colony.

Adventure not alone—seek aid from your brothers and sisters.
progress: The queens of the colony are close. Keep a level head and push forward.
completion: You know victory like no other—I'm half a mind to challenge you myself.

title: Mere Thoughts
objectives:
Slay 5 Stormreaver Outrunner, 10 Stormreaver Ravager, 5 Stormreaver Drone, 5 Stormreaver Raider and return to Kilrogg Deadeye in Stormbreaker Point.
- [Stormreaver Outrunner](Stormreaver Outrunner) slain (5)
- [Stormreaver Ravager](Stormreaver Ravager) slain (10)
- [Stormreaver Drone](Stormreaver Drone) slain (5)
- [Stormreaver Raider](Stormreaver Raider) slain (5)
description:
Since I have regained my freedom, I have come to think about many things. Many questions have riddled my mind into labyrinths I have struggled to overcome. It was for that reason alone I chose to step aside for some time. However, I did not expect to be so easily forgotten. Mere thoughts.

In my short-lived hermit life, I was once or twice challenged to duel the notion of evilness. Are we born evil—or do we become so later on, due to circumstances? The conclusion I came to was quite simple: we all bear a seed of evil at the root of our own being, but it is by choice whether it grows or not.

Which brings us to your next task. If you believe my words earlier to be nothing but a bore, hear me now. Havoc is what they know, so havoc is what you will give. Go beyond Breezehaven, push closer to the castle—your targets await. You are not a killer—you are the consequence of their actions, coming to take its due.
progress: How thin the line between arrogance and confidence can be.
completion: Today, you have been the consequence of others. One day, your own will find you.

title: It Can't Rain All the Time

fields.name: It Can't Rain All the Time

objectives:
Slay Dagar the Glutton, Oronok Torn-Heart, Ighal'for and return to Kilrogg Deadeye in Stormbreaker Point.
- [Dagar the Glutton](Dagar the Glutton) slain
- [Oronok Torn-Heart](Oronok Torn-Heart) slain
- [Ighal'for](Ighal'for) slain
description:
If you have yet to seek Drak'thul, now is the time. Drak'thul holds the key to storm the castle, and your next task is to put it all to rest. An old acquaintance has paid me a visit. Though we do not see eye to eye on many things, there is one hatred we share—the hatred for a despicable being who stood beside Gul'dan during the forming of this clan.

Though the coward is not here himself, he has sent his most treasured pupil to oversee the new uprising. While he is your main target, do not shy away from slaying all you lay eyes upon—Dagar and Oronok especially. Steel yourself; I have no clue what they have in store for you.

While my hatred for them burns like the lowest pits of Blackrock Mountain, I know better—I know they are capable, though despicable. But I believe you are even more capable. Reach out to your allies once more, and see it done. I do wonder... will the sun return to this island once I see you return? After all, it can't rain all the time.
progress: Ashes to ashes, dust to dust and scum to scum.
completion: Well, what do you know... a ray of sunshine breaks through.

title: Storm's End

fields.name: Storm's End
fields.previous: It Can't Rain All the Time
fields.rewards: Choice of:, Kor'kron Crown,, Voodoo Jerkin, or, Totemic Headdress

previous: It Can't Rain All the Time

objectives: Report to Thrall in Grommash Hold, the Valley of Wisdom, Orgrimmar.
description:
When I was sent to this island, I believed the Warchief—like most—saw only an old orc, ready to die. He ordered me to serve as a commander, not a warrior. Were it not for Eitrigg's counsel and Saurfang's mocking words, I doubt I would have played my part. But I trusted my friends, and they trusted the Warchief.

A Frostwolf heart beats in his chest. He is wise beyond his years, much like Drek'thar and Orgrim. It seems he was right about me. Though I longed to fight at your side, to stain this island red with my axe, I have learned something else.

I am the last chieftain of the Bleeding Hollow, elder of the Horde, and with these hands, I will guide the next generation. Go now, with victory in your heart, to Grommash Hold. Present our triumph to the Warchief, and tell him I will soon return. Perhaps I will visit Hellscream's memorial when I do.
progress: Lok'tar ogar.
completion:
Though it is not bound to be the last time we see the embers of the Shadow Council, a great victory was won. While we wish nothing from the land of Balor, it has given me the greatest gift.

Kilrogg was spiteful in the beginning, jealous of Grommash's celebration as a hero—while he himself seemed forgotten. But he was wrong to envy Grommash. My older brother merely set the foundation. It is you, and I, and Kilrogg who will build our future. I am glad he sees it that way now.

title: Eyes of Stormreaver
objectives:
Collect 30 Stormreaver Warlock Eye and return to Kilrogg Deadeye in Stormbreaker Point.
- [Stormreaver Warlock Eye](Stormreaver Warlock Eye) (30)
description:
In their eternal mockery, these foolish warlocks have named one of their abilities after my missing eye. There is no way I can accept this insult with a straight face. It is a disgrace—to my name, to all that I am!

Were I not stuck here under this wretched tent by whatever mischievous power compels me to trust you instead of exacting my own justice, I would march out myself and collect the eyes of those blasted, fel-hungry oafs.

But as I am denied that right, you will do it in my stead. Venture back to the island of Balor and slay the Stormreaver Warlocks. Bring me no fewer than thirty of their eyes! They say if you believe in “an eye for an eye,” the world will one day go blind. The Stormreavers won't need their sight any longer—not once you're done with them.
progress: I am prepared to set them aflame.
completion: Good. Now I shall burn these wretched eyes, so the last thing their souls gaze upon is the fiery pits of the afterlife they deserve.

title: Entranced Magic
objectives:
Gather 5 Vials of Entranced Blood for Far Seer Mothang at Shatterblade Post in Grim Reaches.
- [Vial of Entranced Blood](Vial of Entranced Blood) (5)
description:
You there, <class>. I require assistance in a task vital to the Horde, one that could secure our place here within Grim Reaches. There is a latent power lingering within the region, and it is my desire to claim it for myself.

To harness such energies requires natural materials latent with magical vitality. I require you to gather the blood of the nearby entranced dragonkin. These creatures are under the control of the Dragonmaw clan, and can be found to the southwest of here. Gather their blood, and return it to me.
progress: The blood is required for my rituals, has it been obtained <class>?
completion: The power of the Demon Soul is infused within this blood, its power is undeniable.

title: Natural Remedies
objectives:
Gather Lingering Fel Energy from the demons in Desolace, and a Crystal Spine Scale from the basilisks in Stranglethorn Vale for Far Seer Mothang at Shatterblade Post in Grim Reaches.
- [Lingering Fel Energy](Lingering Fel Energy)
- [Crystal Spine Scale](Crystal Spine Scale)
description:
If I am to truly captivate the magic of the region I will require a series of natural materials to amplify my abilities. Our real work is yet to come, but we must prepare nonetheless.

I require some trace of fel energy from the demons of the burning legion, I do know they have a presence in Desolace, seek them out there.

Lastly, I will require the scale of a basilisk, Crystal Spine basilisks to be more specific. This rare breed can be found along the Savage Coast in Stranglethorn Vale, seek them out, and gather me one of their scales.
progress: Have you gathered what I have asked for?
completion: You have done well, now we can begin the more arduous tasks.

title: Dark Essence (quest)
objectives:
Recover a Dark Essence from the ghosts of The Grim Hollow for Far Seer Mothang at Shatterblade Post in Grim Reaches.
- [Dark Essence](Dark Essence)
description:
There is one final material that I require before our tasks is complete. To the south of the region lays a place called The Grim Hollow. It is a desolate, and corrupted land that has been twisted by a dark and unknown power.

This power is what I seek, and it can be claimed by the spirits of dwarves that now haunt the hollow itself. Slay them, and return to me a Dark Essence from their remains.
progress: Has my task been completed?
completion: Such dark, and powerful energy, it shall serve me well.

title: The Power of Uth'okk
objectives:
Slay Oronok Torn-Heart and recover the Pendant of Uth'okk from Stormwrought Ruins for Far Seer Mothang at Shatterblade Post in Grim Reaches.
- [The Pendant of Uth'okk](The Pendant of Uth'okk)
description:
All of the materials have been gathered, We have come to the culmination of our efforts. If we want to truly harness such energy we must first find a suitable conduit for which to contain it.

Long ago a great gemstone of immense power was brought to this world by Gul'dan and his minions. The Pendant of Uth'okk was left to Oronok Torn-Heart, one of Gul'dan's lieutenants. It is this pendant that I seek. You can find him lurking within the depths of Stormwrought Ruins on the island of Balor. This will not be an easy task, but I desire you to kill him, and bring me the power of the Pendant of Uth'okk.

Do this, and you shall be rewarded.
progress: Have you reclaimed the Pendant of Uth'okk for the Horde?
completion:
<Far Seer Mothang lets out a deep, and sinister laugh.>

The Pendant of Uth'okk, in my hands...

title: The Ritual of Uth'okk
objectives:
Wait for Far Seer Mothang to finish his ritual.
- Wait for Far Seer Mothang to finish his ritual
description:
All of the materials have been gathered, We have come to the culmination of our efforts. If we want to truly harness such energy we must first find a suitable conduit for which to contain it.

Long ago a great gemstone of immense power was brought to this world by Gul'dan and his minions. The Pendant of Uth'okk was left to Oronok Torn-Heart, one of Gul'dan's lieutenants. It is this pendant that I seek. You can find him lurking within the depths of Stormwrought Ruins on the island of Balor. This will not be an easy task, but I desire you to kill him, and bring me the power of the Pendant of Uth'okk.

Do this, and you shall be rewarded.
progress: <Far Seer Mothang is lost in harmony.>
completion:
The power of the Uth'okk gemstone is flowing through my veins... Such power is euphoric!

I am reborn, and I have you to thank for doing all my work.

<Far Seer Mothang lets out a deep, and sinister laugh.>

The Pendant of Uth'okk has been sapped of its power, but I am sure you can make some use of it.

<Far Seer Mothang lets off a deep smirk.>

Farewell <class>.
rewards:
You will receive:
- [The Pendant of Uth'okk](The Pendant of Uth'okk)
- 300 XP
notes:
-On accept**
  Far Seer Mothang begins the ritual.
  **Far Seer Mothang says:** I can feel the power flowing through my veins!
  *Far Seer Mothang turns red and increases in size.*
  **Far Seer Mothang says:** It is complete! The power of Uth'okk is mine! Behold the energy flowing through my veins!

title: We Take It From The Living

fields.name: We Take It From The Living
fields.rewards: Sash of Innocent Blood and, Wreath of Worgen Blood
fields.next: The Evil Made Me Do It

next: The Evil Made Me Do It

objectives:
Bring 15 Gilnean Blood Vials and 15 Worgen Blood Vials to Orvan Darkeye in the Ruins of Grayshire.
- [Gilnean Blood Vial](Gilnean Blood Vial) (15)
- [Worgen Blood Vial](Worgen Blood Vial) (15)
description:
I must say, you have proven to be a useful servant, and your mindless loyalty is a rare sight indeed in these times. But I must confess, I wasn't exactly truthful with you in the beginning. While my personal pursuit is the search for the works of Ur, I am also here on a mission from the Royal Apothecary Society. We believe that Gilneas is the perfect place to perfect our new weapon against the enemies of the Horde.

But to do so, I require more blood. Human blood, and worgen blood. It's a delicate balance. Take these vials and head south of Stillward Church. There you will find Greymane's forces. It shouldn't be too difficult to get the blood we need from them. As for the worgen blood... well, they will come to you, one way or another. Just be ready for them when they do.
progress: Be quick about it, my servant.
completion: Now that is impressive. Let us see how this blood will react with my concoction. If my calculations are correct...
rewards:
You will receive:
- [Sash of Innocent Blood](Sash of Innocent Blood) and [Wreath of Worgen Blood](Wreath of Worgen Blood)
- 3980 XP
notes:
-Upon completion**
  The concoction explodes violently, covering Orvan in blood.
  **Orvan Darkeye says:** Damn it! We will need the blasted book after all.

title: Dead Until Dark
objectives: Find Orvan Darkeye for Deathstalker Alynna. He is rumored to be somewhere close to the ruins of Greyshire.
description:
Listen, <race>. We face no shortage of troubles here, but I shan't waste your time with mindless errands. Dealing with the pests and beasts that torment our camp is a task I can handle myself.

However, I do require your aid in a matter of greater importance. One of our own, Orvan Darkeye, came to Gilneas in search of the lost tomes of Archmage Ur. Yet, the irony of it all - he himself became lost.

<Deathstalker Alynna's twisted smile conveys her amusement at the situation.>

Your mission is clear: find him, or what little is left of him. Last we heard, he was headed towards Greyshire.
progress: What?
completion:
What? That mindless rotbrain thinks I got lost?

<Orvan chuckles darkly>

How amusing. One less pathetic cur to deal with. As you can see, I am perfectly capable of taking care of myself. But it seems fate has brought you here, and I must admit, I have a need for a servant. And you, my dear, look like a perfect specimen for the job.

title: All We Need is Blood
objectives:
Bring 10 Vilewing Blood Vials for Orvan Darkeye at the Ruins of Greyshire in Gilneas.
- [Vilewing Blood Vial](Vilewing Blood Vial) (10)
description:
I have come to this land in search of a particular book - a tome I have sought for ages: 'On the Powers of Blood' by Archmage Ur. Oh, how it eluded me! But now, I have reason to believe that it may be hidden within Gilneas.

The knowledge contained within those pages could be invaluable to furthering both the goals of the Forsaken and the Horde. I am close to discovering its whereabouts, very close, but in the meantime I require your assistance. Take these vials and collect the blood of bats. We will need them for our plans, yes. Do not disappoint me.
progress: Have you collected the blood already? I need ten full vials.
completion:
Ah, excellent. You have brought me what I needed.

<Orvan takes the vials, inspects them with a sinister smile and abruptly tosses them behind him.>

These will be invaluable, truly invaluable.

title: Last of the Living Dead

fields.name: Last of the Living Dead
fields.next: We Take It From The Living

next: We Take It From The Living

objectives:
Slay 8 Shambling Dead and 8 Lingering Skeletons for Orvan Darkeye at the Ruins of Greyshire in Gilneas.
- [Lingering Skeleton](Lingering Skeleton) slain (8)
- [Shambling Dead](Shambling Dead) slain (8)
description:
Greymane may have thought himself safe behind these walls, but he was foolish to believe he could hide from Death. Now, his incompetence comes back to haunt him, and by extension, me. The Scourge still lurk in these lands, constantly interrupting my research and slowing it down considerably. It is time to take matters into our own hands.

I command you to eliminate the remaining Scourge forces in Greyshire.

Do not fail me, for failure is not an option.

<The Forsaken's eyes narrow with a cold, calculating intensity.>
progress: What are you waiting for? Root them out, destroy them utterly. Their presence here is an affront to the Forsaken and a threat to our operations.
completion:
It seems that not all of the Scourge forces were eradicated, but I must commend you for your work nonetheless. Your efforts have weakened their hold on this land and that will have to be enough for now. We cannot afford to underestimate our enemies, especially not the Scourge. They are a relentless force, serving their vile Lich King until the end.

Speaking of which, what became of the commander of the Scourge invasion here, I wonder? Was he defeated, or is he in hiding, waiting for the Lich King's command to resume his invasion of Gilneas?

title: The Evil Made Me Do It

fields.name: The Evil Made Me Do It
fields.previous: We Take It From The Living

previous: We Take It From The Living

objectives:
Find 'On the Powers of Blood' in Gilneas City, then return to Orvan Darkeye at the Ruins of Greyshire in Gilneas.
- ['On the Powers of Blood']('On the Powers of Blood')
description:
I may have... miscalculated a bit. It seems without the knowledge held in the 'Powers of Blood', I cannot stabilize the mix. I need that book.

I scoured every corner of this land with no success. It can only mean one thing: The book is hidden in the city of Gilneas itself. It looms like an impenetrable fortress, and the thought of trying to find a single book within its walls is overwhelming.

The city is heavily fortified, and the human forces stationed there are not to be trifled with. They are determined to hold onto what little they have left, and they will stop at nothing to keep their city safe. It will take all of your cunning and stealth to even attempt getting past their defenses.

If, however, you do manage to locate the book... I will reward you beyond measure.
progress: Has everything I've done been in vain?
completion:
Ah, finally! After all the obstacles and setbacks, I have obtained Ur's masterpiece. The secrets of blood magic, and the power to control the very essence of life itself! With this book, I will be unstoppable, and the enemies of the Forsaken will tremble before me.

<The Forsaken flips through the pages, cackling with excitement.>

It is clear that Ur was a master of his craft. But even he did not fully comprehend the true potential of blood magic. With the knowledge contained in this tome, I will surpass him and become the greatest bloodmage the world has ever known.

<The Forsaken looks up with a wicked grin.>

You have served me well, my faithful minion. And for that, I will grant you a small taste of the power we will soon wield.

title: Blood for Blood

fields.name: Blood for Blood
fields.previous: The Evil Made Me Do It

previous: The Evil Made Me Do It

objectives: Report to Master Apothecary Faranell in Undercity.
description:
Behold the new age of the Forsaken! With this tome as my guide, I will unlock the secrets of the Blood Dimension and harness its power for our cause.

<Orvan Darkeye mixes blood with a slimy, green concoction, following the steps described in the tome with meticulous precision. After a while, he turns to you, a wicked grin on his face.>

Now, we must find a test subject for my latest creation. I had planned to force it down your throat, but you have been a faithful servant, and I will spare you this time. Instead, I have a better idea. There is a nearby camp of human mercenaries who are loyal to our cause. I wonder if this concoction will make them even more devoted to our mission.

Before I can proceed, I require one final favor from you. Report to Master Apothecary Faranell in Undercity. Tell him that the mission was a success.
progress: Yes?
completion: So Orvan was successful after all. Great. You have done a great favor to the Forsaken and to the Horde this day, so you shall be rewarded. Take this vial, my friend. It contains a potent concoction that will enhance your strength simply by breathing in its fumes. Of course, there may be some minor side effects, such as headaches, vomiting, madness, or even death, but I'm sure you'll be fine. After all, what is a little risk compared to the power it can provide?
rewards:
You will receive:
- [Pure Bloodvial Pendant](Pure Bloodvial Pendant)
- 950 XP

title: In Memory of Franklin

fields.name: In Memory of Franklin
fields.rewards: Choice of:, Bleaktalon, or, Blackheart Boots

objectives:
Place the Blackheart Necklace on the grave of Franklin.
- Place the Blackheart Necklace on the grave of Franklin
description:
I have one last request from you. I figure you should do the honors, since you have recovered this necklace after all.
