<name>, please hand this report to Operative Gillian. If my understanding of the situation is correct, and I am certain that it is, then we cannot wait much longer.
progress: Has Noppsy finished his translation? What have you found out?
completion:
<Verona is reading Noppsy's report without changing expressions. Her meticulous analysis of the report reminds you why she is the spearhead of this operation.>

<name>, ready yourself. We will launch an infiltration.

title: Into The Hornet's Nest

fields.name: Into The Hornet's Nest
fields.rewards: Choice of:, Clasps of Subterfuge, or, Seabreeze Mantle
fields.next: Heart of Darkness, Assassin In Training

objectives:
Infiltrate Stormwrought Castle on Balor and find out who is conspiring with the Stormreaver orcs. Report to Verona Gillian in the SI:7 Outpost on Balor when done.
- [Nethercaller Mahlgus](Nethercaller Mahlgus) slain
- [Warlord Jawbreaker](Warlord Jawbreaker) slain
- [Stormreaver Insignia](Stormreaver Insignia) (20)
description:
From what I gathered from Spickerspan's findings, I don't believe we are simply dealing with the Stormreaver orcs and their demon friends alone at this point. An operation of this magnitude is too grand for a scattered clan from the Second War. There has to be more at play here. Who else has their grimy little fingers involved in this is our next step. Ascend the island, enter the yard of Stormwrought Castle and thin out their numbers. Search the area for crucial intel we might be missing. Dispatch any high ranking officer you come across, we must be swift and deadly. I myself will send notice to Master Shaw to rally as many agents as we can. Personally I do not expect the King to aid us in this tragedy.

Stay sharp, <class>, I expect sufficient results.
progress: Do not venture alone. These beasts are unpredictable and will stop at nothing.
completion:
I expected nothing less. For an external aid, you've proven yourself to be a valuable asset to our team. If the thrill of adventure ever subsides within you, the SI:7 has room for individuals like you.

Please, report your findings. Time is running out.
rewards:
You may choose one of:
- [Clasps of Subterfuge](Clasps of Subterfuge)
- [Seabreeze Mantle](Seabreeze Mantle)
You will also receive:
- 2900 XP

title: Heart of Darkness

fields.name: Heart of Darkness
fields.rewards: Choice of:, Rufus' Trusty Tankard,, Kinrial's Scalpel,, Noppsy's Compendium, or, Nippsy's Precision Rifle

objectives:
Stop the Shadow Council in the Stormwrought Ruins.
- [Ighal'for](Ighal'for) slain
- [Mergothid](Mergothid) slain
description:
The Shadow Council. It seems Doomhammer's lap dogs were sloppy. If you are unfamiliar with them, the Shadow Council are - or rather were - Gul'dan's fanatical followers. A cabal of heretics and sinners, devoting their very being to their demon overlords. They were said to have been eradicated following their master's death during the Second War, yet their depravity still prevails. If this missive can be trusted, then the Stormreaver are led by a high ranking and powerful warlock of the Shadow Council, operating from within Stormwrought Castle.

<name>, there is little time for respite. Gather an elite force and storm the fallen castle. We need to put a stop to their leader from summoning that demon from beyond the Nether and rescue the remaining citizens still in their clutches. Do not take this lightly, prepare for any eventuality!
progress: It may be too much to ask from you, but we don't have any luxuries left at this point.
completion:
What travesties have transpired at this place...? Never have I witnessed such horrors in my life, the thought of such profanities even existing send shivers down my spine.

<name>, your bravery in descending this spiral of madness is a heroic feat rarely seen nowadays. Your service to the kingdom and all of the Alliance this day will be remembered by those present and cherished by those affected. These rewards do not match the magnitude of your deeds, but take them nevertheless.

You are dismissed.
rewards:
You may choose one of:
- [Rufus' Trusty Tankard](Rufus' Trusty Tankard)
- [Kinrial's Scalpel](Kinrial's Scalpel)
- [Noppsy's Compendium](Noppsy's Compendium)
- [Nippsy's Precision Rifle](Nippsy's Precision Rifle)
You will also receive:
- 3600 XP

title: Assassin In Training
objectives:
Thin out the chain of command within Stormwrought Ruins and return to Nippsy Spickerspan in the SI:7 Outpost on Balor.
- [Oronok Torn-Heart](Oronok Torn-Heart) slain
- [Chieftain Stormsong](Chieftain Stormsong) slain
- [Stormreaver Battlemaster](Stormreaver Battlemaster) slain (12)
description:
So the time to infiltrate Stormwrought Castle has finally come. This den of devils will demand every last bit of your focus and skill for you to come back in one piece. I won’t mince my words, but you’re surely aware of it yourself already, no? The others and I will secure the perimeter on the castle courtyard to prevent reinforcements halting your operations.

Operative Gillian has ordered you to dispatch the head of the hydra, which is undoubtedly the most crucial task of all. Still, to ensure no resurgence occurs by surviving figureheads, we need to make sure to snuff them out as well. Liquidate any tough guy you come across. We don’t want to deal with that scum again.
progress: I am sure you will run into more than enough fitting candidates for my task there.
completion: Most impressive. It’s a shame you're not cut out for this field of work. Don’t get me wrong, you possess the skills and wits necessary, but I know your adventurous spirit cannot be tamed and seeks the grandeur of Azeroth. Still, the SI:7 owes you much, so let me reward you appropriately for all you’ve done.

title: Antiquities

fields.name: Antiquities
fields.rewards: Choice of:, Antiquated Slasher, or, Chainmail of Many Pockets

objectives:
Recover ‘Compendium of Successful Trade’ within Stormwrought Castle for Noppsy Spickerspan at the SI:7 Outpost on Balor.
- [Compendium of Successful Trade](Compendium of Successful Trade)
description:
If you’re entering Stormwrought Castle, I have one humble request for you. The Balor family amassed countless books and tomes over the many years they held authority over the island. Following decades of trade, they collected a sheer unimaginable amount of knowledge in their library. One of them, the personal teachings and lectures on the hidden practices of trade by Sir Walton Balor, younger brother of the second Duke of Balor, is a book both I and Stormwind are very much interested in.

Should you come across the vast library of Stormwrought Castle, search it for said book. And <name>: Beware of the dangers inside. I dare not think about the terrors that await you within those vile halls.
progress: Stormwind always envied the Balorians on perfecting the art of successful trade not only with them, but several other nations as well. It’d be a shame if that knowledge would be lost in time, no?
completion: Oh, more dusty than my grandmother back in Ironforge. Time has not been kind to this old tome, and the humid air is not exactly helping either. I will seal it properly in my chest and begin analysis back in the SI:7 headquarters. For you, <name>, my heartfelt gratitude. Please choose a reward fitting for your service.
rewards:
You may choose one of:
- [Antiquated Slasher](Antiquated Slasher)
- [Chainmail of Many Pockets](Chainmail of Many Pockets)
You will also receive:
- 3200 XP

title: Crystal Clear Impression
objectives:
Find a Stormwrought Crystal for Grukson Slatebeard at Slatebeard's Forge.
- [Stormwrought Crystal](Stormwrought Crystal)
description:
My father is one of the finest smiths in all of Grim Reaches, and everyone knows it. I've been trying to earn his respect for years, but no matter what I do, it never seems to measure up to what Margella makes. She's just… better.

But I've been working on something special—something that might finally change that. A mace, a true masterwork of mine. It's not finished yet, though. It needs something rare, something powerful that will set it apart from every other weapon on the wall.

I've heard that deep below the Stormwrought Ruins on Balor, there are glowing red crystals—Stormwrought Crystals. They're said to carry incredible power, and if I could set one into the mace's head, it might finally prove that I'm a worthy smith too.

If you're headed to Balor, could you bring one back for me?
progress: Have you found the crystal yet?
completion:
The crystal!

<Grukson turns it over in his hands, clearly impressed.>

It's just how I imagined it—absolutely perfect. This will make the mace something truly special.

I'd better get to work, then. Maybe this time… my father will finally see what I'm capable of.
rewards:
You will receive:
- [Slatebeard Amulet](Slatebeard Amulet)
- 3500 XP

title: All That Is Left
objectives:
Bring the wooden toy sword to someone that knew its owner. You may have luck in Northwind, where all of this started.
- [Etched Toy Sword](Etched Toy Sword)
description: <Among the puddle left behind by the monstrosity, you find a badly damaged wooden sword. Its size is tiny and the ooze's acid etched most of its surface. You can, however, decipher the words “Sir Tim-” on the toy's hilt. Perhaps that is enough to know who it belonged to.>
progress:
<Judith is still sobbing.>

Oh, Sara, my darling angel… By the Light, please let my Timothy be safe…!
completion:
What…? What is this? Where did you…?! No, no, no! Timothy! My little Timmy, no! Oh, Light, why have you forsaken me?! He was just a boy, my sweet, innocent boy!

<Judith is breaking down. Hysteric crying and yelling is all she can do right now. You did what you could. Atleast she has certainty now.>

title: Storm, Twilight and Hammer
objectives:
Return the second fragment of the key back to Drak'thul in his hut.
- [Gro'tul Deathrattle](Gro'tul Deathrattle) slain
- [Second Key Fragment](Second Key Fragment)
description:
The Stormreaver Clan was not composed solely of orcs from the Shadow Council, but also included the ogre magi who served under Cho'Gall. While a questionable ally, Gul'dan kept that two-headed buffoon as close as he could. I do wonder if the reason was that he knew they would one day betray each other in their lust for power.

Alas, one failed while the other lives—hiding beneath the sands, behind the cloak of a cult that worships myths and legends as old as this world. I have taken the liberty of making the succubi share their plans with me. To the west, past the cave where you defeated her, you will find the Windrock Cliffs. It is there that a member of the Twilight's Hammer holds a fragment of the key. Slay him and return with whatever you find.
progress: The lockbox merely contained the first fragment.
completion: Both fragments together will now serve as the key to enter the ruins of the castle. Beware, for you will face both servants of the Legion and cultists of those long forgotten.
rewards:
You will receive:
- [Key to Stormwrought Castle](Key to Stormwrought Castle)
- 2000 XP

title: Lady Who?
objectives:
Slay Lady Harelyss, return her soul and the item she carries to Drak'thul in his hut.
- [Lady Harelyss](Lady Harelyss) slain
- [Harelyss' Soul](Harelyss' Soul)
- [Rusty Sealed Lockbox](Rusty Sealed Lockbox)
description:
I am sure you are eager to take the battle to the castle at any cost as soon as possible. But for you to do so we must first find the key to open it. Inside the same cave I have sent you to hunt the demons summoned by the Stormreaver Clan you will also find one that has claimed leadership over the rest. She calls herself Lady Harelyss.

This demon holds a great importance, simply because–if my own minions speak the truth, she holds an item that will secure us the key to the castle. While I cannot have you return her here, since you would have to drag her through a battlefield, I will give you a soulshard–the minute you deal the final blow, you will capture her soul in it, simply by having it on you.

Make sure to retrieve the item we are indeed looking for, her demise is inevitable and capturing her soul is simply our insurance in case we need to gather more information.
progress: I wonder what sort of dark, twisted artefact she holds that can provide her ownership of a copy of the key.
completion:
<Drak'thul cracks the box open.>

What is this...?

title: Mycellakos (quest)
objectives:
Slay Mycellakos and bring back Core of Mycellakos back to Uda'pe Sungrass in Stormbreaker Point.
- [Mycellakos](Mycellakos) slain
- [Heart of Mycellakos](Heart of Mycellakos)
description:
These samples have a dark feeling to them. I don't know if you can tell, but it seems they have been infused with some sort of magic—magic that brought them into a state of life.

From what I can tell, they resemble the boggling creatures of Kalimdor, yet are far more twisted. I have yet to attempt cleansing them, though truth be told, this is just dead tissue at this point.

I believe these living fungi originate from a common source. To speak plainly, there should be a larger one that infected the rest. I say this not simply on a whim, but because I feel something from the isle—around the area of the ruined castle—rather, under it.

I believe the source of contamination comes from there. If you can find your way beneath the castle, you might uncover the answers we seek.

Return anything you deem important to me.
progress: The Earthmother will guide you to the answer.
completion: You have brought me its core? Well done. I will attempt to purify it now.

title: The Matron Will Know

fields.name: The Matron Will Know
fields.rewards: Choice of:, Left,, Right, or, Totem of An'she

objectives:
Bring the Core of Mycellakos to Magatha Grimtotem in The Elder Rise, Thunder Bluff.
- [Heart of Mycellakos](Heart of Mycellakos)
description:
Purifying this core is well beyond my abilities. As much as I hate to admit it, there is no way I can do this alone.

It is with a heavy heart that I part with this core; I wished for nothing more than to research it and uncover what caused it to become alive. Nevertheless, this is knowledge that must be passed on.

There is someone who will surely know how to handle the core—our Matron. You will find her in Thunder Bluff, at the Elder Rise.

Pay no mind to Cor and Grom; I will give you my mark, and you will be able to walk freely past them.

Do not speak too much before the Matron. She has a short fuse, and—believe it or not—I have grown fond of you.
progress: Speak.
completion:
Uda'pe was right to send you to me. Though we are not very fond of working with the Horde, you have my thanks and will be paid accordingly.

I will even add a bonus for being so silent and respectful—Uda'pe taught you well.
rewards:
You may choose one of:
- [Left](Left)
- [Right](Right)
- [Totem of An'she](Totem of An'she)
You will also receive:
- 2000 XP

title: Living Fungus
objectives:
Collect 7 Vegetative Sample from the Poisonous and Living Mushroom Beasts and return to Uda'pe Sungrass in Stormbreaker Point in Balor.
- [Vegetative Sample](Vegetative Sample) (7)
description:
Among the ruined battlefield, a cave can be found—an old mine, perhaps. It is there that I have sensed an unnatural disturbance.

Something once immobile has risen on its own feet to live. Much like the undead scattered across this ruined land, these creatures are mindless and will attack any on sight.

I task you to go there, find them, and slay some. I will need samples, so be sure to bring something sharp. With those samples, I can study what made them rise.

I should tell you beforehand—this will not aid our efforts to remove the Stormreaver—but I will have a reward ready for you.

Do not make me wait.
progress: This task can wait, but I would rather you fulfill it as quickly as possible.
completion: You have my thanks—and with them, a reward.

title: Grim Sunlight
objectives:
Kill 12 Stormreaver Mystic, return to Stormbreaker Point once your task is complete.
- [Stormreaver Mystic](Stormreaver Mystic) slain (12)
description:
Made by the hands of men, the only light still visible across Balor is kept prisoner just under our noses. A lighthouse—a strange form of artificial light. The world is vast beyond the villages of my tribe, and the Earthmother holds many children—but some, she was forced to adopt.

The Horde is no stranger to them either, and as much as I would like to say otherwise, I do not think I will ever look upon them with true empathy. A specter of respect? Pity, perhaps. Nevertheless, I am straying from the purpose of our conversation.

Under the gaze of that lighthouse, you will find many so-called Mystics, though you may seek them elsewhere if you wish.

I task you with slaying as many as you can. The empty shells of fel corruption, and their rotting flesh will serve as nourishment in time, allowing nature to take its course once more.
progress: In time, An'she will return to these lands.
completion: A mercy far too great for scum like them. Take these; they will carry the light of An'she with you through grim lands.
rewards:
You will receive:
- [Sunkissed Shoulderpads](Sunkissed Shoulderpads)
- 2800 XP

title: Artifact of the Dark Lady

fields.name: Artifact of the Dark Lady
fields.rewards: Choice of:, Lady Winter's Touch, or, Ring of Judgement

objectives:
Deliver the Bloodstone Pendant to Lady Sylvanas Windrunner in Undercity.
- [Broken Bloodstone Pendant](Broken Bloodstone Pendant)
description:
<In your hand is the broken Bloodstone Pendant used by Ighal’for, disciple of the deranged Cho’gall, to summon the abhorrent beholder Mergothid into Azeroth. The wounds of the fierce battle against the demon are still strewn across your body. Blood runs down your arm onto your palm. Suddenly, the pendant shakes violently, letting out a twisted shriek while drawing in the red liquid. Shortly after, the blood is gone - and the pendant starts pulsating.

You remember assisting a Forsaken warden in Tarren Mill recovering similar artifacts; relics that belonged to the Dark Lady, Sylvanas Windrunner. It’d be best to return her stolen trinkets back to her.>
progress: Speak quickly. I don’t intend to waste my time with vermin.
completion:
Look what the cat dragged in. I was assuming Wordeen had atleast a smidgeon of competency left in his body, but I was sorely mistaken, it seems. To think one of my artifacts escaped those irritating mages and ended up in the clutches of the Shadow Council. Curious, indeed…

<name>, with the return of the pendant, I am closing the book on this unfortunate circumstance among my subordinates. The traitors have been dealt with, my relics are secured and you… You shall be rewarded for delivering a decisive strike against those misusing my possessions.
rewards:
You may choose one of:
- [Lady Winter's Touch](Lady Winter's Touch)
- [Ring of Judgement](Ring of Judgement)
You will also receive:
- 1200 [XP](XP)

title: The Late Duke Balor

fields.name: The Late Duke Balor
fields.rewards: Choice of:, Drinking Halfhorn, or, Enchanted Glass Kopis

objectives:
Return the Crown of Balor to Olmir Halfhorn.
- [Crown of Balor](Crown of Balor)
description:
I promised the Explorers' League a prize whenever I left Ironforge, mostly because they wounded my pride! I dug here and there, but there wasn't much to find on this side of the island, and I'm not strong enough to take on an entire army of orcs just to fulfill my ambition. As much as it pains me, I might have to return empty-handed.

Unless... How about we make a trade? An heirloom for an heirloom. You scratch my back, I'll scratch yours, that sort of thing. I have this artifact I dug up on another expedition that I'm willing to trade, if you return with something from the Duke's castle. I'm man enough to admit my knowledge of Balor is quite limited, but the late Duke must have had something valuable. A sword, a shield, a crown—whatever you may find, bring it back to me, and we'll make the trade.
progress: Did you come up with something?
completion: While in poor condition, it is still the crown of a duke. This will prove those rascals in the Halls of Explorers wrong! Thank you, <race>. Here is what I promised.
rewards:
You may choose one of:
- [Drinking Halfhorn](Drinking Halfhorn)
- [Enchanted Glass Kopis](Enchanted Glass Kopis)
You will also receive:
- 3500 XP

title: Skull And Bones
objectives:
Enter Stormwrought Castle and retrieve the Balor Sigil Ring for Lord Olivert Grahan in his estate on western Balor.
- [Balor Sigil Ring](Balor Sigil Ring)
description:
The Balor family held sovereignty over this island for many years. Even after becoming a vessel state, Stormwind's king allowed the first Duke to govern the state he built under many hardships and tribulations. His scions continued his legacy, each one of them reigning over the merchant paradise with a watchful eye and merciful soul. Us Grahans acted as their advisors and protectors, and we held that position with pride. As such, the immense shame that still fills my very being for failing my lord all those years ago is all the more unbearable. I may not be able to rewrite the past, but I can yet honor the Balor family's legacy.

My ghost is tethered to this estate, so I implore you to accomplish this feat in my stead. Enter Stormwrought Castle and seek the remnants of my old friend. His bones may long have turned to ash within the cursed halls of his home, but his sigil ring may yet remain. Seek it, return the band to me, so that you may be within my ever-lasting debt.
progress: The history of Balor continues to be written, where it will lead, I do not know. But this chapter of its past needs to be closed, that I am certain of.
completion:
Frederik, old friend. Figments of your essence linger in this dull trinket, bare of any grandeur it once held. One day, when I may finally pass on and leave this realm, I will see you once more...

<name>, blessings upon you. This ring will find its way into oblivion, far away from the clutches of darkness, I will make sure of that. For your courageous act, take this from my remaining corporeal belongings. You deserve it well.
rewards:
You will receive:
- [Grahan Family Seal](Grahan Family Seal)
- 3600 XP

title: The Dead Can’t Complain
objectives:
Rikki Fizmask wants you to pillage the Stormwrought Ruins on Balor and return to her at the Gullwing Wreckage.
- [Balorian Treasure](Balorian Treasure) (10)
description:
When we crashlanded here on this island, we noticed that most of our cargo had dropped into the wide expanses of the ocean. While we still have a good chunk of it secured, it’s not nearly enough to satisfy our recipients in Booty Bay. Yunie and the others have their hands full repairing the zeppelin and making sure we don’t actually get eaten by monstrous crustaceans. I on the other hand had the golden opportunity to scout the island when we were looking for Verix a while back. And wouldn’t you know it: there is a giant castle atop the cliffs. You can probably guess what I am hinting at. While I am not as crazy and suicidal as Verix, I would be remiss to pass up this opportunity to grab some valuables no goblin has ever seen before.

Which is where you come in. Grab some friends or pay someone if you don’t have any and grab as many valuables as you can get from within that castle on the other side of Balor. It will pay off, trust me!
progress: You’re tough - or foolish - enough to come to this cursed place on your own, so I’m sure you’ll have no problems going in there and coming back out unharmed - mostly, atleast.
completion: Wow, what a haul. Might not be exactly what we were supposed to be delivering, but I doubt those greedy bastards in their pirate cove will complain that much. Thank you so much, <name>. We owe you big time. You can have this for your troubles, it always gave me the best of luck - the fact I’m still here is proof of that.
rewards:
You will receive:
- [Trusty Goblin Shiv](Trusty Goblin Shiv)
- 2800 XP

title: Searching for Archaeologist Evenpike
objectives: Search for Archeologist Evenpike inside Frostmane Hollow in Dun Morogh.
description: Excuse me, do you have a moment? A colleague of mine from the Explorer’s League went off following a clue on an artifact he had been researching about for a long time now. Normally I would trust him to be reasonable, but he intends to descend Frostmane Hollow, the sanctum of the savage Frost Trolls terrorizing Dun Morogh. Please, could you assemble a group of mercenaries and get that fool of a friend back? You will find the entrance to Frostmane Hollow in the mountains of Dun Morogh, very close to the Ironforge Airfields.
completion: The icy cold of the cave has preserved Evenpike’s body and halted decomposition. You were sadly too late.

title: The Shattered Disc
objectives:
Return to Brohann Caskbelly in the Dwarven District of Stormwind.
- [Shattered Platinum Disc](Shattered Platinum Disc)
description: Locked tight in the frozen grip of the dwarf’s corpse is the fragment of a pristine piece of metal, on which you can see a language unknown to you engraved into the surface. Seemingly worth his death, you bring it into your possession with the intent to let Caskbelly know about it and his friend’s demise.
progress: <name>! You have returned. Pray tell, where is Evenpike?
completion:
By the Makers, he was right. Oh, Odum, you lunatic! Betting your life on it was not worth it!

<Brohann exhales a deep sigh of exhaustion.>

<name>, my friend was searching for an old relic he presumed to be of Titan origin, the celestial beings that once visited Azeroth. Many scholars and professors in our great city of Ironforge theorize a link between the dwarves’ creation and those god-like beings. He assumed what you now hold in your hand could bring dwarvenkind one step closer to the truth, but it appears to not be complete. Still, Evenpike paid with his life to bring us this phenomenal find and I will honor his sacrifice with pride. Once I am done here in Stormwind, I will present it to High Explorer Magellas in the Great Library of Ironforge for further research.

For you, I have a just reward, for both your heroism and contribution to archeology. May you fare well on your journeys, traveler.
rewards:
You will receive:
- [Archaeologist's Lantern](Archaeologist's Lantern)
- 850 XP

title: The Finest Pelt
objectives:
Enter Frostmane Hollow in Dun Morogh and acquire a flawless leopard pelt for Shandlar Thethis in Alah’thalas in the Thalassian Highlands. You can find the entrance to Frostmane Hollow near the Ironforge Airfields.
- [Flawless Leopard Pelt](Flawless Leopard Pelt)
description:
Ba’la dash, malanore. It has been brought to my attention that the deep caverns of Khaz Modan house a particular breed of snow leopards whose fur boasts a remarkable sheen of white. My lord, Astalor of House Sunsworn, requested a one-of-a-kind mantle for his upcoming dinner party and I intend to combine said white fur with the most pristine brocade cloth I have in my possession.

Adventurer, would you be interested in a job of the lucrative kind? If you bring me an immaculate leopard pelt from within Frostmane Hollow, then I will reward you with a fine piece from my current collection. Do we come to an agreement?
progress: Make haste, <class>. My liege is not known for his patience.
completion: The rumors were correct, rarely have I seen such a smooth and silky pelt before. I cannot wait to start working with it. As promised, a reward for you as well. I am sure you will find ample use for it.
rewards:
You will receive:
- [Thalassian Silk Cape](Thalassian Silk Cape)
- 1250 XP

title: Chieftain Ubukaz

fields.name: Chieftain Ubukaz
fields.rewards: Choose one:, Heavy Chain Bracers,, Sash of Illumination, or, Deep-Thread Shawl

objectives:
Slay Battlemaster Ubukaz deep within Frostmane Hollow for Mountaineer Granitebeard at the Ironforge Airfield in Dun Morogh.
- [Battlemaster Ubukaz](Battlemaster Ubukaz) slain
description:
My scouts have confirmed the location of a cave to the south west. It is called Frostmane Hollow, some de-facto capital for all of the troll kind in Dun Morogh. If we want to ever put a halt to this threat, we will need to root it out, from deep inside. Rumor has it that their leader is one called Battlemaster Ubukaz, some revered Frostmane fighter who now calls his warriors to battle. I want you to find him, and bring justice for Ironforge.

I would advise you to bring reinforcements, there is no telling just how many enemies you may find in that cave.
progress: Be prepared for anything <class>, the Frostmane are a cunning foe.
completion:
So, Ubukaz has been slain?

<Granitebeard takes a moment, a smirk crossing his face.>

I cannot believe my ears, I have no doubt there will be a another troll that shall rise to be chieftain, but for these coming days, peace shall be had in Dun Morogh.

Until their infighting is over, we have time to celebrate!
rewards:
You may choose one of:
- [Heavy Chain Bracers](Heavy Chain Bracers)
- [Sash of Illumination](Sash of Illumination)
- [Deep-Thread Shawl](Deep-Thread Shawl)
You will also receive:
- 1200 XP

title: The Frostmane War
objectives:
Slay 8 Frostmane Scouts, 6 Frostmane Drudges, and 6 Frostmane Mystics for Mountaineer Granitebeard at the Ironforge Airfield in Dun Morogh.
- [Frostmane Scout](Frostmane Scout) slain (8)
- [Frostmane Drudge](Frostmane Drudge) slain (6)
- [Frostmane Mystic](Frostmane Mystic) slain (6)
description:
You there <class>, I have need of your assistance.

The local Frostmane have become a greater hinderance than we first anticipated. Every day their numbers and aggression seems to swell, it will not be long before they become brazen enough to attack the airfield.

This frozen lake seperates us from their main den to the south-west, and if it weren't for the damned terrain I would just drive these tanks there and wipe them out.

When you thin their numbers, return to me, and we can advise our next plan of attack.
progress: Do not let your guard down around those blasted trolls. They lack honor, and will strike even if you have your back turned.
completion: Got rid of those trolls have ye? Ironforge is just a little bit safer thanks to your actions, but now we can put our attentions at the real threats.

title: A Grave Misunderstanding!
objectives:
Recover the Tablet of Kaz'gan for Ranix Crackbolt within Frostmane Hollow.
- [Tablet of Kaz'gan](Tablet of Kaz'gan)
description:
<Ranix lets out a breathe of relief, sweat drips down his forehead.>

Boy, am I happy you've come to your senses. There's no point in violence here, infact, I have work for you! Y-yeah, you see, we weren't selling weapons or anything of that sort here. I am just an honest trader, who was looking to acquire something from these Frostmane.

I think it would be in both of our best interests while you're here rooting around and, bringing justice or however to work together. You see, the Frostmane have a rare tablet I was looking to acquire, and they've been a bit slow in handing it over, it is called the Tablet of Kaz'gan, located somewhere here in these corridors...

<Ranix clears his throat.>

So what say you? Coin for work?
progress: So... Have you had any luck yet? I don't want to spend too much longer down here if I don't have too.
completion:
<Ranix stares upon the tablet with interest gleaming on his eyes.>

This is it, wow, I did not think you would actually live up to your word on this! You did well, and since I am such an outstanding, and noble goblin I will pay you what your work is worth.

I will be out of here soon enough, thanks again.

title: In Search of Tauren Relics
objectives:
Gather 8 Windhorn Relics for Tarwegg Dustbrow within Windhorn Canyon and return to him in Ironforge.
- [Windhorn Relic](Windhorn Relic) (8)
description:
You there, explorer! Have you heard of the sacred canyon of the tauren, where houses are etched in rock and tunnels delve beneath the earth?

If you had told me this story a few weeks ago, I would simply have laughed at you for such tales, but now I have come to find out that this story is truth! A reliable source of mine has told me about a place known as Windhorn Canyon nestled in Thousand Needles. Only recently discovered due to some battle that has taken place within. Now, as my source tells me, it is teeming with Grimtotem.

Regardless of whatever evil lurks there, I wish to commission your services to return some of the relics that may linger there. Do this right, and you shall be paid appropriately!
progress: Remember, the Canyon is located deep within Thousand Needles, you will need to travel to the far corners of Kalimdor to find it.
completion:
Magnificent, I was once as ignorant to think the Tauren had no history, and just wandered plains like nomads. This certainly has changed my view upon them as a whole.

You have done well adventurer, please, take this coin for doing such brave, and noble work.

title: Relics of the Windhorn Tribe
objectives:
Travel into the Windhorn Canyon and recover 8 Windhorn Relics for Sagh at Sagh's Refuge in Thousand Needles.
- [Windhorn Relic](Windhorn Relic) (8)
description:
I spent the majority of my life with the Windhorn Tribe, and came to respect and value their traditions. With the pillaging of Windhorn Canyon by the Grimtotem, I fear that the history and culture of the Windhorn may fall into obscurity.

When I fled Windhorn Canyon during the raid the only thing that was on my mind was survival. Now I regret not bringing any of the precious relics that dwell in the city into safety. It will only be a matter of time until they are all destroyed, or lost to time.

I ask of you to brave the Windhorn Canyon. Recover any antiques that you may find inside, return them to me and you shall be rewarded.
progress: Tread carefully, the Grimtotem have fortified Windhorn Canyon and claimed it as their own. The large, steep cliffs provide an excellent redoubt for defence. I advise you to bring allies if you wish to help.
completion:
I spent the entirety of my youth surrounded by such relics. The craftsmanship of the Windhorn is certainly superb.

Without your help, this history would have been lost to time. I thank you, for everything that you have done this day.
rewards:
You will receive:
- [Sagh's Pendant](Sagh's Pendant)
- 2350 XP

title: The Wrath of Malgan

fields.name: The Wrath of Malgan
fields.rewards: Choice of:, Hauberk of Bloodshed, or, Cloudtotem Cloak

objectives:
Slay 20 Blackwind Villagers on behalf of Malgan Windhorn at Sagh's Refuge in Thousand Needles.
- [Blackwind Villager](Blackwind Villager) slain (20)
description:
Our sacred home has been destroyed, desecrated, and now occupied by the Grimtotem and their tribe. My people were slaughtered like animals, and left to live out our lives as vagabonds with no place to call home.

The pain I have felt still burns within me, and I desire our aggressors to know my pain.

I ask of you to travel back to Windhorn Canyon, and bring devastation, not only to the Grimtotem, but to their people. Slaughter the villagers that now call that place home, and make our conquerors mourn as I have.
progress: It is only a matter of time before they feel what I have felt. They shall pay for their actions, and I shall have my revenge.
completion:
Blood for blood. You have done well, and repaid this evil with vengeance. I hope you feel the satisfaction that I feel, for I am vindicated, even if anger still burns deep in my heart.

I must thank you for being the hand of my wrath. Please, take these coins, as tribute from me, and those lost.
rewards:
You may choose one of:
- [Hauberk of Bloodshed](Hauberk of Bloodshed)
- [Cloudtotem Cloak](Cloudtotem Cloak)
You will also receive:
- 2200 XP
notes: - The quest erroneously awards [Ironforge](Ironforge (faction)) reputation.

title: Destroy the Deathtotem

fields.name: Destroy the Deathtotem
fields.rewards: Choice of:, Bloodhoof Sash,, Stormhoof Shackles, or, Stonemane Boots

objectives:
Slay Prophet Stormhoof, the leader of the Deathtotem within Windhorn Canyon, and return to Cairne Bloodhoof in Thunderbluff.
- [Prophet Stormhoof](Prophet Stormhoof) slain
description:
It would appear that evil once again knocks at our door, and has threatened the balance of peace between the tribes. I must ask you to destroy this Deathtotem, and bring their evil to an end.

The Windhorn Canyon is located within the Thousand Needles, and it is there you will find the leader of this cult. Prophet Stormhide should be slain so that his schemes may be brought to an end. Do this for the unity of the tribes, and on my behalf.

Go with the strength of the spirits and bring glory to the Horde young one.
progress: Take heart, and be careful in your task. I am certain that the Deathtotem are aided by dark magic. Bring what company you can, and be swift in your actions.
completion:
<Cairne gazes upon you with a look of approval.>

You have done well, and have brought peace to the Tauren. The Deathtotem shall trouble us no longer young blood. Please, be bestowed by an item that shall bring you fortune in the days to come.
rewards:
You may choose one of:
- [Bloodhoof Sash](Bloodhoof Sash)
- [Stormhoof Shackles](Stormhoof Shackles)
- [Stonemane Boots](Stonemane Boots)
You will also receive:
- 3400 XP

title: The Wall Comes Crashing Down
objectives: Venture to Gilneas and pledge your support to Lord Darius Ravenwood.
description:
Indeed, it is a momentous occasion. The Greymane Wall has finally been breached.

During their long years of isolation, the Gilnean throne has fallen into the hands of a pair of Alteraci nobles - Harlows. They harbor open hostility towards the Alliance, making it crucial for us to support the rebellion that has taken root within Gilneas. They call themselves the Ravenwood Rebellion, and it is through their efforts that the gates of Gilneas have been opened once more. Their leader has reached out to the Alliance, beseeching us for aid.

I have received orders from Lord Fordragon himself to deploy any able-bodied soldiers to lend assistance to the Ravenwood Rebellion in their struggle for the liberation of Gilneas. Travel westward, through Silverpine until you reach the Greymane Wall. Beyond it, nestled along the coastline, you will find the town of Ravenshire.

Once you arrive, seek out Lord Ravenwood. Assure him that the Alliance stands unwavering in its commitment to its allies.
progress: I haven't seen you here before.
completion:
So the promised aid finally arrives.

Genn Greymane's profound lack of trust in the Alliance was undoubtedly one of his gravest misjudgments. Though I can appreciate his reasoning behind such a decision, I could never fully endorse it. However, that is all in the past now, and dwelling on it serves no purpose.

I extend my warmest welcome to you and the formidable might of the Alliance. Ravenshire may be a modest town, but it holds the flame of resilience and hope that will ignite the rekindling of our beloved Gilneas. In due time, we shall extend our hospitality and invite you to partake in a grand feast within the walls of Gilneas City itself. But before we can revel in such festivities, there is much work to be done.

title: Scouring Greyshire
objectives:
Recover the Greyshire Manuscripts from the Ruins of Greyshire for Father Oblen at Shademore Tavern in Gilneas.
- [Greyshire Manuscripts](Greyshire Manuscripts)
description:
It may seem dreary here in Gilneas, though I must assure you this was not always our reality. In times past, I spent many years studying under my masters' tutelage, and painting great manuscripts for the Light. I spread the faith and broke bread with many fine folk.

There are a foolish few who would assume we went unscathed during the perilous times of the Third War. Whilst we may not have suffered directly from the plague as our northern cousins have, we did have conflict with the Scourge.

You see, two years ago, a powerful lich named Naze the Eternal breached the wall near Oldrock Pass. Ultimately, the undead were defeated by the good soldiers of Gilneas, but our victory was paid at a terrible toll.

I was lucky to escape Greyshire with my life, others were not so fortunate. I ask of you to scour that forsaken place, and recover the manuscripts that I spent my younger years painting. While you are there, bring peace to some of the forlorn souls that still remain.
progress: It may seem like a perilous task, but remember: Keep your faith in the Light and you are bound to find yourself on the right path.
completion:
Ahh, I never thought I would look upon these scripts again, lucky they are to have survived all of the misery that befell that place.

I thank you greatly for your efforts, <class>. Please, take this as a sign of my gratitude.
rewards:
You will receive:
- [Cuffs of Sanctitude](Cuffs of Sanctitude)
- 3300 XP

title: Legend of Dawnstone
objectives:
Bring 12 chunks of Dawnstone Ore to Kurnen Oathbrace in Booty Bay. The ore can be found only in Dawnstone Mine in Gilneas.
- [Dawnstone Ore](Dawnstone Ore) (12)
description:
Aye, laddie! Have ye heard of the legendary Dawnstone Ore? It's a tale of epic proportions, that is! Used to forge armor for our brave paladins durin' the Second War. Those were glorious days indeed!

But let me tell ya, it's a scarce find, that it is! Only one place in this whole wide world where it can be dug up – a mine hidden beneath Gilneas City. Aye, there is a curse or somethin' down there, somethin' mysterious that brought this precious ore to the surface. And by the beard of my father, I don't reckon I'd be wantin' to know the true nature of it.

You see, the Greymane Gate's been opened once more, and the political mess in Gilneas has left that mine likely abandoned. So, I'm thinking of gatherin' it for my clients in Undermine. If you can get your hands on twelve hefty chunks of Dawnstone Ore for me, I'll be more than willin' to share some percent of the profits with you. Now, what say ye? Do we have a deal?
progress: I wonder if the mine is still intact...
completion:
Aye, the ore, just as I expected! You've done me proud, lad! Now, let me gather up these precious rocks and get 'em ready for a journey to Undermine. Ah, the thought of the profits fills me with joy!

You've earned yourself a reward, as promised. Here, take this with ye, if ye must.

title: The Dawnstone Coupler
objectives:
Travel to Gilneas in the north and collect 4 Dawnstone Chunks for Technician Voltgear at the Gnomeregan Reclamation Facility in Dun Morogh.
- [Dawnstone Chunk](Dawnstone Chunk) (4)
description:
When Gnomeregan was built many years ago we had access to all sorts of materials from around the world. Dawnstone, one such material that we used, was excellent for being a coupler of energy. It was highly resistant to both magical, and powerful currents of energy. Making it highly versatile in its uses.

We have been unable to recreate any replicas to fix those that have broken down, having to replace them with subpar stand-ins that break much more often.

Though it would appear we have a surge of luck on our side. You see, Gilneas has opened its gates once again. Rumors of civil problems are abound there.

I need you to head to Gilneas far to the north and gather me a supply of four Dawnstone Ore. It should be found at the Dawnstone Mine near the city.
progress: We have been going through Copper Couplers faster than I can wrap my head around! If we are to keep up with all of the repair work required in this facility we need something that can last.
completion: These dull, repressed glints, I remember them fondly. Excellent work <class>, with this ore we will be able to produce enough conductors to fix what is needed in the facility.
rewards:
You will receive:
- [Servocharged Wrench](Servocharged Wrench)
- 4400 XP

title: Wyrms of the Highlands
objectives:
Bring 10 Mana Wyrm Eyes to [Commander Braedin](Commander Braedin) in [Silver Covenant Camp](Silver Covenant Camp).
- [Mana Wyrm Eye](Mana Wyrm Eye) (10)
description:
As members of The Silver Covenant, our mission is clear – to cleanse these lands of any perils that endanger the refugees seeking sanctuary. Among these threats, the burgeoning population of Mana Wyrms poses a significant concern. Their numbers surge as they feed off the mana employed in their vicinity, unsettling the balance we seek.

I task you with culling their numbers and bringing me ten Mana Wyrm eyes as evidence of their demise. Not only will this act bring peace to these lands, but the collected eyes will also serve as catalysts to charge more mana crystals, addressing two issues in a singular endeavor.
progress: Yes, <class>?
completion: Thank you, <class>. The roads are safer, and I'll make sure the charged mana crystals are distributed among the poorest of our kin.
rewards:
You will receive:
- [Mana Wyrm Cape](Mana Wyrm Cape)
- 8200 XP
- +150 [reputation](reputation) with [Silvermoon Remnant](Silvermoon Remnant)

title: Magister's Letter (quest)
objectives:
Read the Magister's Letter and speak to Magister Ala'shor.
- [Magister's Letter](Magister's Letter)
description:
<name>, the fall of our homeland has affected us all. But, even if our education down this path was cut short, there are still ways to learn.

Recently, someone left a letter on the desk and it was addressed to you.

Perhaps you should read it and see what it says?
progress: The Magisterium is the most prestigious group that a mage can be a part of.
completion:
Ah, <name>, I take it you're here to become my apprentice?

If so, then know that I will not coddle you. You will be serving under a proud member of the Magisterium.

As such, you will be taught what I deem necessary for your progress. Continue to perform adequately and I shall continue to guide you.

Eventually, you will be fit enough for the Magisterium.

Talk to me again once you are prepared.
rewards:
You will receive:
- 400 XP
- +150 [reputation](reputation) with [Silvermoon Remnant](Silvermoon Remnant)

title: A Familiar Disturbance

fields.name: A Familiar Disturbance
fields.previous: Rift Fatigue: Mind & Rift Fatigue: Body

objectives: Travel to Moonwhisper Coast north of Azshara and locate the shimmering lake.
description:
Now that I regained my strength, my senses are sharp once more, and I can feel the magic of your world far better than before. What I felt, however, was surprising, a sensation that had an aura of familiarity to it. It came from the north, a whirlwind of conflicting energy. Ideals clashing, emotions uncertain and a great change abound. You may have seen it already, beyond the cliffs to the north is a land clad in blue, its cerulean hue draping the coast in serene midnight. In my mind I have the image of a great shimmering lake, there I had felt the sensation the strongest.

<name>, once we have secured the safety of my people, would you travel to the lands north of here and search for this peculiarity I sensed? My heart tells me it is of great importance.
completion: What are you saying? You have been sent here by another draenei, a riftwalker no less?!

title: Homecoming
objectives:
Bring Elder Krasheen's projection crystal to Sanv K'la in the Harborage in the Swamp of Sorrows.
- [Elder Krasheen's Projection Crystal](Elder Krasheen's Projection Crystal)
description:
I could have never imagined it. For so long we have lived with the thought of us being the only draenei to have survived the breaking of our homeworld. To think that another tribe has managed to escape to your world as well…

<class>, we must get in contact with them. You may be a stranger to the Moro'gai, but you are acquainted with another draenei tribe, so I place my trust in you. Take this crystal and bring it to their chieftain. It is a projection crystal in which I have stored my image into. Tell them that, and they will know how to proceed.
progress: <name>, it is good to see you again in the Harborage. How can I assist you?
completion: A projection crystal... from another draenei?! Please, hand it to me quickly!
notes:
-Upon completion**
  Sanv K'la channels energy into the crystal.
  **Image of Elder Krasheen says:** So the Parash'ka spoke true. There really are other draenei in this world.
  **Image of Elder Krasheen says:** I am Elder Krasheen of the Moro'gai. Formerly inhabiting the swamps of Monoogha, we now call the lakes of Moonwhisper Coast our home. It is an honor to meet your tribe as the representative of the Moro'gai.
  **Sanv K'la says:** Okhal-asha, Elder Krasheen. I am Sanv K'la of the Sanv. Your words resonate with my own. Seeing another tribe alive and well sets my heart aflutter.
  **Image of Elder Krasheen says:** The Sanv Tribe? Of the Nham'shana Jungle? We've heard stories of your exploits. It is an honor to see such renowned riftwalkers, even as a projection.
  **Sanv K'la says:** Our tribe is no longer what it once was, we're a mere drop of water in the vast ocean that is the Twisting Nether. But let us continue this conversation is person, Elder Krasheen.
  **Image of Elder Krasheen says:** Well spoke. I will prepare for this occasion and get in contact with you very soon again.
  Elder Krasheen's image fades away.
  **Sanv K'la says:** We are once more in your debt, fair traveler. You have fulfilled a dream I had thought to be nothing more than a delusion of mine. The Sanv tribe will always welcome you as their own. Enkil Toralar.

title: The Way of Fel
objectives:
Retrieve 10 Fel Crystals from Felstrider Retreat for Leshandra Fintri in Alah'Thalas.
-[Fel Crystal](Fel Crystal) (10)
description:
Greetings. I am Leshandra Fintri, and my research delves into the more... unconventional methods of satiating our arcane addiction.

To the southwest lies a Blood Elf fortress. Blood Elves, notorious for handling their addiction differently than us, employ a distinct type of magic to quench their thirst. My endeavor is to glean more insights, but regrettably, the Regency Council opposes my research. If you could venture there and retrieve some Fel Crystals, I would compensate you generously for your efforts.
progress: I'm sure you will be fine. Just don't show the crystals to the guards.
completion: Ah, what a beautiful haul of sweet, sweet crystals. These will be invaluable in my research, truly invaluable. You have done a great service to our people today.
rewards:
You will receive:
-9300 XP
-+150 [reputation](reputation) with [Silvermoon Remnant](Silvermoon Remnant)

title: Fel Energy Irregularities III
objectives:
Return to Nethergarde, and deliver the Magically Sealed Dalaran Report to Watcher Mahar Ba.
- [Magically Sealed Dalaran Report](Magically Sealed Dalaran Report) (provided)
description:
It would appear that fel energy has indeed begun to ripple across the Blasted Lands, sending the region into a torrent of arcane irregularities and unstable conditions. Let us hope this is simply due to the Dark Portal itself, and not its reactivation.

It will take many more of our kin to keep everything under control. Now then, I am asking you to deliver an important letter, one that is magically sealed. Breaking it will destroy the parchment.

I trust that you will do for the good of the Kirin Tor, and for the Alliance itself. Make sure this reaches Mahar Ba, so that he may begin the necessary preparations.
progress: Have you travelled to Dalaran, and spoken with Ansirem Runeweaver?
completion: It is as I feared, the magical energies are that of fel.

title: Fel Energy Irregularities I
objectives:
Speak with Engineer Wigglestip and gather his report, bring it to Watcher Mahar Ba.
- [Engineer Wigglestip's Report](Engineer Wigglestip's Report)
description:
Why, you wouldn't happen to have some spare time would you?

The master of this tower has been hard at work and has given me the task of gathering a report from Engineer Wigglestip. Sadly to say, I haven't had the opportunity to leave just yet, nor do I know how to find our gnomish friend!

Do you think you could speak with Wigglestip and gather the report from him? Once you've obtained it, you can bring it to Watcher Mahar Ba at the top of the tower.
progress: Yes, can I help you?
completion:
So that is why you are here, this is the report from Wigglestip yes?

<Mahar Ba would take the report, beginning to read it with caution.>

Interesting...

title: Fel Energy Irregularities II
objectives:
Travel to Dalaran, and deliver the Sealed Nethergarde Report to Archmage Ansirem Runeweaver.
- [Sealed Nethergarde Report](Sealed Nethergarde Report)
description:
Well, this news certainly reinforces my assumptions, and what I have been studying. The Blasted Land's has become even more unstable, the energies within the region are beginning to grow in power.

I have been preparing a report that I need delivered to my superior's in the Kirin Tor, and I need you to deliver it at once. Communication at such a distance is impossible with the raging storms so I am relying on you.

Travel to Dalaran at once, and deliver this report to Archmage Ansirem Runeweaver.
progress: Yes?
completion:
Ahh yes, I sensed that you would be coming, I can practically feel the energy from the letter you carry.

<Upon taking the report, Ansirem Runeweaver would read with caution.>

I see.

So it is going as predicted, it would appear we may need to be more hands on to manage the growing instability within the Blasted Lands, let us hope there is no outside interferance that is causing the increased magical irregularities.

title: Fel Energy Irregularities IV
objectives:
Gather 3 Felguard Cuffs, and 3 Felhound Claws for Watcher Mahar Ba in Nethergarde Keep at the Blasted Lands.
-[Felguard Cuff](Felguard Cuff) (3)
-[Felhound Claw](Felhound Claw) (3)
description:
The Riftwatchers and myself have much work to do in our studying now that we know what is happening. I will need you to assist and gather some items from the demons nearest to the Dark Portal.

From the Felguard Sentry, and Felhounds, we will need to analyze to see if these demons are fresh from the portal, in doing so we need specific items.

From the Felguard's, gather Felguard Cuffs, from the Felhounds, gather Felhound Claws.

Once they are obtained, return them to me, at once, three of each should suffice.
progress: Have the items been recovered yet <class>?
completion: Good work, now, let us see what mysteries these may contain.

title: Fel Energy Irregularities V
objectives: Travel to the Tainted Scar, and speak with Daio the Decrepit.
description:
We have spent many months studying and preparing for the future, and it appears the future may be upon us sooner then we had realized.

There is one I have not spoken with for a long, long time. An old friend who once studied within the Kirin Tor, lost to the ways of demonic, and dark magic.

I will simply say that he owes me a favor, and I ask of you to reach him, so that he may answer my questions about the Dark Portal and the irregularities of the magic in the region.

Travel to the Southwest, and venture within the Tainted Scar, find Daio the Decrepit, an old warlock who resides there, ask him if he knows anything, I would suggest bringing a friend, or recruiting mercenaries, it is a dangerous place there.
progress: Yes?
completion: So.. Mahar Ba sent you, did he?

title: Fel Energy Irregularities VI
objectives:
Slay a Dreadlord within The Tainted Scar, and bring his Heart to Daio the Decrepit.
-[Dreadlord Heart](Dreadlord Heart)
description:
Heh.. He has a question, does he?

<The old, withered man lets out a crooked laugh, a wiry smirk resting upon his aged features.>

I haven't spoken to Mahar Ba in a long, long time, if he wants information, than I need something done, favor or no favor!

If you want to know the truth, than I require something from you.

Within the Tainted Scar lies a secretive race of demon, the Dreadlord, I have been meaning to practice all sorts of magic and I need a singular heart. Bring me a Dreadlord Heart, and I shall tell you what I know.
progress: Yes yes yes, do you have my heart?
completion: A Dreadlord Heart, oh how I desired, and needed one. You've done me a real favor, I shall answer your question.

title: Fel Energy Irregularities VII

fields.name: Fel Energy Irregularities VII
fields.rewards: Choice of:, Kirin Tor Shawl of Potency,, Kirin Tor Shawl of Authority,, Kirin Tor Shawl of Persecution, or, Kirin Tor Shawl of Oppresion

objectives: Return the news to Watcher Mahar Ba at Nethergarde Keep.
description:
So, he desires to know about the Dark Portal, and the influx of fel energy? The demon's have been gathering for some time around the Tainted Scar, and have been using it as a safe haven close to The Dark Portal.

With the increase of Fel Energy, there is no doubt that they have plans for the future. This future though, may not come for some time given what I have heard.

Go to Mahar Ba, and tell him to gather the best of his kin, and to prepare himself, time ticks slowly.

Now, begone, I have repaid his favor.
progress: Yes?
completion:
<Watcher Mahar Ba would look on with a slightly concerned look.>

We must begin to prepare, and keep the magical energies stable, you have given us a great deal of information, and without you we would have been unable to figure out these clues and unearth the answers we need for our future.

The Kirin Tor thanks you greatly for what you've done, please, take one of these rewards, it is the -least- we can for how much trouble you have saved us.

title: Genetic Alteration Anomaly!
objectives:
Collect a Pristine Helboar Brain for Engineer Wigglestip at Nethergarde Keep.
-[Pristine Helboar Brain](Pristine Helboar Brain)
description:
The energy radiating off of the Dark Portal is sheerly astounding, and it's given me so many research opportunities that I do not know where to start! I was employed here as an analyst to watch the ever shifting arcane magic within the region, and its incredibly unstable, so unstable infact that it has warped the boars close to the portal itself, turning them into 'Helboar'!

I know it sounds like something straight out of fantasy!

I need you to get me a Pristine Helboar Brain, to see just how much the creature has been altered by the intense energy of the Dark Portal.
progress: Twenty eight, carry the seven, account for arcane disturbances... Oh- it's you, have you had any luck?
completion: Ahh, this is a fine specimen, take long to find?

title: Controlling Sailors
objectives:
Find, and speak with the Kul Tiran Sailors sight-seeing Stormwind City to make sure they are not up to any shenanigans. Once spoken with, return to Petty Officer Milldough at the Kul Tiran Embassy in Stormwind Harbor.
- Check on [Sailor Hylreth](Sailor Hylreth)
- Check on [Sailor Brewen](Sailor Brewen)
- Check on [Sailor Pardol](Sailor Pardol)
description:
The life of a Petty Officer is much akin to herding sheep. I am in charge of keeping my men in control, and while that is easy on a ship, when docked in Stormwind it can be -very- difficult to have my attention on all of them at once.

They are spread around the city, sight-seeing, and no doubt getting quite drunk.

I could use a favor, if you don't mind. There are three sailors that I know of in the city, Hylreth, Brewen, and Pardol. Find them, and find out what exactly it is they are up to, just make sure they are not in any trouble is all, for my sake.
progress: Any luck finding them all?
completion:
Hmm, well, that is not all bad, some fighting will certainly need to be discussed with the Admiral, but otherwise I expected much worse...

Here, take this silver, as trouble for running around the city.
rewards:
You will receive:
-1138 XP
-+200 [reputation](reputation) with [Kul Tiras](Kul Tiras (faction))
notes:
Head to the [Slaughtered Lamb](Slaughtered Lamb) in the [Park](Park) to find [Sailor Pardol](Sailor Pardol):
  You better back off before we have a problem, understood?
  > Gossip: Petty Officer Milldough has asked me to check in on you.
  **Sailor Pardol says:** Check in on me? What does he think he can control me here, and who are you, some worthless constable?
Pardol will turn hostile. Defeat him:
  **Sailor Pardol says:** I yield, fine! Tell him I'll keep out of trouble then, I got the lesson.

Find [Sailor Brewen](Sailor Brewen) wandering the Canals between the Mage Quarter and Stormwind Harbor:
  All this money I've saved up; no better time to spend it than right now, aye?
  <Sailor Brewen laughs.>
  > Gossip: Petty Officer Milldough has asked me to check in on you.
  **Sailor Brewen says:** Check in on me? Haha! I ain't causing no trouble, that goody-two-shoes Milldough should learn to have some fun. All I am doing is exploring, this place is much different than Boralus after all.

Head next to the [Pig and Whistle Tavern](Pig and Whistle Tavern) in [Old Town](Old Town) to find [Sailor Hylreth](Sailor Hylreth):
  The south isn't so bad after all. Good ale, and a chance to stretch my weary sea legs from the long journey.
  What can I do for you, mainlander?
  > Gossip: Petty Officer Milldough has asked me to check in on you.
  **Sailor Hylreth says:** All is well, enjoying some ale, the views of southern lasses, and enjoying the weather on dry land. He should know me not to cause trouble in foreign lands.

title: Embassy Blues
objectives:
Find 3 Flasks of Port for Sailor Valia at the Kul Tiran Embassy in Stormwind Harbor.
- [Flask of Port](Flask of Port) (3)
description:
All this time stationed around and yet we hardly have any ale to tide over the boredom.

Say mainlander, you must have freedom to walk the streets of the city without a job looming over your head, how about a favor?

We are currently busy with tasks during the day, but we could use some loosening up during the night, if you catch my drift.

Head into the city, it should be ripe with ale, find me 3 Flasks of Port, that should do quite well.
progress:
So, you find the port...?

Like the ale.
completion:
Ahh, this is the good stuff.

Well, from one sailor to, whatever you are mainlander, thanks a bunch.
rewards:
You will receive:
-2100 XP
-+75 [reputation](reputation) with [Kul Tiras](Kul Tiras (faction))
notes: Flasks of Port can be bought from [Elly Langston](Elly Langston) at the [Pig and Whistle Tavern](Pig and Whistle Tavern) while speaking with [Sailor Hylreth](Sailor Hylreth) for [quest: Controlling Sailors].

title: A Sailor's Love
objectives:
Buy a rose on behalf of Sailor Borus and deliver it to Charys Yserian in Stormwind City.
- [Red Rose](Red Rose)
description:
Oh, it has been a long, long time since I have been in the city of Stormwind, what seems like a life in itself!

Around three years ago I traveled to this city with the fleet on other business and met a rather charming, and mysterious woman named 'Charys Yserian'. Never since has a woman left such an enchanting impression upon me, and I feel as though I am squandering my time stuck here on the coast with menial jobs unable to see her.

I ask of you to help, mainlander, it will be a few days until I get some free time, and I would like to make an impression... If she can remember me.

Travel to the florist Bernard Gump, he runs a shop called 'Fragrant Flowers' in the canals between Old Town and Trade District, buy a Red Rose and deliver it to Charys, word has it she runs a shop in the Mage Quarter now.
progress: Yes?
completion:
A rose? Why, isn't this something else..

From the Sailor Borus?

<The woman would let out a soft snicker, smirking openly.>

I remember the name, and that Kul Tiran man well, I never assumed him such a romantic.
rewards:
You will receive:
- 310 XP
-+100 [reputation](reputation) with [Kul Tiras](Kul Tiras (faction))

title: Charys' Response
objectives:
Bring Charys' Response to Sailor Borus at the Kul Tiran Embassy in Stormwind Harbor.
- [Charys' Response](Charys' Response (item))
description:
Who would suspect a Kul Tiran sailor to show so much affection? Those that many call crass, blunt, and overly loud at that.

He has surprised me, in a rather nice way; to be remembered after such a long time really is a compliment.

Here, I prepared a letter for him, and - just - for him. Do not think to pry it open, my magic will know if you do.

<She gives a wicked stare, and lets out a laugh to ease her feigned threat.>

Take it to the sailor, and let him know his actions are appreciated.
progress: Yes?
completion:
<Sailor Borus would let out a loud, and heavy sigh of relief.>

I can't thank you enough for this, so much time spent worrying, at the least I was able to finally do something!

Here, for the cost of the rose, I forgot, and some bit extra for doing this on my behalf.
rewards:
You will receive:
- 1100 XP
-+75 [reputation](reputation) with [Kul Tiras](Kul Tiras (faction))

title: A Hydromancer's Curiosity
objectives: Speak with Hydromancer Finnigan in the SI:7 Outpost on Balor.
description:
That good-for-nothing Finnigan! I swear, someday one of his escapades will be the end of him. You see, not long ago a group of SI:7 agents gathered at the docks. Apparently, from what we could overhear, they were on their way to complete a dangerous mission on the island just off the coast of Westfall. Balor is its name. That island has been drenched in a never-ending thunderstorm even well before we settled here in Davenburg. Kul Tiras has been in contact with Balor and its people in the past, so the place is not unknown to us.

Be that as it may, Finnigan, our local hydromancer, actually volunteered in helping the SI:7 with their assignment on Balor and is now with them in their outpost. We need him back here in Davenburg as soon as possible, so as to not jeopardize our diplomatic mission. <class>, would you be willing to help him finish whatever he started, so that he can return to us? One of the agents stayed back at the southern docks, I am sure he can take you to the island.
completion: Hornby sent you? That fool is too soft for his own good. I appreciate the sentiment, but what is happening here exceeds whatever I was assigned to in Davenburg by far. Out of the question. He is right in one thing, however. Should you aid me in my research, I'd be quicker to return to the mainland. So, what do you say?

title: Ceaseless Storms
objectives:
Follow the magically inclined murlocs on Balor and search them for anything suspicious. Return to Hydromancer Finnigan on Balor afterwards.
- [Pearlescent Shard](Pearlescent Shard (quest item))
description:
The storms of Balor fascinate me. During my stay in Davenburg I was occasionally able to peer into the distance and see the heavy clouds loom over the island like a coat of misery and gloom. I convened with my fellow hydromancers and conjured a few theories on what the cause of this unnatural phenomenon could be. There never really was a chance for us to explore this island safely before, however with the expedition of the SI:7 venturing here, such an opportunity arose and I naturally volunteered to assist them.

Feeling the tempest up close made me realize that it was assuredly different from the gales we encountered out on the open sea in Kul Tiras. Furthermore I began observing the local murlocs, as they appear to wield some sort of tidal magic not unsimilar to us hydromancers. <name>, seek out the murloc tidecaller and see if they possess anything unusual. Our last reports say they congregated in the northwestern islands.
progress: Kul Tiras and Balor share a history, were it not their ships to make trade with our fledgling nation many decades ago. As such I feel a distant connection and familiarity with this place, as faint as it may be.
completion: This shine and texture...! Even in this small chip of it, I can feel the tides resonate within it. And you picked it up from an enormous pearl on an altar, crackling with energy? I'll be honest with you, that sounds most alarming.
rewards:
You will receive:
- 2500 XP
-+200 [reputation](reputation) with [Kul Tiras](Kul Tiras (faction))

title: Piece Of A Bigger Picture
objectives:
Return with the needed reagents to Hydromancer Finnigan in the SI:7 Outpost on Balor.
- [Finnigan's Notebook](Finnigan's Notebook)
- [Reflecting Crystal](Reflecting Crystal)
- [Greater Astral Essence](Greater Astral Essence) (3)
description:
The pearl you found possesses tidal energy, meaning its mere presence controls the flow of the ocean and the temper of the sky. Seeing as it is damaged to a great amount, it would explain how the tempest is so unbound around here. How truly fascinating to see such a relic on this desolate island. Has it always been here? We can worry about this later, however. First and foremost we need to level the rampant energy within the pearl.

I can subside the pearl's unbridled power with a spell, but I require a few ingredients for that. A reflecting crystal, facetted and sharp. The Stone Maw basilisks near the northern river in the Stranglethorn Vale create these stones as they age. Bring me the biggest you can find. I also need my old spellbook, which I gifted to my good friend Loremaster Dibbs in Southshore of the Hillsbrad Foothills. Tell him I sent you, and he will gladly return it to me. To complete everything, bring me also three greater astral essences.
progress: From what we gathered I would assume the murlocs are collecting the shards of the broken pearl to complete it again. They do possess a degree of intelligence, more than enough to cast spells, yet even this is abnormal for what you'd expect from your regular murloc.
completion: That old fool. He always had a knack for living on the edge, but he should really start caring more about his safety. Either way, I am glad he is still in good health. Now then, my book may be a bit waterlogged, but I can formulate the spell nevertheless.
rewards:
You will receive:
- 3000 XP
-+100 [reputation](reputation) with [Kul Tiras](Kul Tiras (faction))

title: Calming The Tempest

fields.name: Calming The Tempest
fields.rewards: Pearlescent Shard, Choice of:, Hydromancer Cowl, or, Choker of Insight

objectives:
Calm the pearl and return to Hydromancer Finnigan in the SI:7 Outpost on Balor afterwards.
- [Subsided the Pearl's wrath](Abysstide Siren)
description:
<Finnigan places the reagents on the table in front of him. Reciting spells written in his old journal, you can feel the air crackling with faint energy around the crystal you recovered in Stranglethorn Vale. It begins to glow in various hues of blue, shifting between darkness and bright light. With one last movement of his hands, the hydromancer finishes the sorcery and the crystal lies now still, hummin in perfect harmony.>

It is done. Quickly, take the crystal and hold it near the shattered pearl, on the northwestern islands. The crystal's own harmonious energy should be enough to soothe the pearl's raging energy. Beware of what might happen; tidal magic is unpredictable and untamed.
progress: All of this is more than puzzling, yet the situation calls for action, not speculation.
completion:
Naga, you say?! This is truly bad news. If these slithering demons are behind this phenomenon, then I dare not think what their true intentions are. For now we have thwarted their ambitions. However, I do wonder, has this pearl been here all along? If so, was it always broken? And if not, why was it brought here; and by whom? The naga or the murlocs? Many unanswered questions still lie before us and none of them seem to be easily answered. Either way, I must thank you for your assistance. Our findings today helped me gain a better understanding of Balor's unending storm. Once I return to Davenburg, I will send notice to the Council of Tides in Boralus about the pearl, as well as the naga's involvement in all of this. With their ongoing incursions onto Kul Tiras, I am afraid this won't be the last we've seen of them.

Please, take this as humble compensation for your deeds.
rewards:
You will be able to choose one of these rewards:
-[Hydromancer Cowl](Hydromancer Cowl)
-[Choker of Insight](Choker of Insight)

You will also receive:
- [Pearlescent Shard](Pearlescent Shard)
- 3100 XP
-+100 [reputation](reputation) with [Kul Tiras](Kul Tiras (faction))

title: The Depths of Karazhan V
objectives:
Gather the Old Crypt Key, and the Mark of Karazhan from around the ruins of Karazhan for Kor'gan in Stonard.
- [Mark of Karazhan](Mark of Karazhan)
- [Old Crypt Key](Old Crypt Key)
description:
If we are to reforge the key, then we will need the items that Gunther Arcanus had hinted to. I have no doubts in my mind that both of these items can be found lingering around the tower.

The first item we shall acquire is the key itself, there are rumors of a sickly, pale human who emerges when not a living soul is about, to tend the grounds around Karazhan. It would be from him, that the Old Crypt Key can be found, find him, and claim it for our purposes, he should be around.

Lastly, a Mark of Karazhan will be required, of which there are not many left on this mortal world. I have heard tales of a Captain lingering in the caves of The Master's Cellar. Captain Rothynn and his twin brother were both given one long ago, he should still have one.

When these items are obtained, return to me, and I can forge the key.
progress: Be dedicated in your searching, if we are to destroy this evil, then we must act fast.
completion: So, the stories were correct, the items have been obtained, with the Pendant of Ardan, the Mark of Karazhan, and the key itself, I can begin to work my magic.
notes: Both of the NPCs are found in the [Master's Cellar](Master's Cellar) in the ruined homes just before the tower entrance, with each of the NPCs on opposite ends of the area from one another. [Groundskeeper Jacoby](Groundskeeper Jacoby) can be found at the very end of the wine cellar's right-most passage, whereas [Captain Rothynn](Captain Rothynn) haunts the underground caves beneath the collapsed cellar. You can skip some of the mobs in the caves by hugging the left wall and then dropping down into a small crevasse in the floor and continuing along the way again, keeping to the left.

title: Help The League?
objectives:
Collect 10 Raptor Eggs and bring them to [Grovug Mithrilmane](Grovug Mithrilmane) stationed in Dun Agrath.
-[Raptor Egg](Raptor Egg): 0/10
description:
Report after report of raptors slowly moving against our digsite were ignored by that fool Grovug up in the mountains.

He's had a comfy posting up in Dun Agrath and hasn't moved an inch, even though he's supposed to be here.

I need some solid proof to give to him, right to his face for some action to get done. Raptor Eggs should do finely.

Slay the beasts down there, and collect eggs from them. Bring those eggs to Grovug in the mountains of Dun Agrath to the south west along the mountains.
progress: I'm on important League business up here.
completion:
You're saying these are from the Whelgar site? Really?

I thought they were all overreacting down there, but if it's as bad as you say then I'm going to have to write a report and get it to Ironforge as quickly as I can!

title: Join The League!
objectives: Report to Merrin Rockweaver to become a great explorer!
description:
The Explorer's league is always looking for new members. Are you looking to see the world, and travel the seas of Azeroth in search of forgotten artifacts and buried treasures?!

Well then, you should seek out my friend Merrin Rockweaver, one of the many excavators and explorers from the league uncovering old artifacts and bones!

Head east from here and find Whelgar's Excavation site. It should be tucked against the southern mountains, so keep your eyes peeled explorer!
progress: Yeah, can I help you? Things are a bit of a mess here.
completion:
Is Menethil Harbor still in the dark about what has happened here?

I need proof to report to that fool Grovug stationed in the mountains. You'll help right?

title: The Scales of War
objectives:
Bring the Sealed Kul Tiran Letter to Vice Admiral Renhoff at the Kul Tiran Embassy in the Stormwind Harbor.
- [Sealed Kul Tiran Letter](Sealed Kul Tiran Letter) (provided)
description:
It has been three hard years since Lord Daelin brought us to these Light-forsaken shores. The strength of our Expeditionary Fleet has been duly tested against the orcs and their miserable allies, while I was able to find little to no resources in my absence.

If I am to win this war, or at the least secure a westward bulwark against our most hated enemy, then I cannot fight alone.

Vice Admiral Renhoff is an old friend of mine, and he holds great sway within Kul Tiras.

I need you to find him in Stormwind and deliver this letter to him, to plead our case, to ensure that all our sacrifices are not in vain.
progress: What is it? Can I help you?
completion:
Alverold lives?! Tides be thanked!

With the fall of Lord Daelin, we thought the western cause lost. Indeed, many in Kul Tiras have elected to divert our attention north.

It will not be easy to persuade them to support the Kalimdor Expedition again; it is far more likely that they will demand Alverold's return for his assistance in the northern realms instead.

Still, I will do what I can and send word to Alverold once I have news.

You have Kul Tiras' gratitude, <name>.

title: Your Place In The World
objectives: Speak with [Gornek](Gornek). You recall Kaltunk marking your map with his location and mentioning that gornek resides in the Den, a building to the west.
description:
Finally, you are of age, <name>... of age to battle in the name of the Horde. To conquer for the glory of the [Warchief](Warchief).

Yes...

<[Kaltunk](Kaltunk) looks you over.>

You will do nicely.

No doubt you wish to find a great dragon or demon and strangle it with your bare hands, but perhaps it would be wise to start on something less... dangerous.

<Kaltunk laughs.>

Report to Gornek, he should be able to assign a task better suited to a young <class>. You will find Gornek in the Den, to the west.
completion:
Another one of Kaltunk's recruits, hm?

A sorry state of affairs we find ourselves in if this is the best the Horde can produce. No matter. By the time we think you're ready to leave the [Valley](Valley of Trials), you'll be a proud warrior of the Horde.
rewards:
You will receive:
- 40 [XP](XP)
- +50 [reputation](reputation) with [Orgrimmar](Orgrimmar (faction))
- +50 [reputation](reputation) with [Darkspear Trolls](Darkspear Trolls (faction))

title: Cutting Teeth
objectives:
Slaughter 6 Mottled Boars.
- [Mottled Boar](Mottled Boar) slaughtered (6)
description:
The first order of business will be to put a little strength in your backbone. I could send you out to the [Barrens](Barrens) to hunt [kodo](kodo), but well, in all honesty, you're more useful to us alive than dead.

I believe you'll be of more use to us slaughtering the [boar](boar)s you'll find in the farms to the north and northeast of here.
progress: I hope you haven't returned to try and convince me that you have completed your task, <name>. No, of course not. I would think better of you.
completion:
Hmmm, not bad, <name>. But don't let it get to your head...you'll fight tougher than boars in your career.

Nonetheless, you've proven yourself well, and your next trial will be against a considerably more dangerous opponent, so you'll need some extra protection.
rewards:
You will be able to choose one of these rewards:
-[Soft Wool Boots](Soft Wool Boots)
-[Battleworn Leather Gloves](Battleworn Leather Gloves)

You will also receive:
- 170 [XP](XP)
- +100 [reputation](reputation) with [Orgrimmar](Orgrimmar (faction))
- +100 [reputation](reputation) with [Darkspear Trolls](Darkspear Trolls (faction))
